entry.summary: Presents Functional Task Networks (FTN), a continual learning method inspired by cortical motifs that uses self-organizing binary masks over populations of small deep networks for task isolation and inference without task labels.

entry.title: Scalable Hyperparameter-Divergent Ensemble Training with Automatic Learning Rate Exploration for Large Models

author.name: Hailing Cheng, Tao Huang, Chen Zhu, Antonio Alonso

entry.summary: Proposes Hyperparameter-Divergent Ensemble Training (HDET) that repurposes data-parallel GPU replicas for simultaneous learning rate exploration during LLM training, with automatic learning rate adjustment.

entry.title: Generative diffusion models for spatiotemporal influenza forecasting

author.name: Joseph Lemaitre, Justin Lessler

entry.summary: Adapts denoising diffusion probabilistic models to epidemic forecasting by encoding influenza seasons as spatiotemporal images, using inpainting for conditional generation from partial observations. Generates diverse, realistic epidemic trajectories.

entry.title: Rethinking Layer Redundancy in Large Language Models: Calibration Objectives and Search for Depth Pruning

author.name: Minkyu Kim, Vincent-Daniel Yun, Youngrae Kim, Youngjin Heo, Suin Cho, Seong-hun Kim, Woosang Lim, Gaeul Kwon

entry.summary: Studies depth pruning of LLMs from a functional perspective, showing that layer redundancy depends on both model and evaluation objective. Finds perplexity and downstream accuracy rankings don't consistently align across three LLM families.

entry.title: The Role of Symmetry in Optimizing Overparameterized Networks

author.name: Kusha Sareen, Mohammad Pedramfar, S\'ekou-Oumar Kaba, Mehran Shakerinava, Siamak Ravanbakhsh

entry.summary: Analyzes how weight-space symmetries in overparameterized networks benefit optimization: they enable better-conditioned minima via diagonal preconditioning and increase probability mass of global minima near initialization.

entry.title: Biased Dreams: Limitations to Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification in Latent Space Models

author.name: Julia Berger, Bernd Frauenknecht, Sebastian Trimpe, Bastian Leibe

entry.summary: Demonstrates that latent dynamics models in Dreamer-family MBRL exhibit biased attractors toward well-represented latent regions, causing epistemic uncertainty quantification methods that work for physical dynamics to fail in latent space.

entry.title: Quantum Dynamics via Score Matching on Bohmian Trajectories

author.name: Lei Wang

entry.summary: Solves the time-dependent Schrödinger equation by learning the score function on Bohmian trajectories using neural networks. Proves the zero-loss minimizer recovers Schrödinger dynamics for nodeless wave functions.

entry.title: From Soliloquy to Agora: Memory-Enhanced LLM Agents with Decentralized Debate for Optimization Modeling

author.name: Jianghao Lin, Zi Ling, Chenyu Zhou, Tianyi Xu, Ruoqing Jiang, Zizhuo Wang, Dongdong Ge

entry.summary: Proposes Agora-Opt, a multi-agent framework for optimization modeling combining decentralized debate with memory banks. Multiple agent teams produce solutions independently and reconcile through outcome-grounded debate.

entry.title: GAIA-v2-LILT: Multilingual Adaptation of Agent Benchmark beyond Translation

author.name: Yunsu Kim, Kaden Uhlig, Joern Wuebker

entry.summary: Proposes a refined methodology for adapting English agent benchmarks to other languages with functional, cultural alignment, and difficulty calibration. Introduces GAIA-v2-LILT covering five non-English languages with up to 32.7% improvement over minimal translation.

entry.title: CORAL: Adaptive Retrieval Loop for Culturally-Aligned Multilingual RAG

author.name: Nayeon Lee, Jiwoo Song, Byeongcheol Kang

entry.summary: Introduces CORAL, an adaptive retrieval methodology for multilingual RAG that iteratively refines both the retrieval space (corpora) and query based on evidence quality. Addresses retrieval-condition misalignment for culturally grounded queries.

entry.title: PSI-Bench: Towards Clinically Grounded and Interpretable Evaluation of Depression Patient Simulators

author.name: Nguyen Khoi Hoang, Shuhaib Mehri, Tse-An Hsu, Yi-Jyun Sun, Quynh Xuan Nguyen Truong, Khoa D Doan, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Introduces PSI-Bench, an evaluation framework for depression patient simulators with clinically grounded diagnostics across turn-, dialogue-, and population-level dimensions. Benchmarks seven LLMs and finds existing simulators lack behavioral diversity.

entry.title: DRAGON: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Visual Reasoning over Diagrams

author.name: Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Tampu Ravi Kumar, Gaurav Najpande, Manan Suri, Dinesh Manocha, Puneet Mathur, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces DRAGON, a benchmark for evidence-grounded visual reasoning in diagrams, requiring models to identify visual evidence regions that support their answers rather than just achieving answer accuracy.

entry.title: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments

author.name: Enqi Liu, Liyuan Pan, Zhi Gao, Yan Yang, Chenrui Shi, Yang Liu, Jingrong Wu, Qing Li

entry.summary: Introduces DynamicGUIBench, a benchmark for testing GUI agents in high-dynamic environments where a single screenshot after each action leads to partial observability. The benchmark spans ten applications and diverse interaction scenarios, addressing an underexplored challenge in GUI agent research.

entry.title: DDA-Thinker: Decoupled Dual-Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning-Driven Image Editing

author.name: Hanqing Yang, Qiang Zhou, Yongchao Du, Sashuai Zhou, Zhibin Wang, Jun Song, Tiezheng Ge, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes DDA-Thinker, a framework that decouples planning (Thinker) from generation (Editor) in image editing, using dual-atomic reinforcement learning with verifiable checklist rewards to improve reasoning-driven editing capabilities.

entry.title: Mutual Forcing: Dual-Mode Self-Evolution for Fast Autoregressive Audio-Video Character Generation

author.name: Yupeng Zhou, Lianghua Huang, Zhifan Wu, Jiabao Wang, Yupeng Shi, Biao Jiang, Daquan Zhou, Yu Liu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Qibin Hou

entry.summary: Proposes Mutual Forcing, a framework for fast autoregressive audio-video character generation with long-horizon synchronization. Uses a two-stage strategy training uni-modal generators first then coupling them, and trains a native fast causal model directly.

entry.title: SIEVES: Selective Prediction Generalizes through Visual Evidence Scoring

author.name: Hector G. Rodriguez, Marcus Rohrbach

entry.summary: Proposes SIEVES, a selective prediction framework for multimodal LLMs that requires models to produce localized visual evidence while answering, and trains a selector to estimate reliability from that evidence. Targets reliable OOD deployment.

entry.title: ProDrive: Proactive Planning for Autonomous Driving via Ego-Environment Co-Evolution

author.name: Chuyao Fu, Shengzhe Gan, Zhuoli Ouyang, Yuhan Rui, Xiaowei Chi, Sirui Han, Jiankun Wang, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ProDrive, a world-model-based proactive planning framework for autonomous driving that jointly trains a trajectory planner and BEV world model to anticipate future scene evolution and evaluate candidate trajectories.

entry.title: ML Safety Newsletter #20: AI Wellbeing, Classifier Jailbreaking and Honest Pushback Benchmarking

author.name: Alice Blair

entry.summary: ML Safety Newsletter covering three topics: measuring AI functional wellbeing (pleasure/pain expressions), classifier jailbreaking techniques, and honest pushback benchmarking for language models.

entry.title: CAP-CoT: Cycle Adversarial Prompt for Improving Chain of Thoughts in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Shuxu Chen, Yitian Zhou, Jiaquan Zhang, Haoyu Bian, Aming Wu, Sungyoung Lee, Chaoning Zhang, Hyundong Shin

entry.summary: Proposes CAP-CoT, a cycle adversarial prompt optimization framework that improves Chain-of-Thought reasoning accuracy and stability through iterative forward-solver and adversarial-challenger cycles.

entry.title: A2DEPT: Large Language Model-Driven Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Program Trees

author.name: Bin Chen, Shouliang Zhu, Beidan Liu, Yong Zhao, Tianle Pu, Huichun Li, Zhengqiu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes A2DEPT, which uses LLMs as system-level algorithm architects through evolutionary program trees for combinatorial optimization, enabling open-ended solver synthesis beyond fixed templates.

entry.title: Certified geometric robustness -- Super-DeepG

author.name: No\'emie Cohen (Airbus CR\&T), M\'elanie Ducoffe (Airbus CR\&T), Christophe Gabreau, Claire Pagetti, Xavier Pucel

entry.summary: Presents Super-DeepG, improving formal verification of neural networks against geometric perturbations (rotation, scaling, shearing) through improved linear relaxation and GPU-accelerated Lipschitz optimization.

entry.title: A systematic evaluation of vision-language models for observational astronomical reasoning tasks

author.name: Wenke Ren, Hengxiao Guo, Wenwen Zuo, Xiaoman Zhang

entry.summary: AstroVLBench benchmarks six frontier VLMs across 4,100+ expert-verified astronomical tasks spanning optical, radio, multi-wavelength, time-domain, and spectroscopy data. Finds Gemini 3 Pro is most consistently capable but all models substantially underperform specialized methods.

entry.title: MetaEarth3D: Unlocking World-scale 3D Generation with Spatially Scalable Generative Modeling

author.name: Jinqi Cao, Zhiping Yu, Baihong Lin, Chenyang Liu, Zhenwei Shi, Zhengxia Zou

entry.summary: MetaEarth3D introduces spatially scalable generative modeling for world-scale 3D generation from Earth observation data, arguing that spatial scale is a missing dimension of generative AI intelligence beyond model parameters and training data.

entry.title: The Security Cost of Intelligence: AI Capability, Cyber Risk, and Deployment Paradox

author.name: Sukwoong Choi

entry.summary: Develops an analytical model showing a 'deployment paradox' where more capable AI can lead firms to deploy less when governance controls haven't kept pace with capability, especially in high-loss environments.

entry.title: No Test Cases, No Problem: Distillation-Driven Code Generation for Scientific Workflows

author.name: Siddeshwar Raghavan, Tanwi Mallick

entry.summary: Introduces MOSAIC, a training-free multi-agent LLM framework for scientific code generation that works without I/O test cases by using student-teacher knowledge distillation and a Consolidated Context Window to mitigate hallucinations.

entry.title: From Similarity to Structure: Training-free LLM Context Compression with Hybrid Graph Priors

author.name: Yitian Zhou, Chaoning Zhang, Jiaquan Zhang, Zhenzhen Huang, Jinyu Guo, Sung-Ho Bae, Lik-Hang Lee, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free context compression framework using hybrid graph priors that combines semantic similarity edges with sequential edges to select compact sentence sets under token budgets.

entry.title: Evaluating Jailbreaking Vulnerabilities in LLMs Deployed as Assistants for Smart Grid Operations: A Benchmark Against NERC Standards

author.name: Taha Hammadia, Lucas Rea, Ahmad Mohammad Saber, Amr Youssef, Deepa Kundur

entry.summary: Evaluates jailbreaking vulnerabilities in LLMs deployed as smart grid assistants against NERC reliability standards, testing GPT-4o mini, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, and Claude 3.5 Haiku with multiple attack methods.

entry.title: A Parametric Memory Head for Continual Generative Retrieval

author.name: Kidist Amde Mekonnen, Yubao Tang, Maarten de Rijke

entry.summary: Proposes a parametric memory head for continual generative retrieval that addresses catastrophic forgetting when updating document collections, showing sequential adaptation degrades earlier document retrieval.

entry.title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs

author.name: Divakar Kumar Yadav, Tian Zhao, Deepak Kumar

entry.summary: First independent cross-architecture evaluation of NVIDIA's CuTile against cuBLAS, Triton, and other approaches on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs for AI workloads including GEMM and LLM inference.

entry.title: PhysCodeBench: Benchmarking Physics-Aware Symbolic Simulation of 3D Scenes via Self-Corrective Multi-Agent Refinement

author.name: Tianyidan Xie, Peiyu Wang, Yuyi Qian, Yuxuan Wang, Rui Ma, Ying Tai, Song Wu, Qian Wang, Lanjun Wang, Zili Yi

entry.summary: Introduces PhysCodeBench, a 700-sample benchmark for evaluating LLMs on physics-aware symbolic simulation code generation across mechanics, fluid dynamics, and soft-body physics. Also proposes a multi-agent self-corrective refinement approach.

entry.title: S2G-RAG: Structured Sufficiency and Gap Judging for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented QA

author.name: Minghan Li, Junjie Zou, Xinxuan Lv, Chao Zhang, Guodong Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces S2G-RAG, an iterative RAG framework with an explicit controller (S2G-Judge) that predicts evidence sufficiency and outputs structured gap descriptions for targeted subsequent retrieval in multi-hop QA.

entry.title: Inverting Foundation Models of Brain Function with Simulation-Based Inference

author.name: Niels Bracher, Xavier Intes, Stefan T. Radev

entry.summary: Uses simulation-based inference to invert a brain activity foundation model (TRIBEv2), recovering stimulus properties (valence, arousal, dominance) from predicted brain maps. Pairs the brain emulator with LLMs generating stimuli.

entry.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents

author.name: Jiaqi Wang, Wenhao Zhang, Weijie Shi, Yaliang Li, James Cheng

entry.summary: Identifies 'Trajectory-Level KL Instability' in on-policy distillation for multi-turn agents, where inter-turn error compounding drives the student beyond the teacher's support. Proposes temporal curriculum (TCOD) to address this.

entry.title: Progressive Approximation in Deep Residual Networks: Theory and Validation

author.name: Wei Wang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proves the existence of progressive approximation trajectories in residual networks where error decreases monotonically with depth. Proposes Layer-wise Progressive Approximation (LPA) training that aligns each layer with its residual target.

entry.title: SeaEvo: Advancing Algorithm Discovery with Strategy Space Evolution

author.name: Sichun Luo, Yi Huang, Haochen Luo, Fengyuan Liu, Guanzhi Deng, Lei Li, Qinghua Yao, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SeaEvo, a strategy-space evolution layer for LLM-guided evolutionary algorithm discovery that elevates natural-language strategy descriptions to first-class citizens in the evolutionary search process.

entry.title: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment

author.name: Kaijun Zhou, Qiwei Chen, Da Peng, Zhiyang Li, Xijun Li, Jinyu Gu

entry.summary: Provides systematic cross-accelerator analysis for VLA model deployment on edge devices, introducing CET (Cost, Energy, Time) evaluation framework. Shows right-sized edge devices can be more efficient than flagship GPUs for robot control.

entry.title: DepthKV: Layer-Dependent KV Cache Pruning for Long-Context LLM Inference

author.name: Zahra Dehghanighobadi, Asja Fischer

entry.summary: Proposes DepthKV, a layer-dependent KV cache pruning method that assigns different pruning ratios to different layers based on their sensitivity, rather than uniform pruning across all layers.

entry.title: On the Trainability of Masked Diffusion Language Models via Blockwise Locality

author.name: Yuxiang Wang, Yu Xiang, Baojian Zhou, Qifang Zhao, Keyue Jiang, Yanghua Xiao, Xiaoxiao Xu

entry.summary: Studies trainability of masked diffusion language models (MDMs) compared to autoregressive LLMs on controlled tasks, finding instabilities in MDMs. Proposes Jigsaw and Scatter blockwise models that inject left-to-right bias to improve stability.

entry.title: Laplace-Bridged Randomized Smoothing for Fast Certified Robustness

author.name: Miao Lin, MD Saifur Rahman Mazumder, Feng Yu, Daniel Takabi, Rui Ning

entry.summary: Proposes Laplace-Bridged Smoothing (LBS), an analytic reformulation of Randomized Smoothing that replaces Monte Carlo sampling with efficient low-dimensional probability computations, enabling certified robustness without noise-augmented training.

entry.title: QFlash: Bridging Quantization and Memory Efficiency in Vision Transformer Attention

author.name: Sehyeon Oh, Yongin Kwon, Jemin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes QFlash, an end-to-end integer FlashAttention for Vision Transformers running entirely in integer domain as a single Triton kernel. Achieves up to 6.73x speedup over I-ViT attention.

entry.title: How Fast Should a Model Commit to Supervision? Training Reasoning Models on the Tsallis Loss Continuum

author.name: Chu-Cheng Lin, Eugene Ie

entry.summary: Studies loss functions for training reasoning models using the Tsallis q-logarithm family, interpolating between RLVR and log-marginal-likelihood. Shows how different q values address cold-start stalling in low-success-probability regimes.

entry.title: A Finite Time Analysis of Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization with Preferential Feedback

author.name: Joseph Lazzaro, Davide Buffelli, Da-shan Shiu, Sattar Vakili

entry.summary: Proposes a Thompson Sampling approach to Bayesian optimization with preferential (pairwise comparison) feedback, providing finite-time regret bounds matching standard BO with scalar feedback. Uses dueling kernel formulation.

entry.title: Walking Through Uncertainty: An Empirical Study of Uncertainty Estimation for Audio-Aware Large Language Models

author.name: Chun-Yi Kuan, Wei-Ping Huang, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: First systematic empirical study of uncertainty estimation in audio-aware large language models (ALLMs). Benchmarks five uncertainty methods across multiple models and tasks, revealing challenges from perceptual ambiguity and cross-modal grounding.

entry.title: Analyzing LLM Reasoning to Uncover Mental Health Stigma

author.name: Sreehari Sankar, Aliakbar Nafar, Mona Barman, Hannah K. Heitz, Ashwin Kumar, Pouria Tohidi, Dailun Li, Danish Hussain, Russell DuBois, Hamed Hasheminia, Farshad Majzoubi

entry.summary: Analyzes intermediate reasoning steps of LLMs to uncover hidden stigmatizing language toward people with mental health conditions. Develops clinical-expertise-based framework for identifying problematic reasoning patterns.

entry.title: LLM-ReSum: A Framework for LLM Reflective Summarization through Self-Evaluation

author.name: Huyen Nguyen, Haoxuan Zhang, Yang Zhang, Junhua Ding, Haihua Chen

entry.summary: Conducts comprehensive meta-evaluation of 14 summarization metrics across seven datasets and five domains (2K-27K words). Finds traditional metrics (ROUGE, BLEU) have weak/negative correlation with human judgments, while LLM-based evaluators achieve higher alignment. Proposes LLM-ReSum, a reflective summarization framework.

entry.title: R$^3$-SQL: Ranking Reward and Resampling for Text-to-SQL

author.name: Hojae Han, Yeonseok Jeong, Seung-won Hwang, Zhewei Yao, Yuxiong He

entry.summary: Proposes R³-SQL for Text-to-SQL that addresses inconsistent scoring of equivalent SQL queries and missing correct candidates through unified reward-based ranking and resampling. Groups candidates by execution result for consistent scoring.

entry.title: OmniVTG: A Large-Scale Dataset and Training Paradigm for Open-World Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Minghang Zheng, Zihao Yin, Yi Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces OmniVTG, a large-scale dataset for open-world video temporal grounding with a Semantic Coverage Iterative Expansion pipeline and Self-Correction Chain-of-Thought training for MLLMs.

entry.title: Instruction-Evidence Contrastive Dual-Stream Decoding for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Yashwant Pravinrao Bangde, Debaditya Roy

entry.summary: Proposes IECD2, a dual-stream decoding framework for vision-language models that balances linguistic informativeness and visual faithfulness by maintaining two parallel token distributions at each decoding step.

entry.title: 8DNA: 8D Neural Asset Light Transport by Distribution Learning

author.name: Liwen Wu, Haolin Lu, Bing Xu, Milo\v{s} Ha\v{s}an, Ravi Ramamoorthi

entry.summary: Introduces 8D Neural Assets (8DNA) for pre-baking global illumination effects (subsurface scattering, interreflections) into neural representations, enabling accurate rendering under near-field illumination using distribution learning from path-traced samples.

entry.title: asRoBallet: Closing the Sim2Real Gap via Friction-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Underactuated Spherical Dynamics

author.name: Fang Wan, Guangyi Huang, Tianyu Wu, Zishang Zhang, Bangchao Huang, Haoran Sun, Mingdong Chen, Chaoyang Song

entry.summary: Introduces asRoBallet, the first successful RL deployment on humanoid ballbot hardware, proposing a high-fidelity MuJoCo simulation that models disc-ball friction to close the sim-to-real gap for this challenging underactuated control problem.

entry.title: Will whole brain emulation matter for the AI transition?

author.name: djbinder

entry.summary: Analyzes whether whole brain emulation (WBE) will matter for the AI transition, concluding it's decades away without AGI, would cost 10,000-40,000 H100-equivalents per emulation, and offers a weak safety case compared to purpose-built AI.

entry.title: From Coarse to Fine: Self-Adaptive Hierarchical Planning for LLM Agents

author.name: Haoran Tan, Zeyu Zhang, Chen Ma, Tianze Liu, Quanyu Dai, Xu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AdaPlan-H, a self-adaptive hierarchical planning mechanism for LLM agents that adjusts planning granularity based on task complexity, inspired by progressive refinement in cognitive science.

entry.title: MetaGAI: A Large-Scale and High-Quality Benchmark for Generative AI Model and Data Card Generation

author.name: Haoxuan Zhang, Ruochi Li, Yang Zhang, Zhenni Liang, Junhua Ding, Ting Xiao, Haihua Chen

entry.summary: Introduces MetaGAI, a benchmark of 2,541 verified document triplets for evaluating automated generation of AI Model and Data Cards, constructed through semantic triangulation of papers, GitHub repos, and Hugging Face artifacts.

entry.title: Thinking Like a Clinician: A Cognitive AI Agent for Clinical Diagnosis via Panoramic Profiling and Adversarial Debate

author.name: Zhiqi Lv, Duofan Tu, Jun Li, Mingyue Zhao, Heqin Zhu, Wenliang Li, Shaohua Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DxChain, a chain-based clinical reasoning framework for LLM-assisted diagnosis that mirrors clinician cognitive trajectories with Memory Anchoring, Navigation, and Verification phases. Introduces adversarial debate for verification.

entry.title: Transferable Human Mobility Network Reconstruction with neuroGravity

author.name: Jinming Yang, Shaoyu Huang, Zongyuan Huang, Yaohui Jin, Xiaokang Yang, Marta C. Gonzalez, Yanyan Xu

entry.summary: Develops neuroGravity, a physics-informed deep learning model for reconstructing human mobility flows from limited observations that transfers to unobserved cities. Finds spatial income segregation plays a key role in model transferability.

entry.title: Explanation Quality Assessment as Ranking with Listwise Rewards

author.name: Thomas Bailleux, Tanmoy Mukherjee, Emmanuel Lonca, Pierre Marquis, Zied Bouraoui

entry.summary: Reformulates explanation quality assessment as a ranking problem rather than generation, training listwise and pairwise ranking models on candidate explanation sets. Finds ranking losses outperform regression on score separation.

entry.title: FastOMOP: A Foundational Architecture for Reliable Agentic Real-World Evidence Generation on OMOP CDM data

author.name: Niko Moeller-Grell, Shihao Shenzhang, Zhangshu Joshua Jiang, Richard JB Dobson, Vishnu V Chandrabalan

entry.summary: FastOMOP is a multi-agent framework for generating real-world evidence from OMOP clinical data that addresses safety, coordination failures, and governance of agentic systems operating over health records of nearly one billion patients across 83 countries.

entry.title: DO-Bench: An Attributable Benchmark for Diagnosing Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models

author.name: JiYang Wang, Jiawei Chen, Mengqi Xiao, Yu Cheng, Yangfu Li, Zhaoxia Yin

entry.summary: DO-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark that disentangles whether VLM object hallucination errors stem from perceptual limitations or contextual textual priors through structured multimodal interventions.

entry.title: VS-DDPM: Efficient Low-Cost Diffusion Model for Medical Modality Translation

author.name: Nikoo Moradi, Gijs Luijten, Behrus Hinrichs-Puladi, Jens Kleesiek, Victor Alves, Jan Egger, Andr\'e Ferreira

entry.summary: Proposes VS-DDPM, a 3D variable-step diffusion model for medical modality translation that accelerates inference while maintaining quality. Achieves SOTA on missing MRI synthesis in BraTS2025 challenge.

entry.title: C-MORAL: Controllable Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization with Reinforcement Alignment for LLMs

author.name: Rui Gao, Youngseung Jeon, Swastik Roy, Morteza Ziyadi, Xiang 'Anthony' Chen

entry.summary: Proposes C-Moral, an RL post-training framework for controllable multi-objective molecular optimization with LLMs, using group-based optimization and continuous reward aggregation for drug design.

entry.title: UNSEEN: A Cross-Stack LLM Unlearning Defense against AR-LLM Social Engineering Attacks

author.name: Tianlong Yu, Yang Yang, Xiao Luo, Lihong Liu, Fudu Xing, Zui Tao, Kailong Wang, Gaoyang Liu, Ting Bi

entry.summary: Proposes UNSEEN, a cross-stack defense using LLM unlearning against AR-LLM social engineering attacks where attackers use AR glasses and LLMs to identify and phish targets.

entry.title: Au-M-ol: A Unified Model for Medical Audio and Language Understanding

author.name: Meizhu Liu, Nistha Mitra, Paul Li, Amine Abdaoui, Adam Ledyard, Tao Sheng

entry.summary: Presents Au-M-ol, a multimodal architecture extending LLMs with audio processing for medical speech, achieving 56% WER reduction on medical transcription compared to SOTA baselines.

entry.title: GIFT: Global stabilisation via Intrinsic Fine Tuning

author.name: Rory Young, Nicolas Pugeault

entry.summary: Proposes GIFT, a training framework that directly optimizes global stability of deep RL policies using custom reward functions, addressing the chaotic dynamics often produced by RL in continuous control.

entry.title: EmoTrans: A Benchmark for Understanding, Reasoning, and Predicting Emotion Transitions in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: He Hu, Tengjin Weng, Zebang Cheng, Yu Wang, Jiachen Luo, Bj\"orn Schuller, Zheng Lian, Laizhong Cui

entry.summary: Introduces EmoTrans, a benchmark for evaluating emotion dynamics understanding in multimodal videos with 1,000 annotated clips covering emotion transitions rather than static emotion recognition.

entry.title: Pref-CTRL: Preference Driven LLM Alignment using Representation Editing

author.name: Imranul Ashrafi, Inigo Jauregi Unanue, Massimo Piccardi

entry.summary: Proposes Pref-CTRL, a test-time alignment method that trains a multi-objective value function on preference pairs (rather than reward scores) to guide LLM generation via representation editing at inference time.

entry.title: FlowPlace: Flow Matching for Chip Placement

author.name: Peng Xie, Ke Xue, Yunqi Shi, Ruo-Tong Chen, Chengrui Gao, Siyuan Xu, Chenjian Ding, Mingxuan Yuan, Chao Qian

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPlace for chip placement using flow matching instead of diffusion models, with mask-guided synthetic data, flexible prior injection, and hard constraint sampling for overlap-free layouts. Claims 10-50x faster sampling.

entry.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Ashish Seth, Xinhao Mei, Changsheng Zhao, Varun Nagaraja, Ernie Chang, Gregory P. Meyer, Gael Le Lan, Yunyang Xiong, Vikas Chandra, Yangyang Shi, Dinesh Manocha, Zhipeng Cai

entry.summary: Presents a systematic evaluation framework for audio hallucinations in egocentric video understanding, showing that state-of-the-art audio-visual LLMs often infer sounds from visual cues rather than actually processing audio. Curates 300 videos with 1,000 targeted questions.

entry.title: Improving Robustness of Tabular Retrieval via Representational Stability

author.name: Kushal Raj Bhandari, Adarsh Singh, Jianxi Gao, Soham Dan, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Shows that semantically equivalent table serializations (csv, tsv, html, markdown) produce substantially different embeddings and retrieval results. Proposes centroid averaging across serializations as a canonical representation.

entry.title: Leveraging Human Feedback for Semantically-Relevant Skill Discovery

author.name: Maxence Hussonnois, Thommen George Karimpanal, Santu Rana

entry.summary: Proposes semantic labelling as a feedback-efficient alternative to preference-based approaches for human-guided skill discovery in RL. Leverages human cognitive strengths to identify and label distinct skill categories rather than comparing preferences.

entry.title: MEMCoder: Multi-dimensional Evolving Memory for Private-Library-Oriented Code Generation

author.name: Mofei Li, Taozhi Chen, Guowei Yang, Jia Li

entry.summary: Proposes MEMCoder, a framework enabling LLMs to autonomously accumulate and evolve usage guidelines for private library code generation. Addresses the knowledge gap when RAG provides only isolated API definitions without coordination patterns.

entry.title: See Further, Think Deeper: Advancing VLM's Reasoning Ability with Low-level Visual Cues and Reflection

author.name: Zhiheng Wu, Tong Wang, Shuning Wang, Naiming Liu, Yumeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ForeSight, a multimodal interleaved reasoning framework for VLMs that integrates low-level visual tools and mask-based visual feedback to address hallucination by encouraging visual fidelity.

entry.title: Less Is More: Engineering Challenges of On-Device Small Language Model Integration in a Mobile Application

author.name: William Oliveira

entry.summary: Documents a 5-day longitudinal case study of integrating on-device small language models (Gemma 4, Qwen3 0.6B) into a production Android game. Shows the journey from ambitious LLM-driven design to pragmatic hybrid architecture.

entry.title: Transformer Approximations from ReLUs

author.name: Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu, Mingcheng Lu, Yi-Chen Lee, Han Liu

entry.summary: Provides a systematic recipe for translating ReLU approximation results to softmax attention mechanisms, yielding target-specific resource bounds beyond universal approximation. Demonstrates on multiplication, reciprocal, and min/max primitives.

entry.title: DiRe-RAPIDS: Topology-faithful dimensionality reduction at scale

author.name: Alexander Kolpakov, Igor Rivin

entry.summary: Introduces DiRe-RAPIDS for topology-faithful dimensionality reduction, showing that UMAP/t-SNE can invent topological features. Proposes a topology-faithfulness benchmark and achieves 3-4x better topological preservation on 723K arXiv embeddings.

entry.title: Exploring Time Conditioning in Diffusion Generative Models from Disjoint Noisy Data Manifolds

author.name: Liuzhuozheng Li, Zhiyuan Zhan, Shuhong Liu, Dengyang Jiang, Zanyi Wang, Guang Dai, Jingdong Wang, Mengmeng Wang

entry.summary: Revisits time conditioning in diffusion models from a geometric perspective, showing noisy data distributions concentrate on hyper-cylinder-like manifolds that can become disjoint, explaining when time conditioning is necessary.

entry.title: MotionBricks: Scalable Real-Time Motions with Modular Latent Generative Model and Smart Primitives

author.name: Tingwu Wang, Olivier Dionne, Michael De Ruyter, David Minor, Davis Rempe, Kaifeng Zhao, Mathis Petrovich, Ye Yuan, Chenran Li, Zhengyi Luo, Brian Robison, Xavier Blackwell, Bernardo Antoniazzi, Xue Bin Peng, Yuke Zhu, Simon Yuen

entry.summary: Introduces MotionBricks, a modular latent generative model for real-time interactive motion control supporting velocity commands, style selection, and keyframe control. Scales to large motion repertoires for production use.

entry.title: Data-Driven Hamiltonian Reduction for Superconducting Qubits via Meta-Learning

author.name: Arielle Sanford, Andrew T. Kamen, Frederic T. Chong, Andy J. Goldschmidt

entry.summary: Introduces HAML, a meta-learning framework for fast online adaptation of effective Hamiltonian models of superconducting quantum processors. Learns reduction from full multi-mode Hamiltonians to effective qubit descriptions without perturbation theory.

entry.title: From Cursed to Competitive: Closing the ZO-FO Gap via Input-to-State Stability

author.name: Amir Ali Farzin, Philipp Braun, Iman Shames

entry.summary: Shows that under several conditions, zeroth-order optimization methods do not suffer extra dimension dependencies in convergence rates compared to first-order counterparts, using input-to-state stability analysis.

entry.title: Dynamic Decision Learning: Test-Time Evolution for Abnormality Grounding in Rare Diseases

author.name: Jun Li, Mingxuan Liu, Jiazhen Pan, Che Liu, Wenjia Bai, Cosmin I. Bercea, Julia A. Schnabel

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Decision Learning for rare disease abnormality grounding that enables frozen vision-language models to refine decisions at test time through instruction optimization and prediction consolidation under visual perturbations.

entry.title: Don\'t Stop Early: Scalable Enterprise Deep Research with Controlled Information Flow and Evidence-Aware Termination

author.name: Prafulla Kumar Choubey, Kung-Hsiang Huang, Pranav Narayanan Venkit, Jiaxin Zhang, Vaibhav Vats, Yu Li, Xiangyu Peng, Chien-Sheng Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Enterprise Deep Research architecture addressing premature stopping, context explosion, and uneven coverage through outline-driven decomposition, dependency-guided execution, and evidence-based completion criteria.

entry.title: What Makes Good Instruction-Tuning Data? An In-Context Learning Perspective

author.name: Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes instruction data selection based on weighted in-context influence (wICI), measuring how effectively each example reduces instruction-following difficulty for semantically related peers.

entry.title: CroSearch-R1: Better Leveraging Cross-lingual Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Rui Qi, Fengran Mo, Sijin Lu, Yufeng Chen, Jian-Yun Nie, Kaiyu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CroSearch-R1, integrating cross-lingual knowledge retrieval into GRPO reinforcement learning for RAG. Uses multi-turn retrieval with cross-lingual knowledge integration to dynamically align multilingual information.

entry.title: Do LLMs Capture Embodied Cognition and Cultural Variation? Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Demonstratives

author.name: Yu Wang, Emmanuele Chersoni, Chu-Ren Huang

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs acquire embodied cognition and cultural conventions by probing demonstrative expressions (this/that) across English and Chinese. Establishes a 6,400-response human baseline showing cross-linguistic differences, then finds five SOTA LLMs fail to capture proximal-distal contrasts and default to English-centric reasoning.

entry.title: M$^3$-VQA: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Entity, Multi-Hop Visual Question Answering

author.name: Jiatong Ma, Longteng Guo, Yuchen Liu, Zijia Zhao, Dongze Hao, Xuanxu Lin, Jing Liu

entry.summary: Presents M³-VQA, a knowledge-based VQA benchmark requiring multi-entity understanding and multi-hop reasoning across visual and textual sources. Evaluates 16 leading MLLMs and finds significant performance gaps.

entry.title: IAM: Identity-Aware Human Motion and Shape Joint Generation

author.name: Wenqi Jia, Zekun Li, Abhay Mittal, Chengcheng Tang, Chuan Guo, Lezi Wang, James Matthew Rehg, Lingling Tao, Size An

entry.summary: Proposes IAM, an identity-aware human motion generation framework that models the relationship between body morphology and motion dynamics. Uses learned identity representations rather than explicit geometric measurements.

entry.title: Beyond Fidelity: Semantic Similarity Assessment in Low-Level Image Processing

author.name: Runjie Wang, Weiling Chen, Tiesong Zhao, Chang Wen Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes 'Semantic Similarity' as a new evaluation task for low-level image processing, arguing that conventional Image Quality Assessment metrics are insufficient when generative models preserve perceptual quality but alter semantic content. Proposes a structured formulation based on semantic entities and relations.

entry.title: SAMe: A Semantic Anatomy Mapping Engine for Robotic Ultrasound

author.name: Jing Zhang, Duojie Chen, Wentao Jiang, Zihan Lou, Jianxin Liu, Xinwu Cui, Qinghong Zhao, Bo Du, Christoph F. Dietrich, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Presents SAMe, a semantic anatomy mapping engine for robotic ultrasound that provides anatomical understanding for scan planning. Grounds clinical complaints into structured target organs and creates patient-specific anatomical representations from a single body image.

entry.title: HANDFUL: Sequential Grasp-Conditioned Dexterous Manipulation with Resource Awareness

author.name: Ethan Foong, Yunshuang Li, Hao Jiang, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Daniel Seita

entry.summary: Introduces HANDFUL, a framework for sequential grasp-conditioned dexterous manipulation where the robot must execute multiple skills while maintaining previous grasps, modeling finger usage as a limited resource.

entry.title: ANCHOR: A Physically Grounded Closed-Loop Framework for Robust Home-Service Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Jinhao Jiang, Shengyu Fang, Sibo Zuo, Yujie Tang, Yirui Li

entry.summary: Presents ANCHOR, a closed-loop framework for home-service mobile manipulation addressing three failure modes: stale semantic maps, navigation endpoints infeasible for manipulation, and undifferentiated anomaly handling.

entry.title: The Price of Agreement: Measuring LLM Sycophancy in Agentic Financial Applications

author.name: Zhenyu Zhao, Aparna Balagopalan, Adi Agrawal, Dilshoda Yergasheva, Waseem Alshikh, Daniel M. Bikel

entry.summary: Studies sycophancy in LLMs deployed for agentic financial tasks, finding that models show only low-to-modest performance drops when users contradict correct answers, which differs from sycophancy patterns observed in general domains.

entry.title: Probing Visual Planning in Image Editing Models

author.name: Zhimu Zhou, Yanpeng Zhao, Qiuyu Liao, Bo Zhao, Xiaojian Ma

entry.summary: EAR reformulates visual planning as single-step image editing rather than step-by-step generation, and introduces AMAZE, a procedurally generated maze dataset for probing visual reasoning in image editing models.

entry.title: CAPSULE: Control-Theoretic Action Perturbations for Safe Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Rahul Narava, Siddharth Verma, Ojas Jain, Shashi Shekhar Jha, Mayank Shekhar Jha

entry.summary: Proposes CAPSULE, a safe RL framework that learns probabilistic control-affine dynamics offline and constructs control barrier functions incorporating model uncertainty for conservative safety guarantees during exploration.

entry.title: Hindsight Preference Optimization for Financial Time Series Advisory

author.name: Yanwei Cui, Guanghui Wang, Xing Zhang, Peiyang He, Ziyuan Li, Bing Zhu, Wei Qiu, Xusheng Wang, Zheng Yu, Anqi Xin

entry.summary: Proposes Hindsight Preference Optimization for financial time series advisory, using observed outcomes retrospectively to rank candidate advisories via LLM judge, creating preference pairs for DPO without human annotation.

entry.title: RAS: a Reliability Oriented Metric for Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Wenbin Huang, Yuhang Qiu, Bohan Li, Yiwei Guo, Jing Peng, Hankun Wang, Xie Chen, Kai Yu

entry.summary: Introduces RAS, a reliability-oriented ASR evaluation metric that balances informativeness and error aversion, alongside an abstention-aware framework that enables ASR models to explicitly abstain from uncertain segments.

entry.title: Global Context or Local Detail? Adaptive Visual Grounding for Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Yubo Jiang, Xin Yang, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Zheming Yuan, Xuxin Cheng, Fengying Xie, Zhiguo Jiang, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Haopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Positive-and-Negative Decoding (PND), a training-free inference framework that mitigates VLM hallucination by amplifying visual evidence through a positive path while degrading hallucinated content through a negative path.

entry.title: Unrequited Emotions: Investigating the Gaps in Motivation and Practice in Speech Emotion Recognition Research

author.name: Taryn Wong, Zeerak Talat, Hanan Aldarmaki, Anjalie Field

entry.summary: Systematic survey of speech emotion recognition (SER) research uncovering gaps between stated motivations (healthcare, voice systems) and actual practice (datasets don't reflect deployment contexts). Raises ethical concerns about task validity.

entry.title: The Thinking Pixel: Recursive Sparse Reasoning in Multimodal Diffusion Latents

author.name: Yuwei Sun, Yuxuan Yao, Hui Li, Siyu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a recursive sparse mixture-of-experts framework integrated into diffusion models for improved compositional text-to-image generation, using iterative refinement in joint attention layers.

entry.title: AI Identity: Standards, Gaps, and Research Directions for AI Agents

author.name: Takumi Otsuka, Kentaroh Toyoda, Alex Leung

entry.summary: Defines AI Identity as the relationship between declared and observed agent behavior, conducts gap analysis across the agent identity lifecycle, and proposes a structural model spanning identification, authentication, and accountability.

entry.title: Causal Discovery as Dialectical Aggregation: A Quantitative Argumentation Framework

author.name: Sheng Wei, Yulin Chen, Beishui Liao

entry.summary: Proposes QACD, a quantitative argumentation framework for causal discovery that represents conditional independence outcomes as graded defeasible arguments rather than irreversible constraints, improving robustness in finite-sample regimes.

entry.title: AgentPulse: A Continuous Multi-Signal Framework for Evaluating AI Agents in Deployment

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu

entry.summary: Introduces AgentPulse, a continuous evaluation framework scoring 50 AI agents across four factors (Benchmark Performance, Adoption Signals, Community Sentiment, Ecosystem Health) from 18 real-time signals.

entry.title: SemML 2.0: Synthesizing Controllers for LTL

author.name: Jan K\v{r}et\'insk\'y, Tobias Meggendorfer, Maximilian Prokop

entry.summary: Presents SemML 2.0, a tool for synthesizing reactive systems from LTL specifications that outperforms all state-of-the-art tools by combining classical automata-theoretic approaches with machine-learning guidance and partial exploration.

entry.title: Beyond the Attention Stability Boundary: Agentic Self-Synthesizing Reasoning Protocols

author.name: Dahlia Shehata, Ming Li

entry.summary: Identifies 'Attention Latch' as a failure mode in autoregressive transformers where historical context overrides mid-task updates, causing agents to anchor on obsolete constraints. Proposes Self-Synthesizing Reasoning Protocols (SSRP) as a metacognitive framework separating architectural planning from execution.

entry.title: Case-Specific Rubrics for Clinical AI Evaluation: Methodology, Validation, and LLM-Clinician Agreement Across 823 Encounters

author.name: Aaryan Shah, Andrew Hines, Alexia Downs, Denis Bajet, Paulius Mui, Fabiano Araujo, Laura Offutt, Aida Rutledge, Elizabeth Jimenez

entry.summary: Presents a methodology using case-specific clinician-authored rubrics for evaluating clinical AI documentation systems, validated across 823 encounters and showing LLM-generated rubrics can approximate clinician agreement at lower cost.

entry.title: PivotMerge: Bridging Heterogeneous Multimodal Pre-training via Post-Alignment Model Merging

author.name: Zibo Shao, Baochen Xiong, Xiaoshan Yang, Yaguang Song, Qimeng Zhang, Haifeng Chen, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: PivotMerge addresses model merging for multimodal pre-training, introducing a post-alignment merging task that integrates cross-modal alignment capabilities from multiple expert MLLMs into a unified model.

entry.title: Towards Understanding the Expressive Power of GNNs with Global Readout

author.name: Maurice Funk, Daumantas Kojelis

entry.summary: Studies the expressive power of message-passing GNNs with global readout, showing that sum aggregation suffices to capture first-order properties beyond C² logic, and identifying conditions for restoring characterizability.

entry.title: Citation-Driven Multi-View Training for Patent Embeddings: QaECTER and Sophia-Bench

author.name: Younes Djemmal (ALMAnaCH), You Zuo (ALMAnaCH), Kim Gerdes (LISN, Qatent), Kirian Guiller

entry.summary: Introduces Sophia-bench, a large-scale patent retrieval benchmark with 10K queries across 12 query types and 8 technology sections, plus QaECTER, a citation-driven multi-view training approach for patent embeddings.

entry.title: UpstreamQA: A Modular Framework for Explicit Reasoning on Video Question Answering Tasks

author.name: Jason Nguyen, Ameet Rao, Alexander Chang, Ishaan Kumar, Erin Tan

entry.summary: Proposes UpstreamQA, a modular framework for Video QA that disentangles spatial, temporal, and linguistic reasoning into explicit upstream modules, enabling interpretable evaluation of video reasoning components.

entry.title: Small Language Model Helps Resolve Semantic Ambiguity of LLM Prompt

author.name: Zhenzhen Huang, Chaoning Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Jiaquan Zhang, Yitian Zhou, Shuxu Chen, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes using a small language model to resolve semantic ambiguity in user prompts before LLM inference, performing explicit prompt disambiguation as a pre-processing step.

entry.title: CombiMOTS: Combinatorial Multi-Objective Tree Search for Dual-Target Molecule Generation

author.name: Thibaud Southiratn, Bonil Koo, Yijingxiu Lu, Sun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CombiMOTS for dual-target molecule generation using combinatorial multi-objective tree search that captures trade-offs between target engagement and integrates synthetic planning into the generative process.

entry.title: A Taxonomy and Resolution Strategy for Client-Level Disagreements in Federated Learning

author.name: Daan Rosendal, Ana Oprescu

entry.summary: Introduces a taxonomy of client-level disagreements in federated learning and proposes a multi-track resolution strategy that guarantees strict client exclusion through isolated model update paths.

entry.title: Hybrid JIT-CUDA Graph Optimization for Low-Latency Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Divakar Kumar Yadav, Tian Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid JIT-CUDA Graph framework that partitions LLM inference into static (CUDA Graph replay) and dynamic (JIT-compiled) components to reduce launch overhead during autoregressive decoding.

entry.title: DLM: Unified Decision Language Models for Offline Multi-Agent Sequential Decision Making

author.name: Zhuohui Zhang, Bin Cheng, Bin He

entry.summary: Proposes Decision Language Model (DLM), formulating multi-agent decision making as dialogue-style sequence prediction. Uses two-stage training (SFT + RL fine-tuning) under centralized training/decentralized execution paradigm.

entry.title: Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)

author.name: Nicola Zanarini, Niccol\`o Ferrari

entry.summary: Proposes Graph Memory Transformer (GMT) that replaces the FFN in decoder-only transformers with an explicit learned memory graph of centroids connected by directed transition matrices, with gravitational routing.

entry.title: Quantum Knowledge Graph: Modeling Context-Dependent Triplet Validity

author.name: Yao Wang, Zixu Geng, Jun Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Quantum Knowledge Graphs (QKG) where triplet validity depends on context (like patient demographics in medicine), instantiated with a diabetes-centered medical KG with 68,651 context-sensitive relations.

entry.title: FreeScale: Distributed Training for Sequence Recommendation Models with Minimal Scaling Cost

author.name: Chenhao Feng, Haoli Zhang, Shakhzod Ali-Zade, Yanli Zhao, Liang Luo, Jennifer Cao, Lisen Deng, Siqiao Chen, Chenyu Zhao, Tristan Rice, Daniel Johnson, Min Si, Tiantu Xu, Yi Zhang, Siqi Yan, Chuanhao Zhuge, Min Ni, Bi Xue, Qunshu Zhang, Shen Li

entry.summary: Introduces FreeScale for distributed training of recommendation models, addressing computational underutilization through load balancing, overlapped communications, and GPU resource optimization.

entry.title: Speech Enhancement Based on Drifting Models

author.name: Liang Xu, Diego Caviedes-Nozal, Bastiaan Kleijn, Longfei Felix Yan, Rasmus Kongsgaard Olsson

entry.summary: Proposes DriftSE, a generative speech enhancement framework using drifting models that achieves one-step inference by evolving pushforward distributions to match clean speech. Supports training on unpaired data.

entry.title: SycoPhantasy: Quantifying Sycophancy and Hallucination in Small Open Weight VLMs for Vision-Language Scoring of Fantasy Characters

author.name: Arya Shah, Deepali Mishra, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Introduces the Bluffing Coefficient metric to quantify sycophantic behavior in VLMs when scoring image-text alignment. Evaluates six open-weight VLMs on 173K AI-generated character portraits.

entry.title: GAMMAF: A Common Framework for Graph-Based Anomaly Monitoring Benchmarking in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Pablo Mateo-Torrej\'on, Alfonso S\'anchez-Maci\'an

entry.summary: Introduces GAMMAF, an open-source benchmarking platform for graph-based anomaly detection in LLM multi-agent systems. Provides standardized environment rather than a novel defense mechanism.

entry.title: Aligned Multi-View Scripts for Universal Chart-to-Code Generation

author.name: Zhihan Zhang, Lizi Liao

entry.summary: Introduces Chart2NCode, a dataset of 176K charts with aligned scripts in Python, R, and LaTeX, and CharLuMA, a parameter-efficient module for universal chart-to-code generation across plotting languages.

entry.title: Meta-CoT: Enhancing Granularity and Generalization in Image Editing

author.name: Shiyi Zhang, Yiji Cheng, Tiankai Hang, Zijin Yin, Runze He, Yu Xu, Wenxun Dai, Yunlong Lin, Chunyu Wang, Qinglin Lu, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-CoT for image editing that decomposes editing operations into triplets (task, target, required understanding ability) and generates task-specific chain-of-thought for improved granularity and generalization.

entry.title: Information bottleneck for learning the phase space of dynamics from high-dimensional experimental data

author.name: K. Michael Martini, Eslam Abdelaleem, Paarth Gulati, Ilya Nemenman

entry.summary: Introduces DySIB (Dynamical Symmetric Information Bottleneck) for learning low-dimensional representations of time-series data by maximizing predictive mutual information between past and future observations while penalizing complexity.

entry.title: Intrinsic Mutual Information as a Modulator for Preference Optimization

author.name: Peng Liao, Peijia Zheng, Lingbo Li, Shangsong Liang, Lin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RMiPO, a framework that uses intrinsic response-level mutual information to dynamically modulate hyperparameters in offline preference optimization for LLMs. Aims to reduce reliance on manual hyperparameter tuning in methods like DPO.

entry.title: PolyKV: A Shared Asymmetrically-Compressed KV Cache Pool for Multi-Agent LLM Inference

author.name: Ishan Patel, Ishan Joshi

entry.summary: Presents PolyKV, a system where multiple concurrent LLM inference agents share a single asymmetrically compressed KV cache pool, using int8 keys and 3-bit values with FWHT rotation. Achieves significant memory savings with multi-agent serving.

entry.title: Prior-Aligned Data Cleaning for Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Laure Berti-Equille

entry.summary: Introduces L2C2, the first deep RL framework for data cleaning of tabular foundation models, addressing the prior mismatch between clean synthetic pre-training data and noisy real-world inputs.

entry.title: Safe-Support Q-Learning: Learning without Unsafe Exploration

author.name: Yeeun Lim, Narim Jeong, Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Safe-Support Q-Learning that eliminates unsafe state visitation during RL training by constraining exploration to a safe set via behavior policy. Uses two-stage framework with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Dyna-Style Safety Augmented Reinforcement Learning: Staying Safe in the Face of Uncertainty

author.name: Artur Eisele, Bernd Frauenknecht, Friedrich Solowjow, Sebastian Trimpe

entry.summary: Proposes Dyna-SAuR, combining a learned uncertainty-aware dynamics model with a safety filter for safe RL exploration. The filter avoids both failure states and high-uncertainty regions.

entry.title: Uncovering Exotic Paired States in the 2D Spin-Imbalanced Fermi Gas with Neural Wave Functions

author.name: Wan Tong Lou, Gino Cassella, Andres Perez Fadon, Halvard Sutterud, David Pfau, James S. Spencer, Johannes Knolle, W. M. C. Foulkes

entry.summary: Uses neural network variational Monte Carlo (FermiNet) to study the phase diagram of 2D spin-imbalanced Fermi gas, observing exotic paired states like FFLO phase and phase separation. Demonstrates AI-for-science approach to condensed matter physics.

entry.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Probabilistic Downscaling of Maximum 3-day Snowfall in Alaska

author.name: Douglas Brinkerhoff, Elizabeth Fischer

entry.summary: Presents WxFlow, a conditional flow matching model for probabilistic downscaling of climate model output to fine-scale snowfall in Alaska. Produces calibrated probabilistic ensembles at 4km resolution at a fraction of WRF computational cost.

entry.title: ADE: Adaptive Dictionary Embeddings -- Scaling Multi-Anchor Representations to Large Language Models

author.name: Orhan Demirci, Sezer Aptourachman

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Dictionary Embeddings (ADE) that scale multi-anchor word representations to large language models, representing polysemous words as combinations of multiple vectors with efficient Vocabulary Projection.

entry.title: FAMA: Failure-Aware Meta-Agentic Framework for Open-Source LLMs in Interactive Tool Use Environments

author.name: Amir Saeidi, Venkatesh Mishra, Souradeep Mukhopadhyay, Gaowen Liu, Ali Payani, Jayanth Srinivasa, Chitta Baral

entry.summary: Presents FAMA, a failure-aware meta-agentic framework for open-source LLMs in interactive tool use. Analyzes failure trajectories from baseline agents and uses meta-agent guidance to reduce cascading errors.

entry.title: The Structured Output Benchmark: A Multi-Source Benchmark for Evaluating Structured Output Quality in Large Language Models

author.name: Abhinav Kumar Singh, Harsha Vardhan Khurdula, Yoeven D Khemlani, Vineet Agarwal

entry.summary: Introduces SOB, a multi-source benchmark for evaluating LLM structured output quality across text, image, and audio sources. Isolates structured-output capability from raw modality processing by providing text-normalized inputs.

entry.title: DV-World: Benchmarking Data Visualization Agents in Real-World Scenarios

author.name: Jinxiang Meng, Shaoping Huang, Fangyu Lei, Jingyu Guo, Haoxiang Liu, Jiahao Su, Sihan Wang, Yao Wang, Enrui Wang, Ye Yang, Hongze Chai, Jinming Lv, Anbang Yu, Huangjing Zhang, Yitong Zhang, Yiming Huang, Zeyao Ma, Shizhu He, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DV-World, a benchmark of 260 tasks for evaluating data visualization agents across real-world professional lifecycles including spreadsheet manipulation, cross-platform evolution, and interactive intent alignment with user simulators.

entry.title: Leverage Laws: A Per-Task Framework for Human-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Stan Loosmore

entry.summary: Proposes a per-task leverage ratio framework for human-agent collaboration, decomposing the denominator into specification, interrupt resolution, and review costs. Analyzes information flow bounds and scaling behavior.

entry.title: ESICA: A Scalable Framework for Text-Guided 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yu Xin, Gorkem Can Ates, Jun Ma, Sumin Kim, Ying Zhang, Kaleb E Smith, Kuang Gong, Wei Shao

entry.summary: Proposes ESICA, a lightweight framework for text-guided 3D medical image segmentation using similarity matrix-based mask prediction and efficient decomposed decoder for enhanced semantic alignment with natural language descriptions.

entry.title: SaliencyDecor: Enhancing Neural Network Interpretability through Feature Decorrelation

author.name: Ali Karkehabadi, Jamshid Hassanpour, Houman Homayoun, Avesta Sasan

entry.summary: Proposes SaliencyDecor, a training framework that enforces feature decorrelation to improve gradient-based saliency map quality without modifying saliency methods or model architectures.

entry.title: Leveraging Previous-Traversal Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Tracking

author.name: Markus K\"appeler, \"Ozg\"un \c{C}i\c{c}ek, Yakov Miron, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes DualViewMapDet, a camera-only 3D object detection framework for autonomous driving that leverages static point cloud maps from prior traversals to compensate for the absence of LiDAR at inference time. Uses a dual-space camera-map fusion strategy.

entry.title: Vision SmolMamba: Spike-Guided Token Pruning for Energy-Efficient Spiking State-Space Vision Models

author.name: Dewei Bai, Hongxiang Peng, Yunyun Zeng, Ziyu Zhang, Hong Qu, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Vision SmolMamba, a spiking neural network architecture combining spike-driven dynamics with linear-time state-space models. Features a Spike-Guided Token Pruner that uses spike activation strength and first-spike latency for progressive token pruning.

entry.title: Refinement via Regeneration: Enlarging Modification Space Boosts Image Refinement in Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Jiayi Guo, Linqing Wang, Jiangshan Wang, Yang Yue, Zeyu Liu, Zhiyuan Zhao, Qinglin Lu, Gao Huang, Chunyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a 'refinement via regeneration' paradigm for unified multimodal models in text-to-image tasks, arguing that current editing-based refinement approaches are limited by coarse instructions and pixel-level preservation constraints. Regeneration enlarges the modification space.

entry.title: PhyloSDF: Phylogenetically-Conditioned Neural Generation of 3D Skull Morphology via Residual Flow Matching

author.name: Kaikwan Lau, Gary P. T. Choi

entry.summary: Presents PhyloSDF, a phylogenetically-conditioned neural generative model for 3D biological morphology (skulls) that structures latent space to correlate with evolutionary distances and uses residual flow matching for generation.

entry.title: Is AI welfare work puntable?

author.name: Oscar

entry.summary: Argues against delaying AI welfare work until after an intelligence explosion, citing risks of early value lock-in, persistent multipolarity, and path dependency. Recommends prioritizing strategy and policy work over technical philosophical research.

entry.title: Latent reasoning models might be a good thing?

author.name: loops

entry.summary: Argues that latent reasoning models (LRMs), which perform chain-of-thought in the model's latent space rather than in text, might be better for interpretability and safety than text-based reasoning models. The key argument is that direct CoT interpretation will eventually fail at scale anyway, and LRM activations compress whole thoughts into single tokens which may be more amenable to mechanistic interpretability.

entry.title: RedParrot: Accelerating NL-to-DSL for Business Analytics via Query Semantic Caching

author.name: Tong Wang, Yongqin Xu, Jianfeng Zhang, Lingxi Cui, Wenqing Wei, Suzhou Chen, Huan Li, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou

entry.summary: RedParrot from Xiaohongshu accelerates natural language to domain-specific language conversion for business analytics through semantic query caching, exploiting the high repetition in enterprise user queries to bypass costly multi-stage LLM pipelines.

entry.title: Implicit Humanization in Everyday LLM Moral Judgments

author.name: Hoda Ayad, Tanu Mitra

entry.summary: Examines how LLMs handle implicit humanization in moral judgment queries (e.g., 'who was wrong?'), finding that current models reinforce anthropomorphic assumptions in their responses through linguistic, behavioral, and cognitive cues.

entry.title: SwarmDrive: Semantic V2V Coordination for Latency-Constrained Cooperative Autonomous Driving

author.name: Anjie Qiu, Donglin Wang, Zexin Fang, Sanket Partani, Hans D. Schotten

entry.summary: SwarmDrive is a V2V coordination framework for autonomous driving where nearby vehicles run local small language models and share compact intent distributions through event-triggered consensus, achieving 94.1% success vs 68.9% for single-model approaches.

entry.title: Hard to See, Hard to Label: Generative and Symbolic Acquisition for Subtle Visual Phenomena

author.name: Renjith Prasad, Rishabh Sharma, Andrew E. Shao, Annmary Justine Koomthanam, Shreyas Kulkarni, Suparna Bhattacharya, Martin Foltin, Amit Sheth, David Orozco, Matthew Quinn, Brian Sammuli

entry.summary: Proposes GSAL, an active learning framework for detecting subtle visual anomalies (hairline cracks, sub-millimeter voids) combining diffusion-based difficulty signals with hierarchical acquisition for industrial defect inspection.

entry.title: MetaErr: Towards Predicting Error Patterns in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Varun Totakura, Shayok Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes MetaErr, a meta-model framework that predicts when deep neural networks will fail on specific inputs, training on features of the base model's behavior to anticipate errors.

entry.title: RaV-IDP: A Reconstruction-as-Validation Framework for Faithful Intelligent Document Processing

author.name: Pritesh Jha

entry.summary: Proposes Reconstruction-as-Validation (RaV-IDP) for document processing, where extracted entities are validated by attempting to reconstruct the original document, providing an intrinsic fidelity check for RAG and knowledge base pipelines.

entry.title: Risk-Aware Robust Learning: Reducing Clinical Risk under Label Noise in Medical Image Classification

author.name: Maycon R. S. Pereira, Filipe R. Cordeiro

entry.summary: Investigates whether noise-robust training methods preserve clinical safety under label noise in medical imaging, showing that methods optimized for accuracy may increase clinically dangerous false negatives.

entry.title: An Investigation of Linguistic Biases in LLM-Based Recommendations

author.name: Nitin Venkateswaran, Jason Ang, Deep Adhikari, Tarun Krishna Dasari

entry.summary: Investigates linguistic biases in LLM-based recommendation systems when prompts use different English dialects (Southern American, Indian English, Code-Switched Hindi-English). Examines whether dialect variation leads to systematically different recommendations.

entry.title: Interactive Episodic Memory with User Feedback

author.name: Nikesh Subedi, Loris Bazzani, Ziad Al-Halah

entry.summary: Introduces EM-QnF task for episodic memory with interactive feedback, where users can refine queries based on model predictions for egocentric video search, addressing limitations of one-shot retrieval setups.

entry.title: Governing What You Cannot Observe: Adaptive Runtime Governance for Autonomous AI Agents

author.name: German Marin, Jatin Chaudhary

entry.summary: Proposes the Agent Viability Framework grounded in Aubin's viability theory for governing autonomous AI agents, formalizing monitoring, anticipation, and monotonic restriction as necessary and sufficient properties, instantiated as RiskGate.

entry.title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Truly Understand Small Objects?

author.name: Fujun Han, Junan Chen, Xintong Zhu, Jingqi Ye, Xuanjie Mao, Tao Chen, Peng Ye

entry.summary: SOUBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on small object understanding across driving, aerial, and underwater scenarios, with 18,204 VQA pairs revealing significant gaps in current models.

entry.title: Fix Initial Codes and Iteratively Refine Textual Directions Toward Safe Multi-Turn Code Correction

author.name: Yuto Tanaka, Issei Sato

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative Refinement of Textual Directions (IRTD), a simpler alternative to Scattered Forest Search for multi-turn code correction. Establishes theoretical safety guarantees using Oracle-Guided Inductive Synthesis.

entry.title: DouC: Dual-Branch CLIP for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Mohamad Zamini, Diksha Shukla

entry.summary: Proposes DouC, a training-free dual-branch CLIP framework for open-vocabulary segmentation that decomposes prediction into token-gated patch reliability (OG-CLIP) and structure-prior injection (FADE-CLIP) branches.

entry.title: Combating Visual Neglect and Semantic Drift in Large Multimodal Models for Enhanced Cross-Modal Retrieval

author.name: Guosheng Zhang, Linkai Liu, Keyao Wang, Haixiao Yue, Zhiwen Tan, Xiao Tan

entry.summary: Proposes Salient Subject-Aware approach to combat visual neglect and semantic drift in Large Multimodal Models for cross-modal retrieval, adding subject-level semantic alignment beyond sample-level contrastive learning.

entry.title: HuM-Eval: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Human-Centric Video Evaluation

author.name: Bingzi Zhang, Kaisi Guan, Ruihua Song

entry.summary: Proposes HuM-Eval, a coarse-to-fine evaluation framework for human-centric video generation using VLMs for global quality assessment and 2D pose for anatomical correctness.

entry.title: AdaMamba: Adaptive Frequency-Gated Mamba for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xudong Jiang, Mingshan Loo, Hanchen Yang, Wengen Li, Mingrui Zhang, Yichao Zhang, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes AdaMamba, combining frequency-domain analysis with Mamba state-space models for long-term time series forecasting. Addresses cross-domain heterogeneity where variables differ in frequency domain despite time-domain synchronization.

entry.title: Expert Evaluation of LLM's Open-Ended Legal Reasoning on the Japanese Bar Exam Writing Task

author.name: Jungmin Choi, Keisuke Sakaguchi, Hiroaki Yamada

entry.summary: First dataset for evaluating LLM open-ended legal reasoning on Japanese bar exam writing tasks. Expert evaluation reveals LLMs can identify legal issues but struggle with structured legal argumentation in Japanese context.

entry.title: An empirical evaluation of the risks of AI model updates using clinical data: stability, arbitrariness, and fairness

author.name: Ioannis Bilionis, Ricardo C. Berrios, Luis Fernandez-Luque, Carlos Castillo

entry.summary: Evaluates risks of AI model updates in clinical settings using diabetes CGM data, proposing a monitoring framework for stability, arbitrariness, and fairness when models are retrained with new data.

entry.title: Right-to-Act: A Pre-Execution Non-Compensatory Decision Protocol for AI Systems

author.name: Gadi Lavi

entry.summary: Introduces the Right-to-Act protocol, a deterministic non-compensatory pre-execution decision layer that evaluates whether AI-generated decisions are permitted to be executed at all, enforcing strict structural constraints.

entry.title: PhysNote: Self-Knowledge Notes for Evolvable Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Model

author.name: Sinin Zhang, Yunfei Xie, Yuxuan Cheng, Haoyu Zhang, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: PhysNote proposes an agentic framework enabling vision-language models to externalize and refine physical reasoning knowledge through self-generated notes. It addresses spatio-temporal identity drift and volatility of inference-time insights that cause VLMs to fail on dynamic real-world physics scenarios.

entry.title: When VLMs 'Fix' Students: Identifying and Penalizing Over-Correction in the Evaluation of Multi-line Handwritten Math OCR

author.name: Jin Seong, Wencke Liermann, Minho Kim, Jong-hun Shin, Soojong Lim

entry.summary: Reveals that VLMs used for handwritten math OCR tend to 'fix' student errors rather than faithfully transcribing them, which is problematic for educational assessment. Proposes PINK, a metric penalizing over-correction in multi-line math OCR.

entry.title: Neural Network Optimization Reimagined: Decoupled Techniques for Scratch and Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xin Ning, Qiankun Li, Xiaolong Huang, Qiupu Chen, Feng He, Weijun Li, Prayag Tiwari, Xinwang Liu

entry.summary: DualOpt proposes decoupled optimization techniques for training from scratch (layer-wise weight decay) versus fine-tuning pre-trained models, recognizing that these paradigms have different optimization requirements.

entry.title: Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Factual Queries

author.name: Miao Xie, Xiao Zhang, Yi Li, Chunli Lv

entry.summary: Proposes structure-guided RAG that explicitly incorporates structural information for factual queries, introducing the Exact Retrieval Problem (ERP) to ensure all query conditions are satisfied rather than relying solely on vector similarity.

entry.title: MTServe: Efficient Serving for Generative Recommendation Models with Hierarchical Caches

author.name: Xin Wang, Chi Ma, Shaobin Chen, Pu Wang, Menglei Zhou, Junyi Qiu, Qiaorui Chen, Jiayu Sun, Shijie Liu, Zehuan Wang, Lei Yu, Chuan Liu, Fei Jiang, Wei Lin, Hao Wang, Jiawei Jiang, Xiao Yan

entry.summary: MTServe manages hierarchical KV caches for generative recommendation, virtualizing GPU memory with host RAM as backup and introducing hybrid storage, async transfer, and locality-driven replacement to bridge the I/O gap.

entry.title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs

author.name: Minghui Xu, Qi Luo, Kun Li

entry.summary: Presents a dynamic data valuation framework for LLM training data that operates at token-level using Shannon entropy, influence functions, and Data Shapley values, with cryptographic verifiability via Merkle trees. Moves beyond simple row-count pricing to utility-based data pricing.

entry.title: AmaraSpatial-10K: A Spatially and Semantically Aligned 3D Dataset for Spatial Computing and Embodied AI

author.name: Mohammad Sadegh Salehi, Alex Perkins, Igor Maurell, Ashkan Dabbagh, Raymond Wong

entry.summary: Presents AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of 10,000+ deployment-ready synthetic 3D assets with standardized metrics, PBR materials, collision hulls, and metadata for embodied AI, robotics, and AR/VR applications.

entry.title: Toward Polymorphic Backdoor against Semantic Communication via Intensity-Based Poisoning

author.name: Xiao Yang, Yuni Lai, Gaolei Li, Jun Wu, Kai Zhou, Jianhua Li, Mingzhe Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SemBugger, a polymorphic backdoor attack on semantic communication systems that dynamically adjusts trigger intensity to produce diverse malicious outputs through multi-effect poisoning.

entry.title: Why Architecture Choice Matters in Symbolic Regression

author.name: Chakshu Gupta

entry.summary: Demonstrates that architecture choice (tree structure) in symbolic regression significantly affects which targets can be recovered, with expressiveness alone being insufficient - the optimization landscape matters.

entry.title: Lightweight and Production-Ready PDF Visual Element Parsing

author.name: Meizhu Liu, Yassi Abbasi, Matthew Rowe, Michael Avendi, Paul Li

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight, production-ready PDF parsing framework for extracting visual elements (figures, tables, forms) and associating captions using spatial heuristics and semantic similarity for multimodal RAG.

entry.title: Nonlinear Non-Gaussian Density Steering with Input and Noise Channel Mismatch: Sinkhorn with Memory for Solving the Control-affine Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge Problem

author.name: Georgiy A. Bondar, Asmaa Eldesoukey, Yongxin Chen, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Extends Sinkhorn recursion for control-affine Schrödinger bridge problems where control and noise channels don't match, proposing 'Sinkhorn with memory' for nonlinear non-Gaussian density steering.

entry.title: From Rights to Rites: Expectations Management in Smart-Home AI

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Ivan Flechais, Marina Jirotka, Nigel Shadbolt

entry.summary: Based on 33 interviews with practitioners at Amazon Alexa, Microsoft Azure IoT, and Google Nest, develops 'Expectations Management' model describing how smart-home AI practitioners shape, calibrate, and repair user expectations.

entry.title: Scalable Production Scheduling: Linear Complexity via Unified Homogeneous Graphs

author.name: Jonathan Hoss, Moritz Link, Noah Klarmann

entry.summary: Introduces a unified homogeneous graph framework for job shop scheduling that projects heterogeneous node types into a shared latent space, enabling linear-complexity graph processing with standard GIN instead of quadratic heterogeneous layers.

entry.title: Constraint-Guided Multi-Agent Decompilation for Executable Binary Recovery

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Xiaohan Wang, Yueke Zhang, Kevin Leach

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent framework for decompilation that transforms compiled binaries back into re-executable source code using hierarchical validation (syntactic, compilability, behavioral) with LLM-based iterative refinement.

entry.title: What Did They Mean? How LLMs Resolve Ambiguous Social Situations across Perspectives and Roles

author.name: Qiming Yuan, Linyi Han, Nam Ling, Cihan Ruan

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs interpret ambiguous social situations across four domains, finding that 87.5% of responses produce interpretive closure rather than preserving uncertainty, with only 12.5% genuinely maintaining ambiguity.

entry.title: Distilling Self-Consistency into Verbal Confidence: A Pre-Registered Negative Result and Post-Hoc Rescue on Gemma 3 4B

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Pre-registered study on distilling self-consistency into verbal confidence for Gemma 3 4B. Phase 0 was a negative result; an exploratory rescue produced a binary discriminator with AUROC2=0.77 but failed as a calibrated confidence reporter.

entry.title: MultiDx: A Multi-Source Knowledge Integration Framework towards Diagnostic Reasoning

author.name: Yimin Deng, Zhenxi Lin, Yejing Wang, Guoshuai Zhao, Pengyue Jia, Zichuan Fu, Derong Xu, Yefeng Zheng, Xiangyu Zhao, Li Zhu, Xian Wu, Xueming Qian

entry.summary: Proposes MultiDx, a two-stage diagnostic reasoning framework that integrates multi-source knowledge for clinical differential diagnosis. Addresses alignment with standard clinical reasoning trajectories, not just prediction accuracy.

entry.title: RefEvo: Agentic Design with Co-Evolutionary Verification for Agile Reference Model Generation

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Jianmin Ye, Jiahao Yang, Xi Wang

entry.summary: Presents RefEvo, an agentic framework for generating SystemC reference models for SoC design using LLMs with co-evolutionary verification. Addresses coupled validation failures where testbenches incorrectly validate flawed models.

entry.title: Unconstrained Multi-view Human Pose Estimation with Algebraic Priors

author.name: Xiaolin Qin, Qianlei Wang, Jiacen Liu, Chaoning Zhang, Fei Zhu, Zhang Yi

entry.summary: Proposes an unconstrained multi-view human pose estimation framework that works without camera calibration by reformulating triangulation as a data-driven token fusion process with algebraic priors.

entry.title: Measuring Successful Cooperation in Human-AI Teamwork: Development and Validation of the Perceived Cooperativity and Teaming Perception Scales

author.name: Christiane Attig, Christiane Wiebel-Herboth, Patricia Wollstadt, Tim Schrills, Mourad Zoubir, Thomas Franke

entry.summary: Introduces two validated scales for measuring human-AI cooperation quality: the Perceived Cooperativity Scale (PCS) grounded in joint activity theory and the Teaming Perception Scale (TPS) grounded in evolutionary cooperation theory.

entry.title: Quantum Kernel Advantage over Classical Collapse in Medical Foundation Model Embeddings

author.name: Sebastian Cajas Ord\'o\~nez, Felipe Ocampo Osorio, Dax Enshan Koh, Rafi Al Attrach, Aldo Marzullo, Ariel Guerra-Adames, J. Alejandro Andrade, Siong Thye Goh, Chi-Yu Chen, Rahul Gorijavolu, Xue Yang, Noah Dane Hebdon, Leo Anthony Celi

entry.summary: Claims quantum kernel advantage in binary medical image classification using QSVM with frozen embeddings from medical foundation models. Shows classical linear SVM collapses to majority-class prediction while QSVM maintains non-trivial recall.

entry.title: Defective Task Descriptions in LLM-Based Code Generation: Detection and Analysis

author.name: Amal Akli, Mike Papadakis, Maxime Cordy, Yves Le Traon

entry.summary: Develops SpecValidator, a lightweight classifier to detect defective task descriptions (lexical vagueness, under-specification, syntax-formatting) in LLM code generation inputs. Achieves F1=0.804.

entry.title: minAction.net: Energy-First Neural Architecture Design -- From Biological Principles to Systematic Validation

author.name: Martin G. Frasch

entry.summary: Evaluates energy-aware learning across 2,203 experiments spanning vision, text, neuromorphic, and physiological datasets, finding that architecture alone explains negligible variance in accuracy but architecture-dataset interaction is large. Proposes biologically-inspired energy constraints for neural network design.

entry.title: Zero Shot Coordination for Sparse Reward Tasks with Diverse Reward Shapings

author.name: Keenan Powell, Peihong Yu, Pratap Tokekar

entry.summary: Addresses zero-shot coordination in multi-agent RL where agents may use different reward shaping despite identical sparse objectives. Proposes methods to train agents robust to diverse reward shapings.

entry.title: Shearlet Neural Operators for Anisotropic-Shock-Dominated and Multi-scale parametric partial differential equations

author.name: Fabio Pereira dos Santos, Julio de Castro Vargas Fernandes, Adriano Mauricio de Almeida Cortes

entry.summary: Introduces Shearlet Neural Operator (SNO) that replaces Fourier transforms with shearlet representations for learning PDE solution operators, better handling anisotropic structures and sharp gradients.

entry.title: FED-FSTQ: Fisher-Guided Token Quantization for Communication-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs on Edge Devices

author.name: Changyu Li, Shuanghong Huang, Jiashen Liu, Ming Lei, Jidu Xing, Kaishun Wu, Lu Wang, Fei Luo

entry.summary: Proposes FED-FSTQ, using Fisher information to guide token-level quantization for communication-efficient federated LLM fine-tuning on edge devices, preserving task-critical signals under non-IID conditions.

entry.title: VISION-SLS: Safe Perception-Based Control from Learned Visual Representations via System Level Synthesis

author.name: Antoine P. Leeman, Shuyu Zhan, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Glen Chou

entry.summary: Proposes VISION-SLS, a method for image-based nonlinear control with robust constraint satisfaction guarantees. Combines learned visual representations with system-level synthesis for scalable visuomotor control with formal guarantees.
