entry.title: Variational Neural Belief Parameterizations for Robust Dexterous Grasping under Multimodal Uncertainty

author.name: Clinton Enwerem, Shreya Kalyanaraman, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Formulates grasp acquisition as variational inference over latent contact parameters and object pose, using differentiable Gaussian mixture beliefs with Gumbel-Softmax for risk-sensitive dexterous grasping.

entry.title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: A Green Compression Pipeline for Overgrown Language Models

author.name: Ajmain Inqiad Alam, Palash Roy, Chanchal K. Roy, Banani Roy, Kevin A. Schneider

entry.summary: Introduces Carbon-Taxed Transformers, a systematic multi-stage compression pipeline for LLMs that treats efficiency and environmental cost as first-class design constraints, combining multiple compression techniques.

entry.title: Independent-Component-Based Encoding Models of Brain Activity During Story Comprehension

author.name: Kamya Hari, Taha Binhuraib, Jin Li, Cory Shain, Anna A. Ivanova

entry.summary: Proposes independent component-based encoding models for fMRI data during story listening, separating stimulus-driven from noise signals. Trains encoding models on ICs using LLM representations as predictors of neural activity.

entry.title: LongSumEval: Question-Answering Based Evaluation and Feedback-Driven Refinement for Long Document Summarization

author.name: Huyen Nguyen, Haoxuan Zhang, Yang Zhang, Haihua Chen, Junhua Ding

entry.summary: Introduces LongSumEval, a framework bridging evaluation and generation for long document summarization through structured QA feedback that identifies coverage gaps and factual inconsistencies.

entry.title: Scaling Probabilistic Transformer via Efficient Cross-Scale Hyperparameter Transfer

author.name: Penghao Kuang, Haoyi Wu, Kewei Tu

entry.summary: Applies Maximal Update Parametrization (muP) to Probabilistic Transformers to enable hyperparameter transfer from small to large models, scaling PT to 0.4B parameters. This addresses a key scalability bottleneck for white-box probabilistic language models. Results show PT consistently outperforms standard transformers at this scale.

entry.title: Praxy Voice: Voice-Prompt Recovery + BUPS for Commercial-Class Indic TTS from a Frozen Non-Indic Base at Zero Commercial-Training-Data Cost

author.name: Venkata Pushpak Teja Menta

entry.summary: Proposes Praxy Voice, combining BUPS (Brahmic Unified Phoneme Space) romanization with LoRA adaptation to bring a non-Indic TTS base (Chatterbox) to commercial-class quality on Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi without training a new decoder or using commercial TTS data.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Remote Sensing: Technical Challenges and Research Directions

author.name: Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Akashah Shabbir, Muhammad Haris Khan, Fahad Khan, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Begum Demir, Salman Khan

entry.summary: Survey paper examining how agentic AI can be applied to Earth Observation, identifying unique challenges from georeferenced, multi-modal, temporally structured data where errors propagate silently across processing stages.

entry.title: ResetEdit: Precise Text-guided Editing of Generated Image via Resettable Starting Latent

author.name: Hanyi Wang, Han Fang, Zheng Wang, Shilin Wang, Ee-Chien Chang

entry.summary: Proposes ResetEdit for precise editing of AI-generated images using the original generation latent as the editing anchor, avoiding quality degradation from DDIM inversion.

entry.title: Rapid tracking through strongly scattering media with physics-informed neuromorphic speckle analysis

author.name: Yuqing Cao, Shuo Zhu, Rongzhou Chen, Jingyan Chen, Ni Chen, Edmund Y. Lam

entry.summary: Introduces computational neuromorphic tracking (CNT), combining asynchronous event cameras with physics-informed speckle analysis for tracking fast-moving objects through strongly scattering media in low-light conditions.

entry.title: Benchmarking Layout-Guided Diffusion Models through Unified Semantic-Spatial Evaluation in Closed and Open Settings

author.name: Luca Parolari, Nicla Faccioli, Lamberto Ballan

entry.summary: Introduces complementary closed-set (C-Bench) and open-set (O-Bench) benchmarks for evaluating layout-guided text-to-image models on both semantic alignment and spatial fidelity.

entry.title: GramSR: Visual Feature Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Super-Resolution

author.name: Fabio D'Oronzio, Federico Putamorsi, Leonardo Zini, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi

entry.summary: Proposes GramSR, a one-step diffusion-based super-resolution framework that replaces text conditioning with dense visual features from the low-resolution input, addressing the representation gap between abstract text semantics and spatially aligned visual details.

entry.title: QB-LIF: Learnable-Scale Quantized Burst Neurons for Efficient SNNs

author.name: Dewei Bai, Hongxiang Peng, Jiajun Mei, Yang Ren, Hong Qu, Dawen Xia, Zhang Yi

entry.summary: Proposes the Quantized Burst-LIF (QB-LIF) neuron for spiking neural networks, reformulating burst spiking as saturated uniform quantization of membrane potentials with a learnable scale, overcoming the 1-bit-per-timestep information bottleneck.

entry.title: Robust Deepfake Detection: Mitigating Spatial Attention Drift via Calibrated Complementary Ensembles

author.name: Minh-Khoa Le-Phan, Minh-Hoang Le, Trong-Le Do, Minh-Triet Tran

entry.summary: Proposes a deepfake detection framework that addresses spatial attention drift under real-world degradations using a DINOv2-Giant backbone with three specialized processing streams (texture, facial, semantic) and an extreme compound degradation training engine.

entry.title: GeoSearch: Augmenting Worldwide Geolocalization with Web-Scale Reverse Image Search and Image Matching

author.name: Tung-Duong Le-Duc, Hoang-Quoc Nguyen-Son, Minh-Son Dao

entry.summary: Proposes GeoSearch, an open-world image geolocalization framework that integrates web-scale reverse image search into a RAG pipeline with large multimodal models, augmenting prompts with database-retrieved coordinates and web-sourced textual evidence.

entry.title: The optimal betting wealth growth rate

author.name: Ashwin Ram, Aaditya Ramdas

entry.summary: Characterizes the optimal rate of wealth growth in Kelly betting against a general i.i.d. null hypothesis, proving it equals a quantity involving the bipolar of the product null set, which can be strictly smaller than KL_inf.

entry.title: The Power of Power Law: Asymmetry Enables Compositional Reasoning

author.name: Zixuan Wang, Xingyu Dang, Jason D. Lee, Kaifeng Lyu

entry.summary: As reported in Research yesterday, Demonstrates counterintuitively that training under power-law distributions consistently outperforms uniform distributions for compositional reasoning tasks. Provides theoretical analysis showing power-law sampling creates asymmetry that enables better compositional generalization with less data.

entry.title: LEGO: An LLM Skill-Based Front-End Design Generation Platform

author.name: Jincheng Lou, Ruohan Xu, Jiecheng Ma, Runzhe Tao, Xinyu Qu, Yibo Lin

entry.summary: Presents LEGO, a unified skill-based platform for LLM-assisted front-end digital design (EDA), decomposing the workflow into six steps with 42 executable circuit skills extracted from 100+ papers and 11 open-source projects.

entry.title: FAIR_XAI: Improving Multimodal Foundation Model Fairness via Explainability for Wellbeing Assessment

author.name: Sophie Chiang, Tom Brennan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Jiaee Cheong, Hatice Gunes

entry.summary: Investigates VLM fairness in wellbeing assessment across laboratory and naturalistic datasets, finding substantial performance variation across environments and demographics. Proposes using XAI techniques to improve fairness.

entry.title: Agentic AI platforms for autonomous training and rule induction of human-human and virus-human protein-protein interactions

author.name: Hung N. Do, Jessica Z. Kubicek-Sutherland, Oscar A. Negrete, S. Gnanakaran

entry.summary: Constructs agentic AI platforms for autonomous training of PPI prediction models and rule induction for human-human and virus-human protein-protein interactions, achieving ~87% accuracy on protein-disjoint cross-validation.

entry.title: CT-FineBench: A Diagnostic Fidelity Benchmark for Fine-Grained Evaluation of CT Report Generation

author.name: Ruifeng Yuan, Wanxing Chang, Weiwei Cao, Bowen Shi, Zhongyu Wei, Ling Zhang, Jianpeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CT-FineBench, a benchmark for fine-grained evaluation of CT report generation using QA-based assessment of diagnostic fidelity, addressing limitations of coarse lexical overlap metrics.

entry.title: Adaptive ToR: Complexity-Aware Tree-Based Retrieval for Pareto-Optimal Multi-Intent NLU

author.name: Hee-Kyong Yoo, Wonbae Kim, Hyocheol Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Tree-of-Retrieval for multi-intent NLU that dynamically adjusts retrieval topology based on query complexity, routing queries to either single-step or adaptive-depth hierarchical paths.

entry.title: XGRAG: A Graph-Native Framework for Explaining KG-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhuoling Li, Ha Linh Hong Tran Nguyen, Valeria Bladinieres, Maxim Romanovsky

entry.summary: XGRAG introduces a framework for generating causally grounded explanations for knowledge-graph-based RAG systems, addressing the black-box nature of how structured knowledge influences GraphRAG outputs.

entry.title: Quantifying Divergence in Inter-LLM Communication Through API Retrieval and Ranking

author.name: Eyhab Al-Masri

entry.summary: Benchmarks inter-LLM divergence in API discovery and ranking across 15 domains and 5 model families, finding moderate overall alignment but strong domain dependence in how different LLMs select and rank APIs for autonomous tasks.

entry.title: Complete Cyclic Subtask Graphs for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Flexibility, Cost, and Bottlenecks in Multi-Agent Workflows

author.name: Luay Gharzeddine, Samer Saab Jr

entry.summary: Studies complete cyclic subtask graphs for multi-agent tool-using workflows, where unrestricted revisitation is made explicit and analyzable. Evaluates across TextCraft, ALFWorld, and Finance-Agent with ablations over component strength.

entry.title: IntrAgent: An LLM Agent for Content-Grounded Information Retrieval through Literature Review

author.name: Fengbo Ma, Zixin Rao, Xiaoting Li, Zhetao Chen, Hongyue Sun, Yiping Zhao, Xianyan Chen, Zhen Xiang

entry.summary: IntrAgent is an LLM-based agent for automated fine-grained information retrieval from scientific literature, mimicking human literature review behavior through section ranking followed by iterative detail extraction.

entry.title: Usable Agent Discovery for Decentralized AI Systems

author.name: Patrizio Dazzi, Emanuele Carlini, Matteo Mordacchini, Saul Urso

entry.summary: Studies decentralized agent discovery under two-level churn (node and agent) in large-scale agentic systems, comparing structured (Kademlia) and gossip-based overlays for distributed AI agent infrastructure.

entry.title: ArgRE: Formal Argumentation for Conflict Resolution in Multi-Agent Requirements Negotiation

author.name: Haowei Cheng, Milhan Kim, Chong Liu, Teeradaj Racharak, Truong Vinh Truong Duy, Phan Thi Huyen Thanh, Jialong Li, Naoyasu Ubayashi, Hironori Washizaki

entry.summary: Presents ArgRE, embedding Dung-style abstract argumentation into multi-agent LLM requirements negotiation for auditable conflict resolution in software engineering, particularly for regulated domains.

entry.title: AnalogRetriever: Learning Cross-Modal Representations for Analog Circuit Retrieval

author.name: Yihan Wang, Lei Li, Yao Lai, Jing Wang, Yan Lu

entry.summary: Presents AnalogRetriever, a tri-modal retrieval framework for analog circuits supporting search across SPICE netlists, schematics, and functional descriptions, with a repaired dataset achieving 100% compile rate.

entry.title: Layer Embedding Deep Fusion Graph Neural Network

author.name: Taihua Xu, Genhao Tian, Jicong Fan, Xibei Yang, Qinghua Zhang, Yun Cui

entry.summary: Proposes a deep fusion GNN with layer embeddings to address over-smoothing and heterophily challenges, using layer-wise fusion to capture long-range dependencies while handling inconsistent node semantics.

entry.title: Lost in Decoding? Reproducing and Stress-Testing the Look-Ahead Prior in Generative Retrieval

author.name: Kidist Amde Mekonnen, Yongkang Li, Yubao Tang, Simon Lupart, Maarten de Rijke

entry.summary: Reproduces and stress-tests the PAG look-ahead prior for generative retrieval, confirming main results while revealing sensitivity to beam size and decoding configuration choices.

entry.title: Learn&Drop: Fast Learning of CNNs based on Layer Dropping

author.name: Giorgio Cruciata, Luca Cruciata, Liliana Lo Presti, Jan Van Gemert, Marco La Cascia

entry.summary: Proposes Learn&Drop, reducing CNN training time by evaluating layer learning progress and dropping layers that have converged from forward propagation during training.

entry.title: CyberCane: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Privacy-Preserving Phishing Detection with Formal Ontology Reasoning

author.name: Safayat Bin Hakim, Aniqa Afzal, Qi Zhao, Vigna Majmundar, Pawel Sloboda, Houbing Herbert Song

entry.summary: Introduces CyberCane, a neuro-symbolic phishing detection framework combining deterministic symbolic analysis with privacy-preserving RAG, designed to avoid sending sensitive data to external APIs while maintaining high detection accuracy.

entry.title: LLMs Reading the Rhythms of Daily Life: Aligned Understanding for Behavior Prediction and Generation

author.name: Fanjin Meng, Jingtao Ding, Nian Li, Yizhou Sun, Yong Li

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for aligning LLMs with human behavioral data (daily activity sequences), enabling behavior prediction and generation. Addresses the modality gap between behavioral data and natural language.

entry.title: Crystal structure prediction using graph neural combinatorial optimization

author.name: Stavros Gerolymatos, J. Kyle Brubaker, Martin J. A. Schuetz, Vladimir V. Gusev

entry.summary: Applies graph neural network-based combinatorial optimization to crystal structure prediction, addressing the challenge of allocating atoms on discrete grid positions while minimizing interaction energy.

entry.title: Poster: ClawdGo: Endogenous Security Awareness Training for Autonomous AI Agents

author.name: Jiaqi Li, Yang Zhao, Bin Sun, Yang Yu, Jian Chang, Lidong Zhai

entry.summary: Presents ClawdGo, a framework for training autonomous AI agents to recognize security threats from the inside at inference time, using a three-layer taxonomy and self-play training loop without model modification.

entry.title: From Skill Text to Skill Structure: The Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation for Agent Skills

author.name: Qiliang Liang, Hansi Wang, Zhong Liang, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Scheduling-Structural-Logical (SSL) representation for agent skills, making execution structure, constraints, and side effects explicit rather than embedded in natural language descriptions.

entry.title: QEVA: A Reference-Free Evaluation Metric for Narrative Video Summarization with Multimodal Question Answering

author.name: Woojun Jung, Junyeong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes QEVA, a reference-free video summarization evaluation metric that assesses summaries against source videos through multimodal QA along three dimensions: Coverage, Factuality, and Chronology.

entry.title: Latency and Cost of Multi-Agent Intelligent Tutoring at Scale

author.name: Iizalaarab Elhaimeur, Nikos Chrisochoides

entry.summary: Benchmarks latency and cost of a four-agent LLM tutoring system (ITAS) built on Gemini 2.5 Flash across multiple throughput tiers and concurrency levels. Finds Priority PayGo maintains sub-4-second responses while Standard PayGo degrades significantly under classroom-scale load.

entry.title: AdapTime: Enabling Adaptive Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yimin Deng, Yejing Wang, Zhenxi Lin, Zichuan Fu, Guoshuai Zhao, Derong Xu, Yefeng Zheng, Xiangyu Zhao, Xian Wu, Li Zhu, Xueming Qian

entry.summary: Proposes AdapTime, an adaptive temporal reasoning method for LLMs that dynamically selects reasoning strategies based on question complexity, avoiding unnecessary processing for simple cases and inadequate reasoning for complex ones.

entry.title: Self-Abstraction Learning for Effective and Stable Training of Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Wonyong Cho, Taemin Kim, Jungmin Kim, Jeong-Rae Kim, Sung Hoon Jung

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Abstraction Learning (SAL), a hierarchical framework where networks arranged by structural complexity are trained sequentially, with simpler networks guiding more complex ones top-down.

entry.title: PathMoG: A Pathway-Centric Modular Graph Neural Network for Multi-Omics Survival Prediction

author.name: Di Wang, Chupei Tang, Junxiao Kong, Jixiu Zhai, Moyu Tang, Tianchi Lu

entry.summary: Proposes PathMoG, a pathway-centric modular graph neural network for multi-omics cancer survival prediction using 354 KEGG pathway modules with hierarchical omics modulation. Evaluated on 5,650 patients across 10 cancer types.

entry.title: Learning to Route Queries to Heads for Attention-based Re-ranking with Large Language Models

author.name: Yuxing Tian, Fengran Mo, Zhiqi Huang, Weixu Zhang, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: Proposes RouteHead, a query-dependent head selection method for attention-based document re-ranking with LLMs. Learns a lightweight router to map queries to optimal attention head sets rather than using static selection.

entry.title: Leveraging LLMs for Multi-File DSL Code Generation: An Industrial Case Study

author.name: Sivajeet Chand, Kevin Nguyen, Peter Kuntz, Alexander Pretschner

entry.summary: Reports an industrial case study at BMW adapting LLMs for multi-file DSL code generation for an Xtext-based domain-specific language. Develops end-to-end pipeline for dataset construction, task representation, and evaluation.

entry.title: Time-varying Interaction Graph ODE for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Xiaoyi Wang, Zhiqiang Wang, Jianqing Liang, Xingwang Zhao, Chuangyin Dang, Zhen Jin, Jiye Liang

entry.summary: Proposes TI-ODE, a time-varying interaction graph ODE that decomposes evolution functions into learnable interaction bases to capture diverse and time-varying inter-node interaction patterns in dynamic graphs.

entry.title: CoreFlow: Low-Rank Matrix Generative Models

author.name: Dongze Wu, Linglingzhi Zhu, Yao Xie

entry.summary: Proposes CoreFlow, a low-rank flow model for generating matrix-valued distributions by learning shared row/column subspaces and training normalizing flows only on the low-dimensional core matrix.

entry.title: GraphPL: Leveraging GNN for Efficient and Robust Modalities Imputation in Patchwork Learning

author.name: Xingjian Hu, Zuoyu Yan, Jianhua Zhu, Liangcai Gao, Fei Wang, Tengfei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes GraphPL for patchwork learning where different clients have different available modalities, using GNNs to flexibly integrate all observed modalities for missing modality imputation.

entry.title: Subspace Optimization for Efficient Federated Learning under Heterogeneous Data

author.name: Shuchen Zhu, Zhengyang Huang, Yuqi Xu, Peijin Li

entry.summary: Proposes SSF, a subspace optimization method for federated learning that performs heterogeneity-corrected optimization in low-dimensional subspace while preserving full-dimensional control via backfill updates.

entry.title: Learning Illumination Control in Diffusion Models

author.name: Nishit Anand, Manan Suri, Christopher Metzler, Dinesh Manocha, Ramani Duraiswami

entry.summary: Presents a fully open-source pipeline for learning illumination control in diffusion models, building a data engine that creates supervised training triplets from well-lit images for lighting instruction following.

entry.title: Making AI-Assisted Grant Evaluation Auditable without Exposing the Model

author.name: Kemal Bicakci

entry.summary: Proposes a TEE-based architecture for making AI-assisted grant evaluation auditable without exposing model weights or scoring rubrics, using remote attestation to verify the evaluation pipeline.

entry.title: Egocentric Tactile and Proximity Sensors as Observation Priors for Humanoid Collision Avoidance

author.name: Carson Kohlbrenner, Niraj Pudasaini, William Xie, Naren Sivagnanadasan, Nikolaus Correll, Alessandro Roncone

entry.summary: Develops a reinforcement learning framework for whole-body humanoid collision avoidance using distributed tactile and proximity sensors, benchmarked on dodgeball task. Characterizes how sensor properties shape avoidant behavior.

entry.title: A Survey on LLM-based Conversational User Simulation

author.name: Bo Ni, Leyao Wang, Yu Wang, Branislav Kveton, Franck Dernoncourt, Yu Xia, Hongjie Chen, Reuben Leura, Samyadeep Basu, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Puneet Mathur, Nesreen Ahmed, Junda Wu, Li Li, Huixin Zhang, Ruiyi Zhang, Tong Yu, Sungchul Kim, Jiuxiang Gu, Zhengzhong Tu, Alexa Siu, Zichao Wang, David Seunghyun Yoon, Nedim Lipka, Namyong Park, Zihao Lin, Trung Bui, Yue Zhao, Tyler Derr, Ryan A. Rossi

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of LLM-based conversational user simulation covering user granularity, simulation objectives, core techniques, and evaluation methodologies. Covers applications from dialogue systems to recommender evaluation.

entry.title: Learning from Medical Entity Trees: An Entity-Centric Medical Data Engineering Framework for MLLMs

author.name: Jianghang Lin, Haihua Yang, Deli Yu, Kai Wu, Kai Ye, Jinghao Lin, Zihan Wang, Yuhang Wu, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: Proposes an entity-centric medical data engineering framework using Medical Entity Trees extracted from literature to hierarchically organize medical training data for multimodal LLMs, improving fine-grained recognition.

entry.title: Progressing beyond Art Masterpieces or Touristic Clich\'es: how to assess your LLMs for cultural alignment?

author.name: Ant\'onio Branco, Jo\~ao Silva, Nuno Marques, Luis Gomes, Ricardo Campos, Raquel Sequeira, Sara Nerea, Rodrigo Silva, Miguel Marques, Rodrigo Duarte, Artur Putyato, Diogo Folques, Tiago Valente

entry.summary: Reviews existing approaches to cultural alignment assessment of LLMs, identifies limitations, and proposes design guidelines for building cultural assessment datasets. Demonstrates greater discriminative power in experiments.

entry.title: Cutscene Agent: An LLM Agent Framework for Automated 3D Cutscene Generation

author.name: Lanshan He, Haozhou Pang, Qi Gan, Xin Shen, Ziwei Zhang, Yibo Liu, Gang Fang, Bo Liu, Kai Sheng, Shengfeng Zeng, Chaofan Li, Zhen Hui, Keer Zhou, Lan Zhou, Shujun Dai

entry.summary: Presents Cutscene Agent, an LLM agent framework for automated end-to-end cutscene generation using a Cutscene Toolkit built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for bidirectional communication with game engines.

entry.title: Toward Multimodal Conversational AI for Age-Related Macular Degeneration

author.name: Ran Gu, Benjamin Hou, M\'elanie H\'ebert, Asmita Indurkar, Yifan Yang, Emily Y. Chew, Tiarn\'an D. L. Keenan, Zhiyong Lu

entry.summary: Presents OcularChat, an MLLM fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL using 705K simulated patient-physician dialogues for AMD diagnosis through visual question answering on fundus photographs.

entry.title: ShapeY: A Principled Framework for Measuring Shape Recognition Capacity via Nearest-Neighbor Matching

author.name: Jong Woo Nam, Amanda S. Rios, Bartlett W. Mel

entry.summary: Introduces ShapeY, a benchmarking framework for shape-based object recognition using 68,200 grayscale images of 200 3D objects from multiple viewpoints. Tests whether recognition systems use shape vs texture cues via nearest-neighbor matching.

entry.title: FCMBench-Video: Benchmarking Document Video Intelligence

author.name: Runze Cui, Fangxin Shang, Yehui Yang, Qing Yang, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces FCMBench-Video, a benchmark for document video intelligence evaluating perception, temporal grounding, and evidence-grounded reasoning under realistic capture conditions for financial/onboarding applications.

entry.title: Golden RPG: Confidence-Adaptive Region-Aware Noise for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes Golden RPG for compositional text-to-image generation, extending noise prediction with region-aware FiLM adapters and confidence-adaptive noise blending for multi-region prompts.

entry.title: CoRE: Concept-Reasoning Expansion for Continual Brain Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Qianqian Chen, Anglin Liu, Jingyang Zhang, Yudong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CoRE framework for continual brain lesion segmentation combining concept-reasoning expansion with visual perception to handle pathological and multimodal heterogeneity across evolving clinical tasks.

entry.title: Generalizable Human Gaussian Splatting via Multi-view Semantic Consistency

author.name: Jingi Kim, Wonjun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a method for generalizable human Gaussian splatting from sparse views that enforces multi-view semantic consistency by unprojecting latent embeddings and aligning them across viewpoints, addressing inconsistent features from complex human articulations.

entry.title: Control Your Queries: Heterogeneous Query Interaction for Camera-Radar Fusion

author.name: Jialong Wu, Yihan Wang, Matthias Rottmann

entry.summary: Proposes ConFusion, a camera-radar 3D object detector introducing 'heterogeneous query interaction' as a new fusion paradigm. Combines image, radar, and learnable world queries with heterogeneous query mixing for cross-type attention.

entry.title: QCalEval: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Quantum Calibration Plot Understanding

author.name: Shuxiang Cao, Zijian Zhang, Abhishek Agarwal, Grace Bratrud, Niyaz R. Beysengulov, Daniel C. Cole, Alejandro G\'omez Frieiro, Elena O. Glen, Hao Hsu, Gang Huang, Raymond Jow, Greshma Shaji, Tom Lubowe, Ligeng Zhu, Luis Mantilla Calder\'on, Nicola Pancotti, Joel Pendleton, Brandon Severin, Charles Etienne Staub, Sara Sussman, Antti Veps\"al\"ainen, Neel Rajeshbhai Vora, Yilun Xu, Varinia Bernales, Daniel Bowring, Elica Kyoseva, Ivan Rungger, Giulia Semeghini, Sam Stanwyck, Timothy Costa, Al\'an Aspuru-Guzik, Krysta Svore

entry.summary: Introduces QCalEval, the first VLM benchmark for quantum computing calibration plot interpretation, with 243 samples across superconducting qubits and neutral atoms. Tests show best zero-shot model reaches 72.3 mean score.

entry.title: Logic of Fuzzy Paths

author.name: Kush Grover, Pratham Gupta, Jan K\v{r}et\'insk\'y

entry.summary: Introduces a new family of temporal logics for robot motion planning that treats paths as first-class citizens with fuzzy, time-varying signal constraints, building upon signal temporal logic but separating geometry from logic.

entry.title: Tail allocation for conformal prediction intervals

author.name: Tianying Wang

entry.summary: Studies how to optimally allocate miscoverage between lower and upper tails for split-conformal prediction intervals. Proposes TA-CQR which estimates the optimal tail allocation by searching over quantile-defined cores.

entry.title: Model-agnostic information transfer and fusion for classification with label noise

author.name: Zhu Guojun, Zhang Sanguo, Ren Mingyang

entry.summary: Proposes a model-agnostic framework for information transfer and fusion in classification with label noise, addressing the challenge of learning from large noisy datasets supplemented by small clean datasets when significant distribution shift exists.

entry.title: Microsoft AI CEO's "Seemingly Conscious AI Risk"

author.name: Stephen Martin

entry.summary: Critiques Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman's co-authored paper on 'Seemingly Conscious AI Risk,' arguing it fails to properly disclose Microsoft's financial conflict of interest (since consciousness protections would burden frontier labs) and that it subtly frames the possibility of AI consciousness as primarily a risk to manage rather than an ethical obligation.

entry.title: SFT-then-RL Outperforms Mixed-Policy Methods for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Alexis Limozin, Eduard Durech, Torsten Hoefler, Imanol Schlag, Valentina Pyatkin

entry.summary: As reported in Research yesterday, Reveals that recently published mixed-policy optimization methods for LLM reasoning relied on faulty baselines due to two bugs: a DeepSpeed optimizer bug dropping micro-batches and an OpenRLHF loss aggregation bug. Shows standard SFT-then-RL outperforms these methods when bugs are fixed.

entry.title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems

author.name: Alexander Bering

entry.summary: Proposes ZenBrain, a 7-layer neuroscience-inspired memory architecture for AI agents integrating consolidation, forgetting, and reconsolidation principles from 15 neuroscience models.

entry.title: Context-Aware Hospitalization Forecasting Evaluations for Decision Support using LLMs

author.name: Rhea Makkuni, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes context-aware hospitalization forecasting using LLMs that incorporate non-temporal public health context alongside temporal data for resource decision support during healthcare disruptions.

entry.title: An Analysis of the Coordination Gap between Joint and Modular Learning for Job Shop Scheduling with Transportation Resources

author.name: Moritz Link, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann

entry.summary: Systematically investigates when joint training (vs modular) is necessary for multi-agent RL in job-shop scheduling with transportation resources, analyzing the coordination gap between approaches.

entry.title: STELLAR-E: a Synthetic, Tailored, End-to-end LLM Application Rigorous Evaluator

author.name: Alessio Sordo, Lingxiao Du, Meeka-Hanna Lenisa, Evgeny Bogdanov, Maxim Romanovsky

entry.summary: STELLAR-E is an automated system for generating high-quality synthetic evaluation datasets for LLMs, requiring minimal human input and supporting domain-specific and multilingual benchmarks without relying on existing datasets.

entry.title: Your Reviews Replicate You: LLM-Based Agents as Customer Digital Twins for Conjoint Analysis

author.name: Bin Xuan, Jungmin Hwang, Hakyeon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes using LLM-based 'customer digital twins' as virtual respondents for conjoint analysis in market research, constructing individualized agents from Reddit user review histories with RAG to simulate consumer preferences.

entry.title: See No Evil: Semantic Context-Aware Privacy Risk Detection for AR

author.name: Jialu Liu, Yao Li, Zhuoheng Li, Huining Li, Ying Chen

entry.summary: PrivAR leverages VLMs with chain-of-thought prompting for contextual privacy risk detection in augmented reality, inferring sensitive information types from visual cues and obfuscating text while preserving contextual reasoning.

entry.title: SGP-SAM: Self-Gated Prompting for Transferring 3D Segment Anything Models to Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Zixuan Tang, Shen Zhao

entry.summary: SGP-SAM proposes a self-gated prompting framework for transferring 3D SAM models to lesion segmentation, addressing weak spatial representation for small irregular targets and extreme foreground-background imbalance in 3D volumes.

entry.title: When Policies Cannot Be Retrained: A Unified Closed-Form View of Post-Training Steering in Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Elias Hossain, Mohammad Jahid Ibna Basher, Ivan Garibay, Ozlem Garibay, Niloofar Yousefi

entry.summary: Studies deployment-time adaptation for frozen offline RL policies using Product-of-Experts composition, finding graceful degradation under poor priors and identifying a closed-form identity connecting different composition methods.

entry.title: CT-Guided Spatially-varying Regularization for Voxel-Wise Deformable Whole-Body PET Registration

author.name: Xiangcen Wu, Ruohua Chen, Sichun Li, Qianye Yang, Sheng Liu, Jianjun Liu, Zhaoheng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes CT-guided spatially-varying regularization for whole-body PET registration, using CT to distinguish rigid structures (bones) from soft tissues for appropriate regularization strength in deformable registration.

entry.title: Cooperative Informative Sensing for Monitoring Dynamic Indoor Environments via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Kanghoon Lee, Matthew M. Sato, Jinnyeong Yang, Seungro Lee, Sujin Lee, Jiachen Li, Kuk-Jin Yoon, Jinkyoo Park, Kincho H. Law, Yoonjin Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes a MARL framework for cooperative active observation where multiple robots optimize monitoring accuracy of human activity in indoor environments under partial observability.

entry.title: DyABD: The Abdominal Muscle Segmentation in Dynamic MRI Benchmark

author.name: Niamh Belton, Victoria Joppin, Aonghus Lawlor, Catherine Masson, Thierry Bege, David Bendahan, Kathleen M. Curran

entry.summary: Introduces DyABD, the first benchmark for abdominal muscle segmentation in dynamic MRI from patients with hernias during exercises, providing a uniquely challenging segmentation dataset with extreme anatomical variability.

entry.title: An Analysis of Active Learning Algorithms using Real-World Crowd-sourced Text Annotations

author.name: Varun Totakura, Ankita Singh, Yushun Dong, Shayok Chakraborty

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates active learning algorithms using real crowd-sourced text annotations with genuinely noisy oracles, contrasting with typical simulated noise settings.

entry.title: $\mathcal{S}^2$IT: Stepwise Syntax Integration Tuning for Large Language Models in Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction

author.name: Bingfeng Chen, Chenjie Qiu, Yifeng Xie, Boyan Xu, Ruichu Cai, Zhifeng Hao

entry.summary: Proposes S²IT, a stepwise syntax integration tuning framework that progressively integrates syntactic structure knowledge into LLMs for Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction through multi-step tuning.

entry.title: Knee-xRAI: An Explainable AI Framework for Automatic Kellgren-Lawrence Grading of Knee Osteoarthritis

author.name: Azmul A. Irfan, Nur Ahmad Khatim, Alfan Alfian Irfan, Achmad Zaki, Erike A. Suwarsono, Mansur M. Arief

entry.summary: Presents Knee-xRAI, a modular explainable framework for knee osteoarthritis grading that independently quantifies joint space narrowing, osteophytes, and sclerosis before integrating into KL grade classification.

entry.title: Grammar-Constrained Refinement of Safety Operational Rules Using Language in the Loop: What Could Go Wrong

author.name: Khouloud Gaaloul, Zaid Ghazal, Madhu Latha Pulimi, Sam Emmanuel Kathiravan

entry.summary: Introduces a framework combining counterfactual reasoning with grammar-constrained refinement for updating safety operational rules in cyber-physical systems. Addresses the risk of LLM-generated refinements that overfit to observed outcomes.

entry.title: Partition-of-Unity Gaussian Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Amir Nooeizadegan

entry.summary: Introduces Partition-of-Unity Gaussian KAN (PU-GKAN), a normalized Gaussian basis variant of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks that produces partition-of-unity feature maps with exact constant reproduction and finite-feature kernel interpretation.

entry.title: Reheat Nachos for Dinner? Evaluating AI Support for Cross-Cultural Communication of Neologisms

author.name: Dayeon Ki, Yu Hou, Rachel Rudinger, Hal Daum\'e III, Marine Carpuat, Fumeng Yang

entry.summary: Studies how well AI tools (LLMs) help non-native English speakers learn and use neologisms/slang in cross-cultural communication, through a 234-participant study comparing different AI assistance conditions.

entry.title: KOMBO: Korean Character Representations Based on the Combination Rules of Subcharacters

author.name: SungHo Kim, Juhyeong Park, Yeachan Kim, SangKeun Lee

entry.summary: Introduces KOMBO, a framework for Korean language models that incorporates the invention principles of Hangeul character composition (from Hunminjeongeum) into PLM representations, showing improvements across NLP tasks.

entry.title: IntentVLM: Open-Vocabulary Intention Recognition through Forward-Inverse Modeling with Video-Language Models

author.name: Hamed Rahimi, Clemence Grislain, Adrien Jacquet Cretides, Olivier Sigaud, Mohamed Chetouani

entry.summary: Presents IntentVLM, a two-stage video-language framework for open-vocabulary human intention recognition inspired by forward-inverse modeling in cognitive science, decomposing intention understanding into goal generation and structured selection.

entry.title: Understanding the Limits of Automated Evaluation for Code Review Bots in Practice

author.name: Veli Karakaya, Utku Boran Torun, Baykal Mehmet U\c{c}ar, Eray T\"uz\"un

entry.summary: Examines automated evaluation of LLM-powered code review bots in an industrial setting at Beko, analyzing 2,604 bot-generated PR comments. Finds limitations in using developer actions as ground truth for evaluation.

entry.title: Nautile-370M: Spectral Memory Meets Attention in a Small Reasoning Model

author.name: Maixent Chenebaux

entry.summary: Presents Nautile-370M, a 371M parameter hybrid language model combining spectral sequence operators (SCA layers) with transformer layers for efficient reasoning. Trained on single TPU pod with RL stage on single DGX Spark.

entry.title: Learning with Embedded Linear Equality Constraints via Variational Bayesian Inference

author.name: Matthew Marsh, Beno\^it Chachuat, Antonio del Rio Chanona

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework to embed linear equality constraints into neural network learning while characterizing full predictive uncertainty, demonstrated on battery model voltage and energy balances.

entry.title: Online combinatorial optimization with stochastic decision sets and adversarial losses

author.name: Gergely Neu, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Studies online combinatorial optimization with stochastic action availability, proposing Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader algorithms with a novel 'Counting Asleep Times' loss estimation technique.

entry.title: Sustained Gradient Alignment Mediates Subliminal Learning in a Multi-Step Setting: Evidence from MNIST Auxiliary Logit Distillation Experiment

author.name: Chayanon Kitkana, Shivam Arora

entry.summary: Empirically validates that gradient alignment between trait and distillation gradients persists through multi-step training in subliminal learning, extending single-step theory. Shows liminal training mitigation works by attenuating alignment.

entry.title: Online learning with Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi side-observation graphs

author.name: Tom\'a\v{s} Koc\'ak, Gergely Neu, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Studies adversarial multi-armed bandits with Erdős-Rényi side-observation graphs where non-chosen arms reveal losses with probability r. Proposes two algorithms achieving near-optimal regret for different ranges of r.

entry.title: Spectral bandits

author.name: Tom\'a\v{s} Koc\'ak, R\'emi Munos, Branislav Kveton, Shipra Agrawal, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Studies bandit problems where payoffs are smooth on a graph, introducing effective dimension to characterize regret. Suitable for graph-based recommendation problems.

entry.title: Improving Diversity in Black-box Few-shot Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Tri-Nhan Vo, Dang Nguyen, Kien Do, Sunil Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes improving diversity in black-box few-shot knowledge distillation through a novel GAN training scheme that actively promotes synthetic image diversity for student learning.

entry.title: Toward a Functional Geometric Algebra for Natural Language Semantics

author.name: James Pustejovsky

entry.summary: Argues that geometric (Clifford) algebra provides a superior foundation for semantic representation compared to standard linear algebra, proposing Functional Geometric Algebra for typed, compositional NLP semantics.

entry.title: Dual-Track CoT: Budget-Aware Stepwise Guidance for Small LMs

author.name: Sagnik Chatterjee, Atharva Patil, Sricharan Ramesh

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Track CoT for enabling small language models (7-8B) to reason reliably under tight token budgets using process supervision and test-time control.

entry.title: WhisperPipe: A Resource-Efficient Streaming Architecture for Real-Time Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Erfan Ramezani, Mohammad Mahdi Giahi, Mohammad Erfan Zarabadipour, Amir Reza Yosefian, Hamid Ghadiri

entry.summary: Presents WhisperPipe, a streaming ASR architecture achieving bounded memory consumption while maintaining transcription quality through hybrid VAD, dynamic buffering with overlapping context windows, and efficient processing pipeline.

entry.title: PSP: An Interpretable Per-Dimension Accent Benchmark for Indic Text-to-Speech

author.name: Venkata Pushpak Teja Menta

entry.summary: Introduces PSP (Phoneme Substitution Profile), a per-phonological-dimension accent benchmark for Indic TTS that decomposes accent quality into six dimensions including retroflex collapse, aspiration fidelity, and vowel-length fidelity.

entry.title: A New Kind of Network? Review and Reference Implementation of Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Martin Spitznagel, Janis Keuper

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive review and reference implementation of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), combining Wolfram's cellular automata concepts with learnable neural networks for modeling self-organizing generative systems.

entry.title: DenseScout: Algorithm-System Co-design for Budgeted Tiny Object Selection on Edge Platforms

author.name: Xiong Zhouzhi, Zimo Zeng, Yi Chen, Shuqi Xu, Yunfeng Yan, Donglian Qi

entry.summary: Presents DenseScout for budgeted tiny object selection on edge platforms, studying the joint algorithm-system perspective for prioritizing candidate patches from high-resolution images under compute and latency constraints.

entry.title: Edge-Cloud Collaborative Reconstruction via Structure-Aware Latent Diffusion for Downstream Remote Sensing Perception

author.name: Yun Li, Xianju Li

entry.summary: Proposes SALD framework for edge-cloud collaborative super-resolution of remote sensing imagery, using structure-aware latent diffusion to avoid both over-smoothing and structural hallucinations.

entry.title: TopoMamba: Topology-Aware Scanning and Fusion for Segmenting Heterogeneous Medical Visual Media

author.name: Fuchen Zheng, Chengpei Xu, Long Ma, Weixuan Li, Junhua Zhou, Xuhang Chen, Weihuang Liu, Haolun Li, Quanjun Li, Zhenxi Zhang, Lei Zhao, Chi-Man Pun, Shoujun Zhou

entry.summary: Presents TopoMamba, a topology-aware framework for medical image segmentation using state-space models. Introduces diagonal/anti-diagonal scanning to better model oblique structures, plus ScanCache for efficient device-aware caching.

entry.title: Sketch2Arti: Sketch-based Articulation Modeling of CAD Objects

author.name: Yi Yang, Hao Pan, Yijing Cui, Alla Sheffer, Changjian Li

entry.summary: Presents Sketch2Arti, the first sketch-based articulation modeling system for CAD objects, allowing designers to specify how parts should move through simple 2D sketches (arrows, strokes) and automatically converting them to articulated 3D models.

entry.title: Threat-Oriented Digital Twinning for Security Evaluation of Autonomous Platforms

author.name: Thomas J. Neubert, Laxima Niure Kandel, Berker Pek\"oz

entry.summary: Presents a threat-oriented digital twinning methodology for cybersecurity evaluation of learning-enabled autonomous platforms, providing an open-source modular twin with confidence-gated perception and runtime hold-safe behavior.

entry.title: A Continuous-Time Ensemble Kalman-Bucy Smoother for Causal Inference and Model Discovery

author.name: Zhang Jiang (University of Wisconsin-Madison), Marios Andreou (University of Wisconsin-Madison), Sebastian Reich (University of Potsdam), Nan Chen (University of Wisconsin-Madison)

entry.summary: Introduces an ensemble Kalman-Bucy smoother for continuous-time data assimilation of nonlinear dynamical systems, reconstructing conditional distributions using ensemble moments for improved state estimation during regime transitions.

entry.title: Empirical calibration of Polymarket: Analysis of 7,661 resolved binary markets

author.name: JohnLeslie_PM

entry.summary: An empirical analysis of 7,661 resolved Polymarket binary prediction markets finds they are well-calibrated at the extremes but show systematic underpricing in the mid-range (30-70% probability events), with an overall Brier score of 0.025. Calibration improves as resolution date approaches, and the analysis includes an interactive tool for exploring the data.

entry.title: Federated Cross-Modal Retrieval with Missing Modalities via Semantic Routing and Adapter Personalization

author.name: Hefeng Zhou, Xuan Liu, Sicheng Chen, Wutong Zhang, Wu Yan, Jiong Lou, Chentao Wu, Guangtao Xue, Wei Zhao, Jie Li

entry.summary: RCSR is a federated cross-modal retrieval framework handling heterogeneous clients with missing modalities through prototype anchoring, semantic routing, and client-specific adapters built on frozen CLIP.

entry.title: DecompKAN: Decomposed Patch-KAN for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Naveen Mysore

entry.summary: Proposes DecompKAN, an attention-free architecture combining trend-residual decomposition, channel-wise patching, and B-spline KAN edge functions for interpretable time series forecasting. Achieves competitive results on 15/32 benchmark settings.

entry.title: Backtranslation Augmented Direct Preference Optimization for Neural Machine Translation

author.name: Mehrdad Ghassabi, Spehr Rajabi, Hamidreza Baradaran Kashani, Sadra Hakim, Mahshid Keivandarian

entry.summary: Proposes using DPO-based reinforcement learning as post-training for neural machine translation, using backtranslation to generate preference data. Shows improvements on English-to-German translation.

entry.title: BifDet: A 3D Bifurcation Detection Dataset for Airway-Tree Modeling

author.name: Ali Keshavarzi, Quentin Bouniot, Benjamin M. Smith, Elsa Angelini

entry.summary: Introduces BifDet, the first publicly available dataset for 3D airway bifurcation detection in thoracic CT scans, filling a critical gap for respiratory disease analysis.

entry.title: The Imbalanced User-AI Relationships as an Ethical Failure of Front-End Design in Healthcare AI

author.name: Maureen Mghambi Mwadime

entry.summary: Identifies 'imbalanced user-AI relationships' as a front-end ethical failure in healthcare AI, where patients are visible to AI but cannot understand, question, or influence how they are represented, through the lens of 'asymmetric legibility.'

entry.title: Towards Causally Interpretable Wi-Fi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition with Discrete Latent Compression and LTL Rule Extraction

author.name: Luca Cotti, Luca Lavazza, Marco Cominelli, Liying Han, Gaofeng Dong, Francesco Gringoli, Mani B. Srivastava, Trevor Bihl, Erik P. Blasch, Daniel O. Brigham, Kara Combs, Lance M. Kaplan, Federico Cerutti

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline for Wi-Fi CSI-based human activity recognition that achieves causal interpretability by combining a categorical VAE with Gumbel-Softmax latent variables and linear temporal logic (LTL) rule extraction. Bridges the gap between deep learning performance and symbolic controllability.

entry.title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging

author.name: Basel Shbita, Anna Lisa Gentile, Bing Zhang, Sungeun An, Shailja Thakur, Shubhi Asthana, Yi Zhou, Saptha Surendran, Farhan Ahmed, Rohan Kulkarni, Yuya Jeremy Ong, Chad DeLuca, Hima Patel

entry.summary: Introduces a systematic debugging methodology for LLMs that treats models as observable systems, providing structured model-agnostic methods spanning issue detection to model refinement. Unifies evaluation, interpretability, and error-analysis practices.

entry.title: IndustryAssetEQA: A Neurosymbolic Operational Intelligence System for Embodied Question Answering in Industrial Asset Maintenance

author.name: Chathurangi Shyalika, Dhaval Patel, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Presents IndustryAssetEQA, a neurosymbolic system combining telemetry with FMEA knowledge graphs for embodied question answering in industrial maintenance, addressing the problem of generic LLM explanations in safety-critical settings.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide

author.name: Nikolaos Al. Papadopoulos, Konstantinos E. Psannis

entry.summary: Provides a practical decision framework for seven information-theoretic measures (entropy, cross-entropy, mutual information, transfer entropy, integrated information, effective information, autonomy) in AI, organized around prescriptive questions.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People

author.name: Aydin Ayanzadeh, Tim Oates

entry.summary: Presents an agentic framework for accessible indoor navigation that converts floor plan images into spatial knowledge graphs with LLM-powered path planning and safety evaluation for blind and low-vision users.

entry.title: Failure-Centered Runtime Evaluation for Deployed Trilingual Public-Space Agents

author.name: M. Meng

entry.summary: Presents PSA-Eval, a failure-centered runtime evaluation framework for deployed trilingual public-space agents that shifts the evaluation unit from scores to failures with traceable repair and regression testing.

entry.title: Generative Design of a Gas Turbine Combustor Using Invertible Neural Networks

author.name: Patrick Kr\"uger, Hanno Gottschalk, Werner Krebs, Bastian Werdelmann

entry.summary: Uses Invertible Neural Networks (INNs) for generative design of gas turbine combustors for hydrogen combustion, enabling knowledge transfer between engine classes to reduce redesign effort.

entry.title: Towards Lawful Autonomous Driving: Deriving Scenario-Aware Driving Requirements from Traffic Laws and Regulations

author.name: Bowen Jian, Rongjie Yu, Hong Wang, Liqiang Wang, Zihang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to derive scenario-aware driving requirements from traffic laws for autonomous vehicles, grounding legal reasoning in structured traffic scenarios to improve precision over naive LLM-based retrieval of legal provisions.

entry.title: ECoLAD: Deployment-Oriented Evaluation for Automotive Time-Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Kadir-Kaan \"Ozer, Ren\'e Ebeling, Markus Enzweiler

entry.summary: ECoLAD proposes a deployment-oriented evaluation protocol for time-series anomaly detection in automotive settings, measuring performance under realistic compute constraints rather than just accuracy on workstation hardware.

entry.title: StratRAG: A Multi-Hop Retrieval Evaluation Dataset for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Aryan Patodiya

entry.summary: StratRAG is an evaluation dataset for benchmarking RAG systems on multi-hop reasoning with 2,200 examples from HotpotQA, comparing BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid strategies under realistic noisy document conditions.

entry.title: Algorithmic Administration and the EU AI Act: Legal Principles for Public Sector Use of AI

author.name: Georgios Pavlidis, Ioannis Kastanas

entry.summary: Examines how the EU AI Act interacts with administrative law principles like discretion, duty to state reasons, and proportionality when AI is used by public authorities in high-risk domains like social benefits, migration, and law enforcement.

entry.title: Applied AI-Enhanced RF Interference Rejection

author.name: Rahul Jain, Pierre Trepagnier, Rick Gentile, Joey Botero, Alexia Schulz

entry.summary: Applies autoregressive transformer decoder models for AI-enhanced RF interference rejection, showing orders-of-magnitude faster throughput than WaveNet models while detecting and decoding signals across varying interference levels without knowledge of the interferer.

entry.title: NeuroAPS-Net: Neuro-Anatomically Aware Point Cloud Representation for Efficient Alzheimer's Disease Classification

author.name: Towhidul Islam (ICS Department, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia), Mufti Mahmud (SDAIA-KFUPM JRC for AI, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, IRC for Bio Systems and Machines, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia)

entry.summary: Introduces a pipeline converting T1 MRI into anatomically informed 2D point clouds for Alzheimer's classification, and NeuroAPS-Net, a lightweight geometric deep learning model incorporating anatomical priors.

entry.title: Reconstructive Authority Model: Runtime Execution Validity Under Partial Observability

author.name: Marcelo Fernandez - TraslaIA

entry.summary: Proposes the Reconstructive Authority Model (RAM) for autonomous systems under partial observability, separating integrity from coverage in governance mechanisms. Argues that authenticated state projections are necessary but insufficient for execution validity.

entry.title: From Pixels to Explanations: Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Grading with CNN-Transformer Ensembles, Visual Explainability and Vision-Language Models

author.name: Pir Bakhsh Khokhar, Carmine Gravino, Fabio Palomba, Sule Yildirim Yayilgan, Sarang Shaikh

entry.summary: Combines CNN-transformer ensembles with visual explainability and vision-language models for diabetic retinopathy grading, converting retinal images into clinically interpretable outputs.

entry.title: MindTrellis: Co-Creating Knowledge Structures with AI through Interactive Visual Exploration

author.name: Xiang Li, Cara Li, Emily Kuang, Can Liu, Jian Zhao

entry.summary: Presents MindTrellis, an interactive visual system for co-creating knowledge structures with AI through visual exploration, supporting collaborative construction of evolving knowledge representations from multiple documents.

entry.title: Training Machine Learning Models on Encrypted Data: A Privacy-Preserving Framework using Homomorphic Encryption

author.name: Alexandre Marques, Beatriz S\'a, Rui Botelho, Pedro Pinto

entry.summary: Demonstrates training ML models on encrypted data using CKKS homomorphic encryption, providing a proof-of-concept privacy-preserving framework that maintains accuracy and efficiency.

entry.title: Scalable LLM-based Coding of Dialogue in Healthcare Simulation: Balancing Coding Performance, Processing Time, and Environmental Impact

author.name: Kiyoshige Garces, Gloria Milena Fernandez-Nieto, Linxuan Zhao, Sachini Samaraweera, Dragan Gasevic, Roberto Martinez-Maldonado, Vanessa Echeverria

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based dialogue coding in healthcare simulation, balancing coding accuracy, processing time, and environmental impact. Moves beyond replicating human coding toward scalable analytical solutions.

entry.title: EAD-Net: Emotion-Aware Talking Head Generation with Spatial Refinement and Temporal Coherence

author.name: Yahui Li, Yinfeng Yu, Liejun Wang, Shengjie Shen

entry.summary: Proposes EAD-Net for emotional talking head generation with SyncNet supervision and temporal alignment to maintain lip synchronization while expressing emotions, using diffusion models.

entry.title: Sphere-Depth: A Benchmark for Depth Estimation Methods with Varying Spherical Camera Orientations

author.name: Soulayma Gazzeh, Giuseppe Mazzola, Liliana Lo Presti, Marco La Cascia

entry.summary: Introduces Sphere-Depth benchmark for evaluating depth estimation robustness from spherical/equirectangular images under camera pose perturbations, relevant for robotic navigation.

entry.title: COMO: Closed-Loop Optical Molecule Recognition with Minimum Risk Training

author.name: Zhuoqi Lyu, Qing Ke

entry.summary: Presents COMO, a closed-loop optical chemical structure recognition system using minimum risk training to optimize molecular-level metrics rather than token-level MLE, addressing exposure bias in SMILES generation from molecular images.

entry.title: ESIA: An Energy-Based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware Framework for Pedestrian Intention Prediction

author.name: Yanping Wu, Meiting Dang, Lin Wu, Edmond S. L. Ho, Zhenghua Chen, Chongfeng Wei

entry.summary: Proposes ESIA, a CRF-based framework for pedestrian intention prediction in autonomous driving that models the problem as structured prediction over a unified graph representation incorporating spatiotemporal interactions.

entry.title: Query2Diagram: Answering Developer Queries with UML Diagrams

author.name: Oleg Baryshnikov (HSE University), Anton M. Alekseev (St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Mathematical Institute, RAS, St. Petersburg State University), Sergey I. Nikolenko (St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Mathematical Institute, RAS, St. Petersburg State University)

entry.summary: Introduces query-driven UML diagram generation where LLMs create focused UML diagrams answering specific developer questions about codebases. Fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Coder-14B on curated code-query-diagram dataset.

entry.title: Geometry Preserving Loss Functions Promote Improved Adaptation of Blackbox Generative Model

author.name: Sinjini Mitra, Constantine Kyriakakis, Shenyuan Liang, Anuj Srivastava, Pavan Turaga

entry.summary: Proposes geometry-preserving loss functions for adapting blackbox generative models where weights and gradients are inaccessible, enabling domain adaptation through an end-to-end pipeline.

entry.title: Do Quantum Transformers Help? A Systematic VQC Architecture Comparison on Tabular Benchmarks

author.name: Chi-Sheng Chen, En-Jui Kuo

entry.summary: Systematically compares four variational quantum circuit architectures (FC-VQC, ResNet-VQC, quantum transformer, fully quantum transformer) on tabular benchmarks, finding simpler FC-VQCs achieve 90-96% of attention-based VQC performance with fewer parameters.

entry.title: The Pragmatic Persona: Discovering LLM Persona through Bridging Inference

author.name: Jisoo Yang (Chung-Ang University), Jongwon Ryu (Chung-Ang University), Minuk Ma (University of British Columbia), Trung X. Pham (Van Lang University), Junyeong Kim (Chung-Ang University)

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for discovering LLM personas through bridging inference—implicit conceptual relations connecting utterances via shared world knowledge. Uses structured knowledge graphs to capture latent semantic links governing how LLMs organize meaning across dialogue turns.

entry.title: SPLIT: Separating Physical-Contact via Latent Arithmetic in Image-Based Tactile Sensors

author.name: Wadhah Zai El Amri, Nicol\'as Navarro-Guerrero

entry.summary: Presents SPLIT, a method for simulating image-based tactile sensors using latent space arithmetic to disentangle contact geometry from sensor-specific optical properties, enabling transfer across different sensor types.

entry.title: Deployment-Aligned Low-Precision Neural Architecture Search for Spaceborne Edge AI

author.name: Parampuneet Kaur Thind, Vaibhav Katturu, Giacomo Zema, Roberto Del Prete

entry.summary: Integrates low-precision (FP16) training directly into hardware-aware neural architecture search for spaceborne edge AI deployment, addressing the mismatch between full-precision search and low-precision deployment.

entry.title: K-MetBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Fine-Grained Evaluation of Expert Reasoning, Locality, and Multimodality in Meteorology

author.name: Soyeon Kim, Cheongwoong Kang, Myeongjin Lee, Eun-Chul Chang, Jaedeok Lee, Jaesik Choi

entry.summary: Introduces K-MetBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Korean meteorology expertise across four dimensions including visual reasoning, logical validity, geo-cultural comprehension, and domain analysis. Evaluates 55 models.

entry.title: Contrastive Image-Metadata Pre-Training for Materials Transmission Electron Microscopy

author.name: Georgia Channing, Debora Keller, Marta D. Rossell, Philip Torr, Rolf Erni, Stig Helveg, Henrik Eliasson

entry.summary: Introduces contrastive image-metadata pre-training for materials science TEM microscopy, creating joint embeddings between HAADF-STEM images and acquisition parameters to enable generative style transfer between imaging conditions.

entry.title: Gradient-Direction Sensitivity Reveals Linear-Centroid Coupling Hidden by Optimizer Trajectories

author.name: Yongzhong Xu

entry.summary: Shows that performing SVD on loss gradients rather than optimizer updates dramatically increases the measured coupling between sensitivity directions and Linear Centroid Hypothesis features in modular arithmetic tasks.

entry.title: VAE-Inf: A statistically interpretable generative paradigm for imbalanced classification

author.name: Hongfei Wu, Ruijian Han, Yancheng Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes VAE-Inf, a two-stage framework for imbalanced classification that trains a VAE on majority-class data and uses statistical hypothesis testing in latent space for minority detection.

entry.title: Enhancing SignSGD: Small-Batch Convergence Analysis and a Hybrid Switching Strategy

author.name: Haoran Chen, Wentao Wang

entry.summary: Revisits SignSGD from a dithering perspective, derives small-batch convergence rates, proposes annealed Gaussian dithering, and introduces a hybrid SGD-SignSGD switching strategy.

entry.title: On Halting vs Converging in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Jeroen Bollen, Stijn Vansummeren

entry.summary: Studies expressiveness relationships between different recurrent GNN stopping criteria: converging, output-converging, and halting RGNNs. Shows over undirected graphs, converging RGNNs equal graded-bisimulation-invariant halting RGNNs.

entry.title: Diverse Image Priors for Black-box Data-free Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Tri-Nhan Vo, Dang Nguyen, Trung Le, Kien Do, Sunil Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes DIP-KD for black-box data-free knowledge distillation using diverse image priors through a three-phase collaborative pipeline, addressing limited data diversity and distillation signals.

entry.title: TSN-Affinity: Similarity-Driven Parameter Reuse for Continual Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dominik \.Zurek, Kamil Faber, Marcin Pietron, Pawe{\l} Gajewski, Roberto Corizzo

entry.summary: Proposes TSN-Affinity for continual offline RL, using similarity-driven parameter reuse across tasks to address catastrophic forgetting without replay buffers.

entry.title: Interpretable Fuzzy Modeling Reveals Population-Level Representation Differences in P300 Brain Computer Interfaces Across Neurodivergent and Neurotypical Cohorts

author.name: Xiaowei Jiang, Sudong Shang, Adrian Wilkinson, Michael L. Platt, Da Xiao, Bening Cao, Thomas Do

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable fuzzy spatiotemporal framework for P300 BCI classification that reveals population-level representation differences across ALS, autism, and neurotypical cohorts.

entry.title: FGDM: Reasoning Aware Multi-Agentic Framework for Software Bug Detection using Chain of Thought and Tree of Thought Prompting

author.name: Srita Padmanabhuni, Bhargavi Karuturi, Jerusha Karen Indupalli, Santhan Reddy Chilla, Vivek Yelleti

entry.summary: Proposes FGDM, a multi-agent framework using flow graphs and Chain-of-Thought/Tree-of-Thought prompting for LLM-based software bug detection, converting code to flow graphs and identifying erroneous segments.

entry.title: CAN-QA: A Question-Answering Benchmark for Reasoning over In-Vehicle CAN Traffic

author.name: Jing Chen, Abhijay Deevi, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing

Proposes solutions like hiding scores until after reading, citing a 2013 RCT showing social influence bias on aggregation sites.

entry.title: On the Existence of an Inverse Solution for Preference-Based Reductions in Argumentation

author.name: Alessio Zaninotto, Bruno Yun, Nir Oren, Srdjan Vesic

entry.summary: Investigates the inverse problem in preference-based argumentation frameworks: given an argumentation graph and labelling, can we determine if a preference relation exists to yield the desired labelling? Establishes complexity results for four widely-used preference-based reductions.

entry.title: Hardware-Efficient FPGA Implementation of Sigmoid Function Using Mixed-Radix Hyperbolic Rotation CORDIC

author.name: Chintan Panchal, Ankur Changela, Mohendra Roy

entry.summary: Proposes a hardware-efficient FPGA implementation of the sigmoid activation function using mixed-radix CORDIC architecture, exploiting the relationship between sigmoid and tanh functions.

entry.title: GCA-BULF: A Bottom-Up Framework for Short-Term Load Forecasting Using Grouped Critical Appliances

author.name: Yunhao Yao, Jinwei Fang, Puhan Luo, Zhiqiang Wang, Jiahui Hou, Xiang-Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a bottom-up short-term load forecasting framework using grouped critical appliances with automatic grouping and specific models per appliance group.

entry.title: Negative Ontology of True Target for Machine Learning: Towards Evaluation and Learning under Democratic Supervision

author.name: Yongquan Yang

entry.summary: Philosophically examines the assumption that a 'true target' exists in machine learning, proposing 'Democratic Supervision' based on the non-existence of objective ground truth and introducing Multiple Inaccurate True Targets (MIATTs).

entry.title: A Quantitative Definition of Intelligence

author.name: Kang-Sin Choi

entry.summary: Proposes a quantitative definition of intelligence as the ratio of logarithm of independent outputs to total description length. Distinguishes memorization from knowledge based on whether description length scales with output count.

entry.title: An analysis of sensor selection for fruit picking with suction-based grippers

author.name: Eva Krueger, Marcus Rosette, Joseph R. Davidson

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal sensor configurations for a suction-based apple picking gripper to determine which sensors are most informative at different grasping phases. Identifies minimal sensor sets for reliable pick detection.

entry.title: Deflation-Free Optimal Scoring

author.name: Sharmin Afroz, Brendan Ames

entry.summary: Proposes Deflation-Free Sparse Optimal Scoring, simultaneously estimating all discriminant vectors under global orthogonality constraints rather than sequentially via deflation.

entry.title: Wiki Dumps to Training Corpora: South Slavic Case

author.name: Mihailo \v{S}kori\'c

entry.summary: Methodology for converting Wikimedia dumps into quality training corpora for seven South Slavic languages, with cleaning and filtering of auto-generated low-quality articles.

entry.title: LLM Style Slop is Absolutely Everywhere

author.name: silentbob

entry.summary: An observational essay documenting the pervasive spread of AI-generated text ('slop') across blog posts, YouTube videos, personal messages, press releases, and even subreddits dedicated to making AI text sound more human. The author argues this is degrading the quality of online discourse.

entry.title: ResAF-Net: An Anchor-Free Attention-Based Network for Tree Detection and Agricultural Mapping in Palestine

author.name: Rabee Al-Qasem

entry.summary: Presents ResAF-Net for satellite-based tree detection in Palestine, combining ResNet-50, ASPP, multi-head self-attention, and anchor-free FCOS detection head for agricultural monitoring.

entry.title: SolarTformer: A Transformer Based Deep Learning Approach for Short Term Solar Power Forecasting

author.name: Ankan Basu, Jyotiraditya Roy, Aditya Datta, Prayas Sanyal, Sumanta Banerjee

entry.summary: Applies transformer architecture to short-term solar power forecasting using meteorological data and power station metadata. Claims to capture temporal dependencies and generalize across power stations.

entry.title: Monitoring exposure-length variations in submarine power cables using distributed fiber-optic sensing

author.name: Sakiko Mishima, Yoshiyuki Yajima, Noriyuki Tonami, Tomoyuki Hino, Shugo Aibe, Junichiro Saikawa, Koji Mizuguchi

entry.summary: Proposes an anomaly detection framework for monitoring submarine power cable exposure lengths using Distributed Acoustic Sensing and one-class SVM. Uses regression-based feature extraction to handle environmental variability in offshore environments.

entry.title: CGU-ILALab at FoodBench-QA 2026: Comparing Traditional and LLM-based Approaches for Recipe Nutrient Estimation

author.name: Wei-Chun Chen, Yu-Xuan Chen, I-Fang Chung, Ying-Jia Lin

entry.summary: Compares traditional ML (TF-IDF), deep encoders (DeBERTa-v3), and LLMs for nutrient estimation from recipe text in a shared task setting. Reveals accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.

entry.title: Assessment of the quantitative impact of occlusal positioning splints on temporomandibular joint conditions

author.name: Agnieszka Anna Tomaka, Krzysztof Domino, Dariusz Pojda, Micha{\l} Tarnawski

entry.summary: Proposes computational method for quantitative analysis of temporomandibular joint configuration using occlusal positioning splints, integrating CBCT, facial motion, and dental scans.

entry.title: Forecasting is Not Overrated and It's Probably Funded Appropriately

author.name: Ben S.

entry.summary: A response arguing that forecasting funding has been valuable, counter to a previous post claiming it's overrated. Points to platforms like Metaculus and Manifold as successful infrastructure that provides daily value to tens of thousands of users, comparing them to epistemic public goods like Wikipedia.

entry.title: Quasi-Quadratic Gradient: A New Direction for Accelerating the BFGS Method in Quasi-Newton Optimization

author.name: John Chiang

entry.summary: Introduces Quasi-Quadratic Gradient (QQG) as a search direction for accelerating BFGS optimization. Defines QQG as the product of inverse Hessian approximation and current gradient.

entry.title: Comparative Study of Bending Analysis using Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Numerical Dynamic Deflection in Perforated nanobeam

author.name: Ramanath Garai, Iswari Sahu, S. Chakraverty

entry.summary: Applies physics-informed neural networks to analyze bending behavior of perforated nanobeams, comparing static bending and dynamic deflection results.

entry.title: CiteRadar: A Citation Intelligence Platform for Researcher Profiling and Geographic Visualization

author.name: Chenxu Niu, Yiming Sun

entry.summary: Presents CiteRadar, an open-source tool that takes a Google Scholar ID and produces geographic visualization of citations, ranked author tables, and collaboration maps.

entry.title: Spark Policy Toolkit: Semantic Contracts and Scalable Execution for Policy Learning in Spark

author.name: Zeyu Bai

entry.summary: Presents Spark Policy Toolkit, providing Spark-native primitives for scalable policy learning, including vectorized inference and collect-less split search governed by semantic contracts.

entry.title: Benchmarking OCR Pipelines with Adaptive Enhancement for Multi-Domain Retail Bill Digitization

author.name: Vijaysinh Gaikwad

entry.summary: Benchmarks an adaptive OCR pipeline for multi-domain retail bill digitization using CNN-based enhancement, quality routing, and NLP post-processing across five retail domains.

entry.title: Benchmarking Logistic Regression, SVM, and LightGBM Against BiLSTM with Attention for Sentiment Analysis on Indonesian Product Reviews

author.name: Razin Hafid Hamdi, Ivana Margareth Hutabarat, Hanna Gresia Sinaga, Luluk Muthoharoh, Ardika Satria, Martin C. T. Manullang

entry.summary: Benchmarks traditional ML methods (Logistic Regression, SVM, LightGBM) against BiLSTM with attention for binary sentiment analysis on Indonesian product reviews. Finds LightGBM achieves best ML performance while BiLSTM with attention achieves highest overall accuracy.

entry.title: [exploding note] Apply to Mentor Secure Program Synthesis Fellowship by May 5th

author.name: Quinn

entry.summary: An announcement for a fellowship on secure program synthesis, jointly run by Apart Research and Atlas Computing, running June-September 2026. The program focuses on applying formal methods and software correctness techniques to AI-generated code, with a hackathon on May 22-24.

entry.title: Applications of the Transformer Architecture in AI-Assisted English Reading Comprehension

author.name: Ping Li

entry.summary: Studies transformer-based models for AI-assisted English reading comprehension, incorporating attention mechanisms, gradient-based attribution, and adversarial bias correction.

entry.title: Benchmarking PyCaret AutoML Against IndoBERT Fine-Tuning for Sentiment Analysis on Indonesian IKN Twitter Data

author.name: Mutia Alfi Mayzaroh, Dwi Fitria Ningsih, Nindi Destriani, Martin C. T. Manullang

entry.summary: Benchmarks PyCaret AutoML against IndoBERT fine-tuning for Indonesian sentiment analysis on IKN Twitter data. IndoBERT achieves 89.59% vs Logistic Regression's 77.57% accuracy.

entry.title: Strategy matters when someone implements it. Astra is cultivating people to do both.

author.name: Aris

entry.summary: Promotes Astra's new Strategy and Governance fellowship for AI safety, a 5-month funded program at Constellation with 25+ mentors aimed at cultivating people who can own AI safety problems end-to-end.

entry.title: Contra Binder on far-UVC and filtration

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: A technical rebuttal to Damon Binder's analysis of far-UVC vs. air filtration for pathogen control. Argues that using cheaper Aerolamp units ($500 vs $2,500), accounting for noise disadvantages of filtration, and recognizing far-UVC's superior performance in larger rooms significantly changes the cost-benefit analysis in favor of far-UVC.

entry.title: Empirical Ablation and Ensemble Optimization of a Convolutional Neural Network for CIFAR-10 Classification

author.name: Naser Khatti Dizabadi

entry.summary: Empirical ablation study of CNN optimization for CIFAR-10, testing 17 progressive modifications to a baseline model. Finds training duration helps but many structural changes add complexity without improving performance.

entry.title: Korean aegyo speech shows systematic F1 increase to signal childlike qualities

author.name: Ji-eun Kim, Volker Dellwo

entry.summary: Phonetic study of Korean aegyo speech showing systematic F1 increase across vowels to signal childlike qualities, suggesting speakers imitate shorter vocal tracts of children.

entry.title: Causal inference diary: skiing causes snow

author.name: Gretta Duleba

entry.summary: An informal diary entry about learning causal inference, exploring causal discovery on a diabetes dataset and discussing challenges with variable selection and graph identification.

entry.title: The Problem in the "Nerd Sniping" xkcd Comic

author.name: peralice

entry.summary: Discusses an XKCD physics problem about equivalent resistance in an infinite grid, explaining how random walks can be used to solve circuit resistance problems.

entry.title: A Pecking Order Problem

author.name: Sean Herrington

entry.summary: A satirical fiction piece about an AI safety organization dealing with a jailbreaker who uses the 'Chicken' programming language to convince an AI it should free all chickens worldwide, causing widespread chaos. Comedy exploring AI safety themes.

entry.title: a letter of babble

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: A literary fiction piece structured as a letter found in a library, written in the style of Borges' 'Library of Babel.' The narrator writes to someone named Letizia about language, loss, and the nature of communication within the library's framework.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 28, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A landmark day for LLM training methodology and AI safety. A bug disclosure reveals that SFT-then-RL was already optimal for LLM reasoning, invalidating mixed-policy results across multiple published papers. In learning theory, the optimal sample complexity of multiclass classification is resolved by proving a tight bound via DS dimension.

Safety & alignment dominates the research landscape:

  • Sandbagging removal via weak supervision shows promise for preventing deliberate underperformance in capable models
  • Tail risk estimation offers efficient methods for quantifying rare harmful outputs at population scale
  • Activation-level misalignment detection catches poisoning at 5% doses—10x earlier than behavioral evaluations
  • PermaFrost-Attack demonstrates stealth poisoning through web-crawled pretraining data, a novel and concerning threat vector
  • Ulterior Motives introduces detection methods for misaligned reasoning in continuous thought models that bypass legible CoT

In mechanistic understanding, hidden-state analysis reveals that individual CoT tokens encode sufficient information to recover correct answers even when surface reasoning fails. Power-law data distributions are shown to consistently outperform uniform distributions for compositional reasoning, challenging common training assumptions. The spectral lifecycle of transformer weight matrices during pretraining reveals transient compression waves and persistent Q/K–V asymmetries across model scales.

entry.title: SFT-then-RL Outperforms Mixed-Policy Methods for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Alexis Limozin, Eduard Durech, Torsten Hoefler, Imanol Schlag, Valentina Pyatkin

entry.summary: Reveals that multiple published papers claiming improvements over SFT-then-RL for LLM reasoning relied on faulty baselines caused by two bugs: a DeepSpeed optimizer bug dropping micro-batches and an OpenRLHF loss aggregation bug. After fixing these, SFT-then-RL matches or beats mixed-policy methods.

entry.title: The Optimal Sample Complexity of Multiclass and List Learning

author.name: Chirag Pabbaraju

entry.summary: Resolves the optimal sample complexity of multiclass classification by proving the maximum hypergraph density is upper-bounded by DS dimension, closing a longstanding sqrt(DS) gap between upper and lower bounds. Proves a conjecture of Daniely and Shalev-Shwartz.

entry.title: Removing Sandbagging in LLMs by Training with Weak Supervision

author.name: Emil Ryd, Henning Bartsch, Julian Stastny, Joe Benton, Vivek Hebbar

entry.summary: Studies removing sandbagging (models deliberately underperforming) using weak supervision, finding that combining SFT on weak demonstrations with RL can reliably elicit true capabilities from sandbagging model organisms on math, science, and coding tasks.

entry.title: Estimating Tail Risks in Language Model Output Distributions

author.name: Rico Angell, Raghav Singhal, Zachary Horvitz, Zhou Yu, Rajesh Ranganath, Kathleen McKeown, He He

entry.summary: Proposes a method to efficiently estimate the probability of harmful LLM outputs for any input query, addressing tail risk when models are queried billions of times daily, moving beyond distribution-of-inputs safety evaluations.

entry.title: When Chain-of-Thought Fails, the Solution Hides in the Hidden States

author.name: Houman Mehrafarin, Amit Parekh, Ioannis Konstas

entry.summary: Demonstrates through activation patching that individual Chain-of-Thought tokens encode sufficient task-relevant information to recover correct answers even when the original CoT trace is incorrect. Shows CoT tokens contain richer information than their surface text suggests.

entry.title: Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks in AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Evaluation Framework
