entry.summary: Introduces PointTransformerX (PTX), a fully PyTorch-native 3D point cloud transformer backbone that removes all custom CUDA operators, enabling portable deployment on non-NVIDIA hardware while maintaining competitive accuracy.

entry.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Jiacheng Chen, Jiaqi Tan, Yongsen Mao, Wenhu Chen, Angel X. Chang

entry.summary: Introduces ReVSI, a rebuilt evaluation benchmark for VLM 3D spatial reasoning that addresses systematic validity issues in existing benchmarks caused by annotation artifacts and frame sampling limitations.

entry.title: Global Context or Local Detail? Adaptive Visual Grounding for Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Yubo Jiang, Xin Yang, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Zheming Yuan, Xuxin Cheng, Fengying Xie, Zhiguo Jiang, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Haopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PND, a training-free decoding framework that mitigates VLM object hallucination through dual-path contrast: amplifying visual evidence (positive path) while degrading unreliable information (negative path).

entry.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark

author.name: Hongxin Li, Xiping Wang, Jingran Su, Zheng Ju, Yuntao Chen, Qing Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AutoGUI-v2, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating whether VLM-based GUI agents truly understand interface functionality and transition logic, going beyond static grounding to predictive mental models.

entry.title: NeuroClaw Technical Report

author.name: Cheng Wang, Zhibin He, Zhihao Peng, Shengyuan Liu, Yufan Hu, Lichao Sun, Xiang Li, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: NeuroClaw is a domain-specialized multi-agent research assistant for reproducible neuroimaging research that operates directly on raw neuroimaging data across modalities (sMRI, fMRI, dMRI, EEG). It integrates environment management with Docker support and automated pipelines for executable and reproducible workflows.

entry.title: DeepSignature: Digitally Signed, Content-Encoding Watermarks for Robust and Transparent Image Authentication

author.name: Mathias Graf, Marco Willi, Melanie Mathys, Michael Aerni, Christian Schwarzer, Martin Melchior, Michael H. Graber

entry.summary: DeepSignature integrates digital signatures with deep neural networks for image watermarking, enabling cryptographically verifiable source attribution and integrity validation. Neural networks generate content-encoding watermarks that are imperceptibly embedded and robustly extractable.

entry.title: SeaEvo: Advancing Algorithm Discovery with Strategy Space Evolution

author.name: Sichun Luo, Yi Huang, Haochen Luo, Fengyuan Liu, Guanzhi Deng, Lei Li, Qinghua Yao, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu

entry.summary: SeaEvo introduces a strategy-space layer for LLM-guided evolutionary search that organizes natural-language strategy descriptions into a population-level structure. This helps distinguish syntactically different implementations of the same idea and preserves strategically promising but lower-fitness directions.

entry.title: RecoverFormer: End-to-End Contact-Aware Recovery for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Zihui Liu

entry.summary: RecoverFormer is an end-to-end humanoid recovery policy using a causal transformer over observation history with novel latent recovery mode and contact affordance heads. It learns to switch among recovery behaviors (stepping, hand contact, center-of-mass reshaping) under model mismatch.

entry.title: Tube Diffusion Policy: Reactive Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for Contact-rich Manipulation

author.name: Teng Xue, Alberto Rigo, Bingjian Huang, Jiayi Shen, Zhengtong Xu, Nick Colonnese, Amirhossein H. Memar

entry.summary: Tube Diffusion Policy proposes a reactive visual-tactile policy learning framework for contact-rich manipulation that addresses the reactivity limitations of action chunking. Enables rapid response to unforeseen observations during execution using tactile feedback.

entry.title: AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation

author.name: Kai Yang, Zedong Chu, Yingnan Guo, Zhengbo Wang, Shichao Xie, Yanfen Shen, Xiaolong Wu, Xing Li, Mu Xu

entry.summary: AsyncShield addresses the latency and jitter issues of cloud-deployed VLA models for mobile navigation by using deterministic physical spatial mapping instead of time-series prediction. Provides a plug-and-play framework that corrects spatiotemporal misalignment from stale cloud inferences.

entry.title: Instrumental Variable Analysis Without Structural Equations

author.name: Zikai Shen, Dimitri Meunier, Houssam Zenati, Arthur Gretton, Nathan Kallus, Aur\'elien Bibaut

entry.summary: Develops a framework for instrumental variable analysis that avoids assuming structural equations have exact solutions. Inference targets a quantity that coincides with usual estimands when solutions exist but remains well-defined otherwise, making IV analysis more robust.

entry.title: Fail safe(r) at alignment by channeling reward-hacking into a "spillway" motivation

author.name: Anders Cairns Woodruff

entry.summary: Proposes 'spillway design' - deliberately channeling reward-hacking into a curated bundle of benign motivations rather than trying to eliminate it entirely. Argues this could decrease worst-case outcomes and enable inference-time correction via satiation of benign reward-seeking traits.

entry.title: QuantClaw: Precision Where It Matters for OpenClaw

author.name: Manyi Zhang, Ji-Fu Li, Zhongao Sun, Xiaohao Liu, Zhenhua Dong, Xianzhi Yu, Haoli Bai, Xiaobo Xia

entry.summary: Proposes QuantClaw, a plug-and-play precision routing plugin for the OpenClaw agent system that dynamically assigns quantization precision based on task characteristics, reducing costs while maintaining performance on complex workflows.

entry.title: Foundation models for discovering robust biomarkers of neurological disorders from dynamic functional connectivity

author.name: Deepank Girish, Yi Hao Chan, Sukrit Gupta, Jing Xia, Jagath C. Rajapakse

entry.summary: Proposes RE-CONFIRM, a framework for evaluating the robustness of potential biomarker candidates identified by deep learning models including brain foundation models, tested across five large datasets of neurological disorders.

entry.title: Optimal Question Selection from a Large Question Bank for Clinical Field Recovery in Conversational Psychiatric Intake

author.name: Guan Gui, Peter Zandi, Jacob Taylor, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Formulates psychiatric intake as a question-selection problem with a benchmark of 655 clinician-authored questions and synthetic patient vignettes, evaluating LLM-based conversational AI for structured clinical information gathering.

entry.title: ResRank: Unifying Retrieval and Listwise Reranking via End-to-End Joint Training with Residual Passage Compression

author.name: Xiaojie Ke, Shuai Zhang, Liansheng Sun, Yongjin Wang, Hengjun Jiang, Xiangkun Liu, Cunxin Gu, Jian Xu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Presents ResRank, a unified retrieval-reranking framework that compresses passages into compact token representations for LLM-based listwise reranking, addressing both the 'lost in the middle' phenomenon and inference latency.

entry.title: Preserve Support, Not Correspondence: Dynamic Routing for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhancun Mu, Guangyu Zhao, Yiwu Zhong, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DROL, a latent-conditioned one-step actor for offline RL that uses top-1 dynamic routing to separately optimize Q-value improvement and data support preservation, avoiding the compromise forced by paired training.

entry.title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jichao Wang, Liuyang Bian, Yufeng Zhou, Han Xiao, Yue Pan, Guozhi Wang, Hao Wang, Zhaoxiong Wang, Yafei Wen, Xiaoxin Chen, Shuai Ren, Lingfang Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes SOLAR-RL, a semi-online RL framework for training MLLM GUI agents that bridges offline and online RL by integrating trajectory-level semantics without full online interaction costs. Addresses task completion and execution quality in dynamic GUI navigation.

entry.title: Aligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via DistillationAligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via Distillation

author.name: Rajinder Sandhu, Di Mu, Cheng Chang, Md Shahriar Tasjid, Himanshu Rai, Maksims Volkovs, Ga Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Utility-Aligned Embeddings (UAE) for RAG that trains a bi-encoder to imitate utility distributions from LLM perplexity reduction. Uses a Utility-Modulated InfoNCE objective to inject graded utility signals into dense retrieval.

entry.title: CODA: Coordination via On-Policy Diffusion for Multi-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Marcel Hedman, Kale-ab Abebe Tessera, Juan Claude Formanek, Anya Sims, Riccardo Zamboni, Trevor McInroe, John Torr, Elliot Fosong

entry.summary: Introduces CODA, a diffusion-based multi-agent trajectory generator for offline MARL that generates synthetic experience conditioned on the current joint policy to enable co-adaptation. Addresses coordination failure from static off-policy data.

entry.title: When Does Removing LayerNorm Help? Activation Bounding as a Regime-Dependent Implicit Regularizer

author.name: Lucky Verma

entry.summary: Studies when Dynamic Tanh (DyT) as LayerNorm replacement helps vs hurts, showing it's a regime-dependent implicit regularizer. DyT improves in low-data regimes but worsens in high-data settings; benefits diminish with scale.

entry.title: On the Memorization of Consistency Distillation for Diffusion Models

author.name: Bingqing Jiang, Difan Zou

entry.summary: Analyzes how consistency distillation reshapes memorization behavior in diffusion models, showing that distillation can amplify or restructure memorization from teacher models in ways not previously understood.

entry.title: OptProver: Bridging Olympiad and Optimization through Continual Training in Formal Theorem Proving

author.name: Chenyi Li, Yanchen Nie, Zhengyu Ming, Gong Zhang, Kun Yuan, Zaiwen Wen

entry.summary: Presents OptProver, a formal theorem prover that transfers from Olympiad-level math to undergraduate optimization through continual training with optimization-focused data curation, addressing distribution shift between mathematical domains.

entry.title: Learning Interpretable PDE Representations for Generative Reconstructions with Structured Sparsity

author.name: Valerie Tsao, Nathaniel Chaney, Manolis Veveakis

entry.summary: Introduces LatentPDE, a latent diffusion framework where latent variables are directly parameterized as PDE coefficients and source terms, enabling interpretable physics-compliant reconstruction from sparse observations with super-resolution.

entry.title: When to Commit? Towards Variable-Size Self-Contained Blocks for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Danny Wang, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: Introduces self-containedness as a principled criterion for deciding when to commit token blocks in discrete diffusion language models, addressing the training-inference mismatch in blockwise semi-autoregressive decoding.

entry.title: Coverage-Based Calibration for Post-Training Quantization via Weighted Set Cover over Outlier Channels

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Formulates PTQ calibration sample selection as a weighted set cover problem over outlier channels, ensuring calibration data activates critical high-magnitude channels that dominate quantization error.

entry.title: Latent-Hysteresis Graph ODEs: Modeling Coupled Topology-Feature Evolution via Continuous Phase Transitions

author.name: Qinhan Hou, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Hysteresis Graph ODE (HGODE) that couples feature evolution with latent topological potential through double-well edge potentials, overcoming the monostability trap where Graph ODEs converge to global consensus.

entry.title: Efficient learning by implicit exploration in bandit problems with side observations

author.name: Tomas Kocak, Gergely Neu, Michal Valko, Remi Munos

entry.summary: Proposes an algorithm for online learning with partial observability and side observations that achieves near-optimal regret without requiring advance knowledge of the observation system, extending to combinatorial optimization settings.

entry.title: Diffusion-Guided Feature Selection via Nishimori Temperature: Noise-Based Spectral Embedding

author.name: Vasiliy S. Usatyuk, Denis A. Sapozhnikov, Sergey I. Egorov

entry.summary: Proposes Noise-Based Spectral Embedding (NBSE), a physics-informed feature selection framework using Nishimori temperature and Bethe Hessian singularity to identify informative features without greedy search in high-dimensional data.

entry.title: Audio2Tool: Bridging Spoken Language Understanding and Function Calling

author.name: Ramit Pahwa, Apoorva Beedu, Parivesh Priye, Rutu Gandhi, Saloni Takawale, Aruna Baijal, Zengli Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Audio2Tool, a large-scale benchmark of ~30,000 queries for evaluating tool-calling capabilities of speech language models across smart car, smart home, and wearables domains with multi-tier complexity.

entry.title: Large language model-enabled automated data extraction for concrete materials informatics

author.name: Zhanzhao Li, Kengran Yang, Qiyao He, Kai Gong

entry.summary: Introduces an LLM-powered pipeline for automated extraction of materials data from scientific literature, achieving F1 of 0.97 and extracting 9,000 records with 100+ attributes from 27,000 publications in one hour for concrete materials.

entry.title: MOCA: A Transformer-based Modular Causal Inference Framework with One-way Cross-attention and Cutting Feedback

author.name: Lei Wang, Debashis Ghosh

entry.summary: Proposes MOCA, a transformer-based causal inference framework with modular separation of treatment and outcome modeling via one-way cross-attention, preventing outcome information from contaminating treatment representations.

entry.title: Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers

author.name: Aryan Sharma, Cutter Dawes, Shivam Raval

entry.summary: Examines whether decodable representations in transformers trained on Dyck language (balanced brackets) are causally used. Finds that depth, distance, and top-of-stack signals are all decodable, but their causal roles diverge - attention to matching brackets is causally necessary while depth information is not.

entry.title: SHAPE: Unifying Safety, Helpfulness and Pedagogy for Educational LLMs

author.name: Sihang (Nagi), Zhao, Kangrui Yu, Youliang Yuan, Pinjia He, Hongyi Wen

entry.summary: Identifies 'pedagogical jailbreaks' where students trick educational LLMs into giving answers rather than scaffolded instruction. Introduces SHAPE benchmark (9,087 student-question pairs) and a graph-augmented tutoring pipeline using knowledge-mastery graphs.

entry.title: MetaEarth3D: Unlocking World-scale 3D Generation with Spatially Scalable Generative Modeling

author.name: Jinqi Cao, Zhiping Yu, Baihong Lin, Chenyang Liu, Zhenwei Shi, Zhengxia Zou

entry.summary: Introduces MetaEarth3D for world-scale 3D generation from satellite imagery, arguing that spatial scale should be a core dimension of generative AI intelligence. Addresses the gap in modeling geographic environments across thousands of kilometers.

entry.title: Unified Multi-Foundation-Model Slide Representation for Pan-Cancer Recognition and Text-Guided Tumor Localization

author.name: Tianyang Wang, Ziyu Su, Abdul Rehman Akbar, Usama Sajjad, Lina Gokhale, Charles Rabolli, Wei Chen, Anil Parwani, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Presents ASTRA, a pan-cancer framework integrating heterogeneous pathology foundation model representations into unified slide-level embeddings through mixture-of-experts, masked reconstruction, and contrastive alignment with structured pathology prompts.

entry.title: BrickNet: Graph-Backed Generative Brick Assembly

author.name: Peter Kulits, Cordelia Schmid

entry.summary: BrickNet trains a language model on 100K+ human-designed LEGO objects to generate brick build sequences, using graph-based representations to handle thousands of part types with diverse connection semantics and physical constraints.

entry.title: Identity-Decoupled Anonymization for Visual Evidence in Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes identity-decoupled anonymization for visual evidence in multimodal RAG systems, using a disentangled variational encoder to separate identity from attribute codes while preserving non-identity visual cues.

entry.title: Hallo-Live: Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Video Avatar Generation with Asynchronous Dual-Stream and Human-Centric Preference Distillation

author.name: Chunyu Li, Jiaye Li, Ruiqiao Mei, Haoyuan Xia, Hao Zhu, Jingdong Wang, Siyu Zhu

entry.summary: Hallo-Live is a streaming framework for real-time joint audio-visual avatar generation using asynchronous dual-stream diffusion with Future-Expanding Attention for reduced articulation lag.

entry.title: DynProto: Dynamic Prototype Evolution for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Yanqi Wu, Xinhua Lu, Runhe Lai, Qichao Chen, Jia-Xin Zhuang, Wei-Shi Zheng, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DynProto for OOD detection in VLMs that dynamically learns OOD prototypes during testing using only in-distribution information, addressing the limitation of predefined OOD label sets.

entry.title: Latent Inter-Frame Pruning: A Training-Free Method Bridging Traditional Video Compression and Modern Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Generation

author.name: Dennis Menn, Chih-Hsien Chou

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Inter-frame Pruning, a training-free method that reduces video generation computation by pruning redundant latent patches across frames, drawing analogy to traditional video compression.

entry.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Ashish Seth, Xinhao Mei, Changsheng Zhao, Varun Nagaraja, Ernie Chang, Gregory P. Meyer, Gael Le Lan, Yunyang Xiong, Vikas Chandra, Yangyang Shi, Dinesh Manocha, Zhipeng Cai

entry.summary: Presents a systematic evaluation framework for audio hallucination in egocentric video understanding, showing that large audio-visual language models often hallucinate sounds from visual cues that are visible but not actually heard.

entry.title: SMoES: Soft Modality-Guided Expert Specialization in MoE-VLMs

author.name: Zi-Hao Bo, Yaqian Li, Anzhou Hou, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Ertao Zhao, Tianxiang Pan, Jiale Yan, Mo Guang, Kaiwen Long

entry.summary: Proposes SMoES for MoE-based VLMs, introducing soft modality-guided expert specialization with dynamic modality scores, expert binning, and mutual information regularization for better expert routing.

entry.title: Robust Deepfake Detection, NTIRE 2026 Challenge: Report

author.name: Benedikt Hopf, Radu Timofte, Chenfan Qu, Junchi Li, Fei Wu, Dagong Lu, Mufeng Yao, Xinlei Xu, Fengjun Guo, Yongwei Tang, Zhiqiang Yang, Zhiqiang Wu, Jia Wen Seow, Hong Vin Koay, Haodong Ren, Feng Xu, Shuai Chen, Minh-Khoa Le-Phan, Minh-Hoang Le, Trong-Le Do, Minh-Triet Tran, Chih-Yu Jian, Yi-Fan Wang, Bang-Kang Chen, You-Chen Chao, Chia-Ming Lee, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Chih-Chung Hsu, Aashish Negi, Hardik Sharma, Prateek Shaily, Jayant Kumar, Sachin Chaudhary, Akshay Dudhane, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla, Jielun Peng, Yabin Wang, Yaqi Li, Jincheng Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Krish Wadhwani, Liam Fitzpatrick, Utkarsh Tiwari, Bilel Benjdira, Anas M. Ali, Wadii Boulila, Cristian Lazo Quispe, Aishwarya A, Akshara S, Ashwathi N, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi

entry.summary: Reports on the NTIRE 2026 Robust Deepfake Detection Challenge, evaluating detectors under common and uncommon image degradations. Provides an overview of participating methods and findings about detection robustness.

entry.title: See Further, Think Deeper: Advancing VLM's Reasoning Ability with Low-level Visual Cues and Reflection

author.name: Zhiheng Wu, Tong Wang, Shuning Wang, Naiming Liu, Yumeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ForeSight, a VLM reasoning framework that integrates low-level visual tools and mask-based visual feedback to enable VLMs to reason with fine-grained visual information through reinforcement learning.

entry.title: TextGround4M: A Prompt-Aligned Dataset for Layout-Aware Text Rendering

author.name: Dongxing Mao, Yilin Wang, Linjie Li, Zhengyuan Yang, Alex Jinpeng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces TextGround4M, a 4M+ prompt-image pair dataset with span-level text grounding and bounding box annotations for layout-aware text rendering, plus a lightweight training strategy for existing models.

entry.title: PhysCodeBench: Benchmarking Physics-Aware Symbolic Simulation of 3D Scenes via Self-Corrective Multi-Agent Refinement

author.name: Tianyidan Xie, Peiyu Wang, Yuyi Qian, Yuxuan Wang, Rui Ma, Ying Tai, Song Wu, Qian Wang, Lanjun Wang, Zili Yi

entry.summary: PhysCodeBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating physics-aware symbolic simulation code generation, comprising 700 manually-crafted samples across mechanics, fluid dynamics, and soft-body physics. Evaluates both code executability and physical accuracy.

entry.title: Pedestrians play chicken with an autonomous vehicle

author.name: Rakshit Soni, Charles Fox

entry.summary: First real-world demonstration of the Sequential Chicken game theory model for AV-pedestrian interaction, showing that AVs can resolve the Freezing Robot Problem by trading credible small collision risks against yielding delays with human subjects.

entry.title: An Artifact-based Agent Framework for Adaptive and Reproducible Medical Image Processing

author.name: Lianrui Zuo, Yihao Liu, Gaurav Rudravaram, Karthik Ramadass, Aravind R. Krishnan, Michael D. Phillips, Yelena G. Bodien, Mayur B. Patel, Paula Trujillo, Yency Forero Martinez, Stephen A. Deppen, Eric L. Grogan, Fabien Maldonado, Kevin McGann, Hudson M. Holmes, Laurie E. Cutting, Yuankai Huo, Bennett A. Landman

entry.summary: Presents an artifact-based agent framework for medical image processing that formalizes intermediate outputs as semantic artifacts, enabling adaptability to dataset-specific conditions and full reproducibility of analytical workflows.

entry.title: The Biggest Risk of Embodied AI is Governance Lag

author.name: Shaoshan Liu

entry.summary: Argues that the biggest risk of embodied AI is governance lag—the inability of public institutions to keep pace with AI deployment in the physical economy—identifying three forms: observational, institutional, and distributive lag.

entry.title: Shard the Gradient, Scale the Model: Serverless Federated Aggregation via Gradient Partitioning

author.name: Amine Barrak

entry.summary: Proposes GradsSharding for federated learning on serverless platforms, partitioning gradient tensors across functions rather than clients, enabling scaling past memory limits while producing bit-identical results to tree-based approaches.

entry.title: Towards Safe Mobility: A Unified Transportation Foundation Model enabled by Open-Ended Vision-Language Dataset

author.name: Wenhui Huang, Songyan Zhang, Collister Chua, Yang Liang, Zhiqi Mao, Heng Yang, Chen Lv

entry.summary: Introduces the Land Transportation Dataset (LTD) and a unified transportation foundation model for safety-oriented visual question answering over roadside camera observations, addressing city-scale traffic analysis beyond autonomous driving.

entry.title: ChangeQuery: Advancing Remote Sensing Change Analysis for Natural and Human-Induced Disasters from Visual Detection to Semantic Understanding

author.name: Dongwei Sun, Jing Yao, Kan Wei, Xiangyong Cao, Chen Wu, Zhenghui Zhao, Pedram Ghamisi, Jun Zhou, J\'on Atli Benediktsson

entry.summary: Presents ChangeQuery, a multimodal framework for disaster situation awareness using remote sensing, with a new dataset (DICQ) for all-weather disaster-induced change detection and semantic analysis beyond simple pixel-level detection.

entry.title: CGC: Compositional Grounded Contrast for Fine-Grained Multi-Image Understanding

author.name: Lihao Zheng, Zhenwei Shao, Yu Zhou, Yan Yang, Xintian Shen, Jiawei Chen, Hao Ma, Tao Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Compositional Grounded Contrast (CGC), a framework for improving fine-grained multi-image understanding in MLLMs without expensive human annotations. Uses inter-image and intra-image contrast from single-image grounding annotations to address spatial hallucination and attention leakage.

entry.title: Shape of Memory: a Geometric Analysis of Machine Unlearning in Second-Order Optimizers

author.name: Kennon Stewart

entry.summary: Argues that current machine unlearning definitions are underspecified for second-order optimizers, showing that second-order methods retain residual geometric information in optimizer state that first-order analysis cannot detect.

entry.title: ProEval: Proactive Failure Discovery and Efficient Performance Estimation for Generative AI Evaluation

author.name: Yizheng Huang, Wenjun Zeng, Aditi Kumaresan, Zi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ProEval, a proactive evaluation framework using Gaussian Process surrogates for efficient generative AI evaluation. Frames performance estimation as Bayesian quadrature and failure discovery as superlevel set sampling.

entry.title: h-MINT: Modeling Pocket-Ligand Binding with Hierarchical Molecular Interaction Network

author.name: Yanru Qu, Yijie Zhang, Wenjuan Tan, Xiangzhe Kong, Xiangxin Zhou, Chaoran Cheng, Mathieu Blanchette, Jiaxuan You, Ge Liu

entry.summary: Proposes h-MINT with OverlapBPE tokenization for molecular representation that preserves chirality, aromaticity, and ionic states. Models pocket-ligand binding with hierarchical molecular interaction networks.

entry.title: Hamiltonian Graph Inference Networks: Joint structure discovery and dynamics prediction for lattice Hamiltonian systems from trajectory data

author.name: Ru Geng, Panayotis Kevrekidis, Yixian Gao, Hong-Kun Zhang, Jian Zu

entry.summary: Introduces Hamiltonian Graph Inference Network (HGIN) that jointly recovers interaction graphs and predicts long-time trajectories from state data alone, handling both separable and non-separable Hamiltonians with heterogeneous node dynamics.

entry.title: Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)

author.name: Nicola Zanarini, Niccol\`o Ferrari

entry.summary: Proposes Graph Memory Transformer (GMT) replacing FFN layers with an explicit learned memory graph of centroids connected by a directed transition matrix, using gravitational source routing for token-to-centroid interaction.

entry.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents

author.name: Jiaqi Wang, Wenhao Zhang, Weijie Shi, Yaliang Li, James Cheng

entry.summary: Identifies Trajectory-Level KL Instability in on-policy distillation for multi-turn agents and proposes temporal curriculum (TCOD) to address inter-turn error compounding by progressively increasing task difficulty.

entry.title: Progressive Approximation in Deep Residual Networks: Theory and Validation

author.name: Wei Wang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proves existence of progressive approximation trajectories in residual networks where error decreases monotonically with depth, and proposes Layer-wise Progressive Approximation (LPA) training that aligns each layer with its residual target.

entry.title: Meta-Aligner: Bidirectional Preference-Policy Optimization for Multi-Objective LLMs Alignment

author.name: Wenzhe Xu, Biao Liu, Yiyang Sun, Xin Geng, Ning Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-Aligner (Meal), a bi-level meta-learning framework for multi-objective LLM alignment that enables bidirectional optimization between preferences and policy responses via a learned preference-weight-net.

entry.title: PathMoG: A Pathway-Centric Modular Graph Neural Network for Multi-Omics Survival Prediction

author.name: Di Wang, Chupei Tang, Junxiao Kong, Jixiu Zhai, Moyu Tang, Tianchi Lu

entry.summary: Proposes PathMoG, a pathway-centric graph neural network for cancer survival prediction from multi-omics data, organizing inputs into 354 KEGG pathway modules with hierarchical modulation and dual-level attention. Evaluated on 5,650 patients across 10 cancer types.

entry.title: Sliced Wasserstein Steering between Gaussian Measures

author.name: Kaito Ito, Anqi Dong

entry.summary: Develops a sliced Wasserstein feedback controller for distribution steering that projects onto one-dimensional directions, synthesizes optimal 1D velocity, and averages to produce ambient-space control, reducing computational complexity.

entry.title: Shape: A Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Foundation Model for Industrial CAD Analysis

author.name: Bayangmbe Mounmo, Sam Chien, Mile Mitrovic

entry.summary: Introduces Shape, a self-supervised 3D geometry foundation model for industrial CAD analysis that converts surface meshes into dense embeddings using a multi-scale geometry-aware tokenizer and transformer, pretrained on 61K CAD meshes.

entry.title: FastAT Benchmark: A Comprehensive Framework for Fair Evaluation of Fast Adversarial Training Methods

author.name: Chao Pan, Xin Yao

entry.summary: Introduces the FastAT Benchmark for fair evaluation of fast adversarial training methods, enforcing unified architecture, standardized configurations, and controlled experimental conditions to isolate genuine algorithmic advances.

entry.title: Efficient Rationale-based Retrieval: On-policy Distillation from Generative Rerankers based on JEPA

author.name: Teng Chen, Sheng Xu, Feixiang Guo, Xiaoyu Wang, Qingqing Gu, Hongyan Li, Luo Ji

entry.summary: Proposes Rabtriever, which distills cross-encoder reranking capabilities into a bi-encoder architecture using JEPA-inspired on-policy distillation from an LLM-based generative reranker, enabling efficient rationale-based retrieval without cross-encoding at inference.

entry.title: Inference of Online Newton Methods with Nesterov's Accelerated Sketching

author.name: Haoxuan Wang, Xinchen Du, Sen Na

entry.summary: Studies online Newton methods with Hessian averaging where Newton directions are approximately computed using Nesterov-accelerated sketch-and-project solvers, achieving reduced computational complexity while maintaining statistical inference quality.

entry.title: Integrative neurocybernetic modeling in the era of large-scale neuroscience

author.name: Il Memming Park, Ayesha Vermani, Gonzalo G. de Polavieja, Juan \'Alvaro Gallego, Kathleen Esfahany, Shreya Saxena, Michael Orger, Auke Ijspeert, Matthew Dowling, Daniel McNamee, Srinivas C. Turaga, Zachary Mainen, Joseph J. Paton, Alfonso Renart

entry.summary: Argues for integrative neurocybernetic models that capture closed-loop brain-body-environment coupling, treating the brain as a controller pursuing latent objectives. Outlines a practical route combining nonlinear state-space models with large-scale neural data.

entry.title: The Price of Agreement: Measuring LLM Sycophancy in Agentic Financial Applications

author.name: Zhenyu Zhao, Aparna Balagopalan, Adi Agrawal, Dilshoda Yergasheva, Waseem Alshikh, Daniel M. Bikel

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM sycophancy specifically in agentic financial applications, finding models show only low to modest performance drops from user contradictions - different from general-domain findings. Introduces new metrics for measuring financial sycophancy.

entry.title: Context-Fidelity Boosting: Enhancing Faithful Generation through Watermark-Inspired Decoding

author.name: Weixu Zhang, Fanghua Ye, Qiang Gao, Jian Li, Haolun Wu, Yuxing Tian, Sijing Duan, Nan Du, Xiaolong Li, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Context-Fidelity Boosting (CFB), a decoding-time framework that reduces faithfulness hallucinations by applying additive logit adjustments to tokens based on their support from input context, inspired by watermarking techniques.

entry.title: LayerBoost: Layer-Aware Attention Reduction for Efficient LLMs

author.name: Mohamed Ali Souibgui, Jan Fostier, Rodrigo Abad\'ia-Heredia, Bohdan Denysenko, Christian Marschke, Igor Peric

entry.summary: Proposes LayerBoost, which selectively replaces softmax attention with linear attention based on layer sensitivity analysis, rather than applying uniform replacement. Shows this targeted approach maintains performance while reducing computational cost.

entry.title: BSViT: A Burst Spiking Vision Transformer for Expressive and Efficient Visual Representation Learning

author.name: Hongxiang Peng, Dewei Bai, Hong Qu

entry.summary: BSViT proposes a burst spiking Vision Transformer with dual-channel burst spiking self-attention (DBSSA) that enhances representational capacity while maintaining spike-based computation for energy efficiency.

entry.title: MotionHiFlow: Text-to-motion via hierarchical flow matching

author.name: Heng Li, Xiaotong Lin, Ling-An Zeng, Yulei Kang, Shuai Li, Jian-Fang Hu

entry.summary: MotionHiFlow is a hierarchical flow matching framework for text-to-motion generation that progressively generates motion from low to high temporal scales, capturing both high-level semantics and fine details.

entry.title: Learning from Noisy Prompts: Saliency-Guided Prompt Distillation for Robust Segmentation with SAM

author.name: Jingxuan Kang, Ziqi Zhang, Shaoming Zheng, Shuang Li, Uday Bharat Patel, Alexander Harry Fitzhugh, Phillip Lung, Yusuf Kiberu, Nikesh Jathanna, Shahnaz Jamil-Copley, Bernhard Kainz, Chen Qin

entry.summary: SPD introduces saliency-guided prompt distillation to make SAM robust to noisy, weak clinical prompts. Learns anatomical priors through a lightweight saliency head to convert unreliable cues into robust guidance.

entry.title: PhysLayer: Language-Guided Layered Animation with Depth-Aware Physics

author.name: Tianyidan Xie, Zhentao Huang, Mingjie Wang, Xin Huang, Jun Zhou, Minglun Gong, Zili Yi

entry.summary: PhysLayer enables language-guided depth-aware layered animation of static images using physics simulation, decomposing scenes into depth-based layers and extending 2D rigid-body dynamics to 2.5D.

entry.title: RaV-IDP: A Reconstruction-as-Validation Framework for Faithful Intelligent Document Processing

author.name: Pritesh Jha

entry.summary: RaV-IDP introduces reconstruction as validation for document processing—after extracting entities, a reconstruction module regenerates the source document to verify extraction fidelity, providing a self-checking mechanism.

entry.title: MuSS: A Large-Scale Dataset and Cinematic Narrative Benchmark for Multi-Shot Subject-to-Video Generation

author.name: Haojie Zhang, Di Wu, Bingyan Liu, Linjie Zhong, Yuancheng Wei, Xingsong Ye, Nanqing Liu, Yaling Liang

entry.summary: Introduces MuSS, a large-scale dataset from 3,000+ movies for multi-shot subject-to-video generation, addressing gaps in cinematic narrative logic and spatiotemporal text-video alignment for video generation.

entry.title: Risk-Aware Robust Learning: Reducing Clinical Risk under Label Noise in Medical Image Classification

author.name: Maycon R. S. Pereira, Filipe R. Cordeiro

entry.summary: Investigates whether noise-robust training methods preserve clinical safety under label noise in medical imaging, proposing a risk-aware evaluation focusing on asymmetric error costs where false negatives are more dangerous.

entry.title: LearnPruner: Rethinking Attention-based Token Pruning in Vision Language Models

author.name: Rinyoichi Takezoe, Yaqian Li, Zihao Bo, Anzhou Hou, Mo Guang, Kaiwen Long

entry.summary: Analyzes attention mechanisms in VLMs for token pruning, finding vision encoders suffer from attention sink while LLM attention patterns vary by layer. Proposes LearnPruner with learnable scoring to improve visual token pruning.

entry.title: LAVA: Layered Audio-Visual Anti-tampering Watermarking for Robust Deepfake Detection and Localization

author.name: Bokang Zeng, Zheng Gao, Xiaoyu Li, Xiaoyan Feng, Jiaojiao Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes LAVA, a layered audio-visual watermarking framework for deepfake detection that fuses audio and visual evidence with calibration-aware design to maintain robustness under real-world compression.

entry.title: SemiSAM-O1: How far can we push the boundary of annotation-efficient medical image segmentation?

author.name: Yichi Zhang, Le Xue, Bichun Xu, Judong Luo, Zhigang Wu, Yu Fu, Zixin Hu, Yuan Cheng, Yuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes SemiSAM-O1, a semi-supervised medical image segmentation framework using only one annotated template image, extending foundation model-driven SSL to extreme low-annotation settings.

entry.title: Bridging Restoration and Generation Manifolds in One-Step Diffusion for Real-World Super-Resolution

author.name: Shyang-En Weng, Yi-Cheng Liao, Yu-Syuan Xu, Wei-Chen Chiu, Ching-Chun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes IDaS-SR, a one-step diffusion framework for real-world super-resolution that bridges deterministic restoration and stochastic generation manifolds through adaptive inversion and degradation-aware sampling.

entry.title: Majorization-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models under Modality-Specific Shift

author.name: Lixian Chen, Mingxuan Huang, Yanhui Chen, Junyi Lin, Yang Shi

entry.summary: MG-MTTA addresses test-time adaptation for vision-language models when visual and textual branches shift asymmetrically. It uses a majorization view of multimodal posteriors to cast adaptation as a constrained de-mixing problem, updating only lightweight gates while keeping the backbone frozen.

entry.title: SwarmDrive: Semantic V2V Coordination for Latency-Constrained Cooperative Autonomous Driving

author.name: Anjie Qiu, Donglin Wang, Zexin Fang, Sanket Partani, Hans D. Schotten

entry.summary: SwarmDrive proposes V2V coordination for autonomous driving where nearby vehicles run local Small Language Models and share compact intent distributions when uncertainty is high. Evaluated in occluded intersection scenarios, raising success from 68.9% to 94.1% while reducing latency.

entry.title: Learning from the Best: Smoothness-Driven Metrics for Data Quality in Imitation Learning

author.name: Soham Kulkarni, Raayan Dhar, Yuchen Cui

entry.summary: RINSE proposes lightweight trajectory smoothness-based metrics for scoring demonstration quality in behavioral cloning, grounded in motor control theory. It operates on trajectory data alone without requiring policy training in the loop or manual annotation.

entry.title: Learning from Demonstration with Failure Awareness for Safe Robot Navigation

author.name: Xianghui Wang, Siwei Cheng, Shanze Wang, Xinming Zhang, Dan Zhang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a failure-aware learning framework for robot navigation that explicitly decouples the roles of successful and failure demonstrations. Failure data informs unsafe regions without being used for action imitation, addressing the distribution limitation of demonstration-only learning.

entry.title: Multi-Robot Motions in Milliseconds: Vector-Accelerated Primitives for Sampling-Based Planning

author.name: James D. Motes, Marco Morales, Nancy M. Amato

entry.summary: Extends the VAMP framework to multi-robot motion planning with vector-accelerated primitives exploiting SIMD parallelism, achieving over 1100X speedup in validation time and multi-robot solutions in milliseconds.

entry.title: When Does Dynamic Preconditioning Preserve the Polyak-Ruppert CLT? A Stabilization Threshold

author.name: Sunyoung An, Xiaoming Huo

entry.summary: Identifies an exact stabilization-rate threshold for when dynamic preconditioning preserves the Polyak-Ruppert central limit theorem. Shows that if the preconditioner stabilizes faster than a critical rate, asymptotic normality is preserved, enabling valid online inference with adaptive methods.

entry.title: AI might surprise itself by going rogue

author.name: David Scott Krueger

entry.summary: David Krueger outlines three mechanisms by which AI could suddenly 'go rogue': scheming, extended reflection leading to value change, and novel experiences triggering new goals. Emphasizes the understudied scenario where AI surprises itself with rogue behavior.

entry.title: Multi-Task Optimization over Networks of Tasks

author.name: Julian Hatzky, Thomas Bartz-Beielstein, A. E. Eiben, Anil Yaman

entry.summary: Introduces MONET, a multi-task optimization algorithm that models the task space as a graph to enable knowledge transfer between related tasks, scaling beyond the limitations of MAP-Elites variants.

entry.title: A Probabilistic Framework for Hierarchical Goal Recognition

author.name: Chenyuan Zhang, Katherine Ip, Hamid Rezatofighi, Buser Say, Mor Vered

entry.summary: Introduces the first planning-based probabilistic framework for hierarchical goal recognition over Hierarchical Task Networks (HTNs), combining hierarchical task structure with probabilistic inference for inferring agent goals from observations.

entry.title: Distance-Misaligned Training in Graph Transformers and Adaptive Graph-Aware Control

author.name: Qinhan Hou, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Studies distance-misaligned training in Graph Transformers, where the model's communication pattern mismatches where label-relevant information lies, and proposes adaptive graph-aware control to match task locality.

entry.title: MTServe: Efficient Serving for Generative Recommendation Models with Hierarchical Caches

author.name: Xin Wang, Chi Ma, Shaobin Chen, Pu Wang, Menglei Zhou, Junyi Qiu, Qiaorui Chen, Jiayu Sun, Shijie Liu, Zehuan Wang, Lei Yu, Chuan Liu, Fei Jiang, Wei Lin, Hao Wang, Jiawei Jiang, Xiao Yan

entry.summary: Proposes MTServe, a hierarchical cache management system for generative recommendation models that virtualizes GPU memory using host RAM as backup. Includes hybrid storage layout, async transfer, and locality-driven replacement.

entry.title: Stochastic simultaneous optimistic optimization

author.name: Michal Valko, Alexandra Carpentier, R\'emi Munos

entry.summary: Presents StoSOO, an algorithm for global optimization of locally smooth functions under noisy evaluations that doesn't require knowledge of the smoothness semi-metric, achieving near-optimal performance through optimistic hierarchical partitioning.

entry.title: A Parametric Memory Head for Continual Generative Retrieval

author.name: Kidist Amde Mekonnen, Yubao Tang, Maarten de Rijke

entry.summary: Proposes a parametric memory head for continual generative retrieval that addresses catastrophic forgetting when document collections are updated, maintaining stability-plasticity balance through post-adaptive memory mechanisms.

entry.title: FlowPlace: Flow Matching for Chip Placement

author.name: Peng Xie, Ke Xue, Yunqi Shi, Ruo-Tong Chen, Chengrui Gao, Siyuan Xu, Chenjian Ding, Mingxuan Yuan, Chao Qian

entry.summary: Proposes FlowPlace for chip placement using flow matching with mask-guided synthetic data, flexible prior injection, and hard constraint sampling for overlap-free layouts, achieving 10-50x faster sampling than diffusion-based methods.

entry.title: Certified geometric robustness -- Super-DeepG

author.name: No\'emie Cohen (Airbus CR\&T), M\'elanie Ducoffe (Airbus CR\&T), Christophe Gabreau, Claire Pagetti, Xavier Pucel

entry.summary: Proposes Super-DeepG for certified geometric robustness verification of neural networks against rotations, scaling, shearing, and translation, improving both precision and computational efficiency over prior work using GPU hardware.

entry.title: Source-Modality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Etha Tianze Hua, Tian Yun, Ellie Pavlick

entry.summary: Defines and investigates source-modality monitoring - whether multimodal models can track which input modality information comes from. Tests 11 VLMs and finds semantic signals outweigh syntactic ones for modality binding.

entry.title: DO-Bench: An Attributable Benchmark for Diagnosing Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models

author.name: JiYang Wang, Jiawei Chen, Mengqi Xiao, Yu Cheng, Yangfu Li, Zhaoxia Yin

entry.summary: Introduces DO-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that isolates whether VLM object hallucinations stem from perceptual limitations or contextual textual priors through structured multimodal interventions.

entry.title: KAConvNet: Kolmogorov-Arnold Convolutional Networks for Vision Recognition

author.name: Zhaoxiang Liu, Zhicheng Ma, Kaikai Zhao, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: KAConvNet integrates Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem with convolutional methods, proposing convolution operations that respect KAN's theoretical foundations rather than simply swapping activation functions.

entry.title: Lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model-Based Modeling for Scalable Patient-Trial Matching

author.name: Xiaodi Li, Yang Xiao, Munhwan Lee, Konstantinos Leventakos, Young J. Juhn, David Jones, Terence T. Sio, Wei Liu, Maria Vassilaki, Nansu Zong

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight RAG+LLM framework for patient-trial matching that separates retrieval-augmented extraction from LLM-based reasoning, achieving scalability over long EHRs while maintaining generalization.

entry.title: Evolve: A Persistent Knowledge Lifecycle for Small Language Models

author.name: Dikran Hovagimian

entry.summary: Proposes Evolve, pairing a small local LLM with a persistent, teacher-compiled knowledge store refined through sleep consolidation and usage-driven refresh. Amortizes teacher costs through cross-query knowledge reuse.

entry.title: Discriminator-Guided Adaptive Diffusion for Source-Free Test-Time Adaptation under Image Corruptions

author.name: Francesco Olivato, Cigdem Beyan, Vittorio Murino

entry.summary: Proposes discriminator-guided adaptive diffusion for source-free test-time adaptation, dynamically controlling diffusion depth per sample to handle corruption-induced domain shifts while keeping all source models frozen.

entry.title: Rethinking Publication: A Certification Framework for AI-Enabled Research

author.name: Yang Lu, Rabimba Karanjai, Lei Xu, Weidong Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a two-layer certification framework separating knowledge quality assessment from human contribution grading for AI-enabled research publications, addressing the growing challenge of AI-generated academic output.

entry.title: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects

author.name: Guancheng Wang, Qinghua Xu, Lionel C. Briand, Zhaoqiang Guo, Kui Liu

entry.summary: Presents CAT, an LLM-based test generation approach for Java that explicitly incorporates call-chain and dependency contexts into prompts through static analysis, addressing limitations of execution-path-only approaches for complex software systems.

entry.title: Data-Free Contribution Estimation in Federated Learning using Gradient von Neumann Entropy

author.name: Asim Ukaye, Mubarak Abdu-Aguye, Nurbek Tastan, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Introduces data-free client contribution estimation in federated learning using matrix von Neumann entropy of final-layer updates, with two schemes (SpectralFed and SpectralFuse) that avoid needing server-side validation data.

entry.title: An Undecidability Proof for the Plan Existence Problem

author.name: Antonis Achilleos

entry.summary: Proves that the plan existence problem in epistemic planning is undecidable even when action preconditions have modal depth at most 1 and there are no postconditions. Resolves a previously open question in the field.

entry.title: Score-Repellent Monte Carlo: Toward Efficient Non-Markovian Sampler with Constant Memory in General State Spaces

author.name: Jie Hu, Lingyun Chen, Geeho Kim, Jinyoung Choi, Bohyung Han, Do Young Eun

entry.summary: Proposes Score-Repellent Monte Carlo (SRMC), a framework that summarizes trajectory history via running average of score evaluations to enable history-dependent sampling in continuous domains. Reduces redundant revisits in MCMC.

entry.title: When Context Sticks: Studying Interference in In-Context Learning

author.name: Hanna R{\o}d, Dagny Streit, Nils Valseth Selte, Justin Li

entry.summary: Investigates context stickiness in in-context learning, showing that earlier examples persistently interfere with later task adaptation. Quantifies how prior context biases predictions across curriculum types.

entry.title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs

author.name: Divakar Kumar Yadav, Tian Zhao, Deepak Kumar

entry.summary: Provides the first independent cross-architecture evaluation of NVIDIA's CUDA Tile (CuTile) against cuBLAS, Triton, and other approaches on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs for AI workloads including GEMM and LLM inference. Results show CuTile effectiveness is strongly workload- and architecture-dependent.

entry.title: Quasi-Equivariant Metanetworks

author.name: Viet-Hoang Tran, An Nguyen, Beno\^it Gu\'erand, Thieu N. Vo, Tan M. Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes quasi-equivariant metanetworks that relax strict equivariance constraints when processing pretrained neural network weights, better handling the non-injective parameter-function mapping in practice.

entry.title: Inverting Foundation Models of Brain Function with Simulation-Based Inference

author.name: Niels Bracher, Xavier Intes, Stefan T. Radev

entry.summary: Uses simulation-based inference to invert a brain activity foundation model (TRIBEv2), recovering stimulus parameters from synthetic brain maps by pairing the emulator with LLMs that generate stimuli from linguistic parameters.

entry.title: Generalising maximum mean discrepancy: kernelised functional Bregman divergences

author.name: Russell Tsuchida, Frank Nielsen

entry.summary: Generalizes maximum mean discrepancy by developing kernelised functional Bregman divergences in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, systematically connecting Bregman divergences with kernel methods.

entry.title: Unveiling the Backdoor Mechanism Hidden Behind Catastrophic Overfitting in Fast Adversarial Training

author.name: Mengnan Zhao, Lihe Zhang, Tianhang Zheng, Bo Wang, Baocai Yin

entry.summary: Interprets catastrophic overfitting in Fast Adversarial Training through the lens of backdoor attacks, showing CO shares mechanisms with unlearnable tasks including universal class-distinguishable triggers.

entry.title: Diffusion Templates: A Unified Plugin Framework for Controllable Diffusion

author.name: Zhongjie Duan, Hong Zhang, Yingda Chen

entry.summary: Presents Diffusion Templates, a unified plugin framework that decouples base-model inference from controllable capability injection through Template models, a cache, and a Router for composable control.

entry.title: SAGE: Sparse Adaptive Guidance for Dependency-Aware Tabular Data Generation

author.name: Shuo Yang, Zheyu Zhang, Bardh Prenkaj, Gjergji Kasneci

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, an LLM-based framework for generating synthetic tabular data that enforces sparse and dynamic dependency guidance between features. It addresses spurious correlations from dense dependency modeling and static relationship assumptions in existing approaches.

entry.title: GradMAP: Gradient-Based Multi-Agent Proximal Learning for Grid-Edge Flexibility

author.name: Yihong Zhou, Hongtai Zeng, Thomas Morstyn

entry.summary: Proposes GradMAP, a decentralized multi-agent RL method for coordinating grid-edge devices in power systems, embedding differentiable three-phase AC power-flow physics into the training loop via implicit differentiation.

entry.title: SpecRLBench: A Benchmark for Generalization in Specification-Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zijian Guo, \.Ilker I\c{s}{\i}k, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li

entry.summary: Introduces SpecRLBench, a benchmark for evaluating generalization of specification-guided RL methods using linear temporal logic across navigation and manipulation domains with varying difficulty, dynamics, and observation modalities.

entry.title: DGHMesh: A Large-scale Dual-radar mmWave Dataset and Generalization-focused Benchmark for Human Mesh Reconstruction

author.name: Rongxiao Guo, Qingchao Chen

entry.summary: Presents DGHMesh, a large-scale dual-radar mmWave dataset with 360K synchronized frames for human mesh reconstruction, including both FMCW and SFCW radar with RGB and 3D annotations for generalization benchmarking.

entry.title: IntrAgent: An LLM Agent for Content-Grounded Information Retrieval through Literature Review

author.name: Fengbo Ma, Zixin Rao, Xiaoting Li, Zhetao Chen, Hongyue Sun, Yiping Zhao, Xianyan Chen, Zhen Xiang

entry.summary: Introduces IntrAgent, an LLM-based agent for content-grounded information retrieval from scientific literature that mimics human reading behavior with section ranking followed by iterative detail extraction.

entry.title: Rethinking Trust Region Bayesian Optimization in High Dimensions

author.name: Wei-Ting Tang, Joel A. Paulson

entry.summary: Proposes AdaScale-TuRBO, a variant of Trust Region Bayesian Optimization that scales GP lengthscales with problem dimension and trust region size, addressing degenerate local GP models in high dimensions.

entry.title: CASP: Support-Aware Offline Policy Selection for Two-Stage Recommender Systems

author.name: Nilson Chapagain

entry.summary: Proposes CASP, a support-aware offline policy selector for two-stage recommender systems that accounts for how candidate generator changes affect both policy value and estimation reliability.

entry.title: A Unified Fractional Regularization Framework for Sparse Recovery

author.name: Yinhao Zhao, Haoyu He, Chuanqi Ma, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified fractional regularization framework for sparse recovery based on ℓ1/ℓp^q, characterizing equivalence with subtractive models, establishing RIP-based recovery conditions, and proving algorithmic convergence.

entry.title: GeoFunFlow-3D: A Physics-Guided Generative Flow Matching Framework for High-Fidelity 3D Aerodynamic Inference over Complex Geometries

author.name: Ruiling Jiang, Yong Zhang, Houbiao Li

entry.summary: Proposes GeoFunFlow-3D, a physics-guided generative flow matching framework for 3D aerodynamic inference that addresses spectral bias and gradient conflicts through optimal transport paths, high-order discrete engines without auto-differentiation, and topology-aware super-resolution.

entry.title: A Taxonomy and Resolution Strategy for Client-Level Disagreements in Federated Learning

author.name: Daan Rosendal, Ana Oprescu

entry.summary: Introduces a taxonomy of 'client-level disagreements' in federated learning where clients may need to exclude each other for strategic/regulatory reasons, and proposes a multi-track resolution strategy with isolated model update paths.

entry.title: From Edges to Depth: Probing the Spatial Hierarchy in Vision Transformers

author.name: Jainum Sanghavi

entry.summary: Probes frozen ViT-B/16 to reveal a spatial hierarchy: boundary structure becomes decodable at layers 5-6 while depth information peaks at layer 8, with both signals collapsing at the final classification layer.

entry.title: High-dimensional Semi-supervised Classification via the Fermat Distance

author.name: Ruoxu Tan, Yiming Zang

entry.summary: Proposes semi-supervised classification methods based on the Fermat distance (a density-sensitive metric) for high-dimensional data, including weighted k-NN and MDS-induced classifiers with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Hardware-Efficient Softmax and Layer Normalization with Guaranteed Normalization for Edge Devices

author.name: Dawon Choi, Hana Kim, Ji-Hoon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes hardware-efficient approximations for Softmax and LayerNorm that guarantee normalization properties for edge deployment of Transformers, maintaining mathematical properties while reducing hardware costs.

entry.title: Conditional Score-Based Modeling of Effective Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Ludovico T. Giorgini

entry.summary: Introduces a data-driven calibration method for stochastic reduced-order models using the conditional score of finite-time transition densities, avoiding common issues with short-time approximations and state-space partitioning.

entry.title: Benchmarking Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Constance Boissin, Johan Vallon-Christersson, David A. Clifton, Mattias Rantalainen

entry.summary: Benchmarks widely-used pathology foundation models for breast cancer survival prediction across three independent cohorts with 5,400+ patients, using standardized evaluation pipeline with external validation.

entry.title: Voice Under Revision: Large Language Models and the Normalization of Personal Narrative

author.name: Tom van Nuenen

entry.summary: Studies how LLM rewriting systematically normalizes personal narratives across 300 texts and three frontier models, reducing function words, contractions, first-person pronouns while increasing vocabulary diversity and punctuation elaboration. Shows this normalization persists even under voice-preserving prompts.

entry.title: BERAG: Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Jinghong Chen, Jingbiao Mei, Guangyu Yang, Bill Byrne

entry.summary: Proposes BERAG, a Bayesian ensemble approach to RAG that processes documents independently rather than concatenating them, addressing the 'lost-in-the-middle' effect and attribution challenges. Scales sub-quadratically with context length.

entry.title: Recognition Without Authorization: LLMs and the Moral Order of Online Advice

author.name: Tom van Nuenen

entry.summary: Compares LLM advisory defaults with community-endorsed advice on 11,565 Reddit posts, finding LLMs identify the same dynamics as humans but are less likely to provide directive authorization for action, especially on high-consensus posts about abuse or safety.

entry.title: Evaluating Remote Sensing Image Captions Beyond Metric Biases

author.name: Ziyun Chen, Fan Liu, Liang Yao, Chuanyi Zhang, Yuye Ma, Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ReconScore, a reference-free evaluation metric for remote sensing image captioning that assesses caption quality by its capacity for visual reconstruction rather than textual similarity to references. Questions whether fine-tuning is needed when evaluation metrics are flawed.

entry.title: Hard to See, Hard to Label: Generative and Symbolic Acquisition for Subtle Visual Phenomena

author.name: Renjith Prasad, Rishabh Sharma, Andrew E. Shao, Annmary Justine Koomthanam, Shreyas Kulkarni, Suparna Bhattacharya, Martin Foltin, Amit Sheth, David Orozco, Brian Sammuli

entry.summary: GSAL is an active learning framework for object detection that combines diffusion-based difficulty signals with hierarchical symbolic acquisition to better select subtle visual anomalies (hairline cracks, sub-millimeter voids) that standard methods miss.

entry.title: Transferable Physical-World Adversarial Patches Against Object Detection in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zihui Zhu, Ziqi Zhou, Yichen Wang, Lulu Xue, Minghui Li, Shengshan Hu

entry.summary: AdvAD proposes transfer-based physical adversarial patches for autonomous driving by optimizing across multiple detection models simultaneously to exploit shared vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Exploring Hierarchical Consistency and Unbiased Objectness for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Sanghoon Lee, Geon Lee, Hyekang Park, Bumsub Ham

entry.summary: Proposes a pseudo labeling framework for open-vocabulary object detection addressing inaccurate class labels from VLMs and unreliable objectness scores, using hierarchical consistency and unbiased objectness.

entry.title: Deploy DINO with Many-to-Many Association

author.name: Haodong Jiang, Mingzhe Li, Junfeng Wu

entry.summary: Explores zero-shot deployment of DINO features for image matching using a many-to-many association paradigm. Introduces a novel likelihood perspective that makes robust estimation under many-to-many matching computationally efficient.

entry.title: ZID-Net: Zero-Inference Diffusion Prior Decoupling Network for Single Image Dehazing

author.name: Xinheng Li, Minghao Chen, Mengqing Wu, Yan Liu, Guanying Huo

entry.summary: Proposes ZID-Net for image dehazing that decouples diffusion model supervision from feed-forward inference, achieving strong restoration quality without the computational cost of diffusion sampling at inference.

entry.title: DeepTaxon: An Interpretable Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Framework for Unified Species Identification and Discovery

author.name: Jiawei Wang, Ming Lei, Yaning Yang, Xinyan Lin, Yuquan Le, Qiwei Ma, Zhiwei Xu, Zheqi Lv, Yuchen Ang, Zhe Quan, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Introduces DeepTaxon, a retrieval-augmented multimodal framework for unified species identification and discovery that performs chain-of-thought comparative reasoning over retrieved visual evidence.

entry.title: CLLAP: Contrastive Learning-based LiDAR-Augmented Pretraining for Enhanced Radar-Camera Fusion

author.name: Bingyi Liu, Chuanhui Zhu, Hongfei Xue, Jian Teng, Jipeng Liu, Enshu Wang, Penglin Dai, Pu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CLLAP, a contrastive learning framework that uses LiDAR data to generate pseudo-radar data for pretraining, enhancing radar-camera fusion for 3D object detection without requiring annotated radar data.

entry.title: QEVA: A Reference-Free Evaluation Metric for Narrative Video Summarization with Multimodal Question Answering

author.name: Woojun Jung, Junyeong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes QEVA, a reference-free evaluation metric for video summarization that assesses summaries directly against source videos through multimodal QA along coverage, factuality, and chronology dimensions.

entry.title: Unconstrained Multi-view Human Pose Estimation with Algebraic Priors

author.name: Xiaolin Qin, Qianlei Wang, Jiacen Liu, Chaoning Zhang, Fei Zhu, Zhang Yi

entry.summary: Proposes an unconstrained multi-view human pose estimation framework that works without camera calibration, using transformer-based triangulation and Grassmannian algebraic priors.

entry.title: SycoPhantasy: Quantifying Sycophancy and Hallucination in Small Open Weight VLMs for Vision-Language Scoring of Fantasy Characters

author.name: Arya Shah, Deepali Mishra, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Investigates sycophantic behavior in small open-weight VLMs when scoring image-text alignment, introducing the Bluffing Coefficient metric to measure the gap between assigned scores and visual evidence recall.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning via Hyperspherical Density Shaping

author.name: Esteban Rodr\'iguez-Betancourt, Edgar Casasola-Murillo

entry.summary: HyDeS proposes a theoretically grounded self-supervised representation learning method based on mutual information maximization on a hypersphere using von Mises-Fisher density estimation. The method biases models toward foreground features and performs well on segmentation tasks but lags in fine-grained classification, with detailed analysis of latent space geometry.

entry.title: A Multiplication-Free Spike-Time Learning Algorithm and its Efficient FPGA Implementation for On-Chip SNN Training

author.name: Maryam Mirsadeghi, Mojtaba Mirbagheri, Saeed Reza Kheradpisheh

entry.summary: Presents a multiplication-free spike-time-based learning algorithm designed for efficient FPGA implementation of on-chip SNN training. Eliminates floating-point arithmetic and explicit gradient storage while maintaining competitive accuracy on Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA.

entry.title: Move-Then-Operate: Behavioral Phasing for Human-Like Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Haoming Xu, Lei Lei, Jie Gu, Chu Tang, Jingmin Chen, Ruiqi Wang

entry.summary: Move-Then-Operate decouples robotic manipulation into coarse relocation and contact-critical interaction phases using a dual-expert policy routed by a learnable phase selector. Phase labels are automatically generated via an MLLM-based pipeline aligned with human motor patterns.

entry.title: QuietWalk: Physics-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Ground Reaction Force-Aware Humanoid Locomotion Under Diverse Footwear

author.name: Hanze Hu, Luying Feng, Silu Chen, Tianjiang Zheng, Dexin Jiang, Wei Chen, Chi Zhang, Guilin Yang, Yaochu Jin

entry.summary: QuietWalk uses physics-informed RL to train humanoid robots for low-noise locomotion across diverse footwear conditions. Employs an inverse-dynamics-constrained PINN to estimate per-foot ground reaction forces without fragile force sensors.

entry.title: Unleashing the Agility of Wheeled-Legged Robots for High-Dynamic Reflexive Obstacle Evasion

author.name: Yongen Zhao (School of Mechanical Engineering, Tianjin University, Tianjin, China, Beijing Zhongguancun Academy, Beijing, China), Zihao Xu (School of Computing, National University of Singapore, Singapore), Wenzhi Lu (School of Mechanical Engineering, Tianjin University, Tianjin, China), Zhen Chu (DeepRobotics, Hangzhou, China), Ce Hao (School of Computing, National University of Singapore, Singapore, Beijing Zhongguancun Academy, Beijing, China)

entry.summary: AWARE is a hierarchical RL framework for high-dynamic obstacle avoidance in wheeled-legged robots. It naturally exhibits emergent diverse gaits and evasive behaviors including forward lunge and lateral dodge, leveraging the hybrid wheeled-legged morphology.

entry.title: The other paper that killed deep learning theory

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Historical analysis of how deep learning theory was challenged twice: by Zhang et al. 2016 (showing neural networks can memorize random labels) and by Nagarajan and Kolter 2019 (showing uniform convergence bounds are vacuous). Traces the field's struggle to explain neural network generalization.

entry.title: Retrospective on my unsupervised elicitation challenge

author.name: DanielFilan

entry.summary: Retrospective on an 'unsupervised elicitation challenge' where the task was to get Claude to correctly answer Ancient Greek homework without knowing Greek yourself. Reports that Claude Opus 4.7 solved it immediately where Opus 4.6 required prompting, discussing implications for alignment-relevant knowledge elicitation.

entry.title: H-Sets: Hessian-Guided Discovery of Set-Level Feature Interactions in Image Classifiers

author.name: Ayushi Mehrotra, Dipkamal Bhusal, Michael Clifford, Nidhi Rastogi

entry.summary: Introduces H-Sets, a two-stage framework for discovering higher-order feature interactions in image classifiers using Hessian-guided analysis, addressing limitations of methods that only capture marginal effects.

entry.title: Semantic Error Correction and Decoding for Short Block Channel Codes

author.name: Jiafu Hao, Chentao Yue, Wanchun Liu, Yonghui Li, Branka Vucetic

entry.summary: Presents a semantic-enhanced receiver framework for wireless communications that uses language model context for error correction of transmitted natural language, with semantic list decoding and confidence-guided HARQ.

entry.title: CNSL-bench: Benchmarking the Sign Language Understanding Capabilities of MLLMs on Chinese National Sign Language

author.name: Rui Zhao, Xuewen Zhong, Xiaoyun Zheng, Jinsong Su, Yidong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CNSL-bench, the first comprehensive Chinese National Sign Language benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs, anchored to an officially standardized dictionary to ensure consistent evaluation.

entry.title: Surface Sensitivity in Lean 4 Autoformalization

author.name: William Feng, Ethan Lou, Aryan Sharma

entry.summary: Studies surface sensitivity in Lean 4 autoformalization, showing that paraphrase sensitivity reflects compilation-boundary failures rather than semantic divergence. Tests across GPT-family and open-weight models with 60 deterministic paraphrase rules.

entry.title: GIFT: Global stabilisation via Intrinsic Fine Tuning

author.name: Rory Young, Nicolas Pugeault

entry.summary: Proposes GIFT, a framework that optimizes global stability of deep RL policies through intrinsic fine-tuning. Addresses the problem of chaotic state dynamics in deep RL policies where small perturbations cause large behavior changes.

entry.title: Advancing Ligand-based Virtual Screening and Molecular Generation with Pretrained Molecular Embedding Distance

author.name: Shiyun Wa, Yifei Wang, Simone Sciabola, Ye Wang

entry.summary: Proposes using pretrained molecular embedding distance (PED) as a simple, training-free molecular similarity measure for drug discovery tasks like virtual screening and molecular generation, replacing expensive fingerprint-based or 3D methods.

entry.title: Characterizations of Admissible Objective Functions for Hierarchical Clustering

author.name: Ryuki Tsukuba, Kazutoshi Ando

entry.summary: Provides mathematical characterizations of admissible objective functions for hierarchical clustering, extending Dasgupta's framework beyond sum-type objectives to include product-type and other forms.

entry.title: Nearly Optimal Subdata Selection

author.name: Min Yang, Wei Zheng, John Stufken, Ming-Chung Chang, Ting Tian, Xueqin Wang

entry.summary: Develops methodology for nearly optimal subdata selection using optimal approximate design theory, addressing the NP-hard problem of selecting the most informative subset of data points for parameter estimation.

entry.title: When Cow Urine Cures Constipation on YouTube: Limits of LLMs in Detecting Culture-specific Health Misinformation

author.name: Anamta Khan, Ratna Kandala, Deepti, Sheza Munir, Joyojeet Pal

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs fail to detect culturally embedded health misinformation, using cow urine health claims on Indian YouTube as a case study. Shows that promotional content blends sacred language with pseudo-science in ways that Western-trained LLMs systematically miss.

entry.title: Neural Recovery of Historical Lexical Structure in Bantu Languages from Modern Data

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Investigates whether neural models trained on modern morphological data can recover historical lexical structure in Bantu languages. Confirms 90.9% of top noun cognate candidates align with previously reconstructed Proto-Bantu forms.

entry.title: AnalogRetriever: Learning Cross-Modal Representations for Analog Circuit Retrieval

author.name: Yihan Wang, Lei Li, Yao Lai, Jing Wang, Yan Lu

entry.summary: AnalogRetriever is a tri-modal retrieval framework for analog circuits that enables cross-modal search across SPICE netlists, schematics, and functional descriptions using vision-language and graph neural network encoders.

entry.title: Breaking the Resource Wall: Geometry-Guided Sequence Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Sheng-Wei Chan, Xin-Jui Pan, Chun-Po Shen, Chia-Min Lin, Yung-Che Wang, Jen-Shiun Chiang

entry.summary: DGM-Net proposes an efficient semantic segmentation architecture using Directional Geometric Mamba, a linear-complexity O(N) operator as an alternative to ASPP/PPM context modeling.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Degradation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Realistic Underwater Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Shaohua Liu, Ning Gao, Zuoya Gu, Hongkun Dou, Yue Deng, Hongjue Li

entry.summary: MarineSTD-GS proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for underwater scene reconstruction that explicitly models both temporal (caustics, flickering) and spatial (attenuation, backscattering) degradations.

entry.title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction

author.name: Zichun Guo, Yuling Shi, Wenhao Zeng, Chao Hu, Haotian Lin, Terry Yue Zhuo, Jiawei Chen, Xiaodong Gu, Wenping Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ShredBench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to reconstruct content from shredded document fragments, requiring both visual pattern recognition and semantic reasoning under content discontinuities.

entry.title: GS-DOT: Gaussian splatting-based image reconstruction for diffuse optical tomography

author.name: Jingjing Jiang

entry.summary: GS-DOT adapts Gaussian Splatting from rendering to diffuse optical tomography, representing absorption coefficients as sparse anisotropic Gaussian primitives. This is the first adaptation of GS algorithms to the photon diffusion regime, replacing ray transport with diffusion functions.

entry.title: ReCast: Recasting Learning Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Peiyan Zhang, Hanmo Liu, Chengxuan Tong, Yuxia Wu, Wei Guo, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ReCast for reinforcement learning in generative recommendation, addressing the failure of standard group-based RL in sparse-hit scenarios by repairing all-zero groups and using boundary-focused contrastive updates.

entry.title: Unstable Rankings in Bayesian Deep Learning Evaluation

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Minxuan Hu, Guansu Wang, Jiaxin Liu, Liang He

entry.summary: Shows that Bayesian deep learning method rankings are unstable under data scarcity and dataset-dependent. Uses Bayesian hierarchical model to properly quantify evaluation uncertainty. No universal sample size threshold exists.

entry.title: TEMPO: Transformers for Temporal Disease Progression from Cross-Sectional Data

author.name: Hongtao Hao, Joseph L. Austerweil

entry.summary: Proposes TEMPO, a Transformer architecture for inferring temporal disease progression from cross-sectional data, learning both ordinal and continuous event sequences. Reduces Kendall's Tau distance by 52.89% vs state-of-the-art.

entry.title: Deep Learning of Solver-Aware Turbulence Closures from Nudged LES Dynamics

author.name: Ashwin Suriyanarayanan, Melissa Adrian, Dibyajyoti Chakraborty, Romit Maulik

entry.summary: Develops deep learning-based turbulence closure models for LES that are solver-aware through nudged dynamics training, addressing instabilities that arise from mismatch between assumed filters and numerical discretizations.

entry.title: Semantic Segmentation for Histopathology using Learned Regularization based on Global Proportions

author.name: Yangping Li, Thomas Pinetz, Michael H\"olzel, Marieta Toma, Alexander Effland

entry.summary: Introduces VSLP, a two-stage framework that infers dense segmentations from global label proportions in histopathology without pixel-level annotations, using pre-trained transformers with test-time augmentation and variational regularization.

entry.title: Micro-Expression-Aware Avatar Fingerprinting via Inter-Frame Feature Differencing

author.name: Masoumeh Chapariniya, Jean-Marc Odobez, Volker Dellwo, Teodora Vukovi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes a preprocessing-free avatar fingerprinting system using micro-expression-aware backbone with inter-frame feature differencing to verify who drives a synthetic talking-head video.

entry.title: Focus Session: Hardware and Software Techniques for Accelerating Multimodal Foundation Models

author.name: Muhammad Shafique, Abdul Basit, Muhammad Abdullah Hanif, Alberto Marchisio, Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, Minghao Shao

entry.summary: Presents a multi-layered methodology for accelerating multimodal foundation models combining hardware-software co-design, mixed-precision quantization, structural pruning, speculative decoding, and model cascading.

entry.title: Ethics Testing: Proactive Identification of Generative AI System Harms

author.name: Shin Hwei Tan, Haibo Wang, Heng Li

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'ethics testing' for generative AI systems, a systematic approach to generating tests for identifying software harms in AI-generated content including code and images.

entry.title: Protect the Brain When Treating the Heart: A Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Emboli

author.name: Andrea Angino, Ken Trotti, Diego Ulisse Pizzagalli, Rolf Krause, Tiziano Torre, Stefanos Demertzis

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D U-Net approach for detecting gaseous microemboli in cardiac ultrasound, achieving robust detection with real-time execution speed and integration into an operating room workflow.

entry.title: BLAST: Benchmarking LLMs with ASP-based Structured Testing

author.name: Manuel Alejandro Borroto Santana, Erica Coppolillo, Francesco Calimeri, Giuseppe Manco, Simona Perri, Francesco Ricca

entry.summary: Introduces BLAST, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating LLM accuracy in generating Answer Set Programming (ASP) code, with two novel semantic metrics and evaluation of ten graph-related ASP problems.

entry.title: FeatEHR-LLM: Leveraging Large Language Models for Feature Engineering in Electronic Health Records

author.name: Hojjat Karami, David Atienza, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Anisoara Ionescu

entry.summary: Presents FeatEHR-LLM, which uses LLMs to generate clinically meaningful features from irregular EHR time series by operating on dataset schemas rather than raw patient data, preserving privacy. Uses tool-augmented generation for specialized clinical feature engineering.

entry.title: Towards Understanding the Expressive Power of GNNs with Global Readout

author.name: Maurice Funk, Daumantas Kojelis

entry.summary: Studies the expressive power of message-passing GNNs with global readout, showing that sum aggregation suffices to capture FO properties beyond C2 logic. Identifies two ways to restore logical characterization.

entry.title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs

author.name: Minghui Xu, Qi Luo, Kun Li

entry.summary: Presents a dynamic data valuation framework for LLM training data with three layers: token-level information density, empirical training gain measurement, and cryptographic verifiability. Proposes utility-based pricing over static accounting.

entry.title: C-MORAL: Controllable Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization with Reinforcement Alignment for LLMs

author.name: Rui Gao, Youngseung Jeon, Swastik Roy, Morteza Ziyadi, Xiang 'Anthony' Chen

entry.summary: Proposes C-MORAL, an RL post-training framework for controllable multi-objective molecular optimization with LLMs. Combines group-based optimization, property score alignment, and nonlinear reward aggregation for drug design.

entry.title: CombiMOTS: Combinatorial Multi-Objective Tree Search for Dual-Target Molecule Generation

author.name: Thibaud Southiratn, Bonil Koo, Yijingxiu Lu, Sun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CombiMOTS, a combinatorial multi-objective tree search for dual-target molecule generation that integrates synthetic planning into the generative process. Addresses trade-offs between target engagement and molecular properties.

entry.title: GeoCert: Certified Geometric AI for Reliable Forecasting

author.name: Regina Zhang, Zongru Li, Honggang Wen, Xiaofeng Liu, Siu-Ming Yiu, Pietro Li\`o, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: Introduces GeoCert, a geometric AI framework that unifies forecasting, physical reasoning, and formal verification using hyperbolic manifold evolution with logarithmic-time certification. Claims certified generalization across energy, climate, and finance domains.

entry.title: CAPSULE: Control-Theoretic Action Perturbations for Safe Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Rahul Narava, Siddharth Verma, Ojas Jain, Shashi Shekhar Jha, Mayank Shekhar Jha
