entry.summary: Proposes HaS, a homology-aware speculative retrieval framework for RAG that performs speculative retrieval over restricted scopes and validates whether candidates contain required knowledge using a homology relation between queries.

entry.title: Cognitive Alignment At No Cost: Inducing Human Attention Biases For Interpretable Vision Transformers

author.name: Ethan Knights

entry.summary: Investigates fine-tuning ViT self-attention weights on human saliency fixation maps to induce human-like attention biases. Shows this reverses anti-human large-object bias, amplifies animacy preference, and improves interpretability at no accuracy cost.

entry.title: FluSplat: Sparse-View 3D Editing without Test-Time Optimization

author.name: Haitao Huang, Shin-Fang Chng, Huangying Zhan, Qingan Yan, Yi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FluSplat, a feed-forward framework for cross-view consistent 3D scene editing from sparse views, replacing iterative test-time optimization with cross-view regularization in the image domain during training.

entry.title: IMPACT-CYCLE: A Contract-Based Multi-Agent System for Claim-Level Supervisory Correction of Long-Video Semantic Memory

author.name: Weitong Kong, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, David Schneider, Zeyun Zhong, Alexander Jaus, Zdravko Marinov, Jiale Wei, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Lei Qi, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Presents IMPACT-CYCLE, a multi-agent system for long-video understanding that reformulates the task as iterative claim-level maintenance of shared semantic memory with versioned claims, dependency graphs, and provenance logs. Role-specialized agents enable proportional human correction.

entry.title: Hallucination Early Detection in Diffusion Models

author.name: Federico Betti, Lorenzo Baraldi, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Introduces HEaD+, a method to detect hallucinations (missing objects) in diffusion model generations early in the denoising process, enabling seed selection that avoids costly full generation of failed outputs.

entry.title: CCTVBench: Contrastive Consistency Traffic VideoQA Benchmark for Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Xingcheng Zhou, Hao Guo, Rui Song, Walter Zimmer, Mingyu Liu, Andr\'e Schamschurko, Hu Cao, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Introduces CCTVBench, a contrastive consistency benchmark for traffic video QA using paired real accident videos and world-model-generated counterfactuals, with structured diagnostics for failure analysis.

entry.title: Render-in-the-Loop: Vector Graphics Generation via Visual Self-Feedback

author.name: Guotao Liang, Zhangcheng Wang, Juncheng Hu, Haitao Zhou, Ziteng Xue, Jing Zhang, Dong Xu, Qian Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Render-in-the-Loop for SVG generation, closing the feedback loop by letting MLLMs perceive intermediate rendered states during vector graphics generation rather than blind open-loop code synthesis.

entry.title: Amodal SAM: A Unified Amodal Segmentation Framework with Generalization

author.name: Bo Zhang, Zhuotao Tian, Xin Tao, Songlin Tang, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Introduces Amodal SAM, extending SAM for amodal image and video segmentation (predicting complete shapes including occluded regions) with a Spatial Completion Adapter while preserving SAM's generalization.

entry.title: Quantization robustness from dense representations of sparse functions in high-capacity kernel associative memory

author.name: Akira Tamamori

entry.summary: Investigates compressibility of Kernel Logistic Regression-trained Hopfield networks, revealing extreme robustness to quantization but high sensitivity to pruning, explained by a 'sparse function, dense representation' principle through Walsh analysis.

entry.title: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Adaptive Ultrasound-Guided Needle Insertion and Needle Tracking

author.name: Yuelin Zhang, Qingpeng Ding, Longxiang Tang, Chengyu Fang, Shing Shin Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes a Vision-Language-Action model for automated ultrasound-guided needle insertion and tracking on a robotic ultrasound system. The unified VLA approach replaces traditional hand-crafted pipelines, enabling real-time adaptive adjustment during insertion.

entry.title: Think Before Writing: Feature-Level Multi-Objective Optimization for Generative Citation Visibility

author.name: Zikang Liu, Peilan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FeatGEO, a feature-level optimization framework for generative engine optimization (GEO) that optimizes over interpretable structural, content, and linguistic properties of webpages rather than directly editing text, for improving citation visibility in AI answer engines.

entry.title: V-tableR1: Process-Supervised Multimodal Table Reasoning with Critic-Guided Policy Optimization

author.name: Yubo Jiang, Yitong An, Xin Yang, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Xuxin Cheng, Fengying Xie, Zhiguo Jiang, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Haopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces V-tableR1, a process-supervised RL framework for multimodal table reasoning using a critic VLM to provide dense step-level feedback. Leverages deterministic grid structure of tables as an ideal testbed for extending verifiable rewards to visual domains.

entry.title: X-PCR: A Benchmark for Cross-modality Progressive Clinical Reasoning in Ophthalmic Diagnosis

author.name: Gui Wang, Zehao Zhong, YongSong Zhou, Yudong Li, Ende Wu, Wooi Ping Cheah, Rong Qu, Jianfeng Ren, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Introduces X-PCR, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on progressive clinical reasoning in ophthalmology across six diagnostic stages and six imaging modalities, with 26K images and 178K expert annotations.

entry.title: Visual-Tactile Peg-in-Hole Assembly Learning from Peg-out-of-Hole Disassembly

author.name: Yongqiang Zhao, Xuyang Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Matteo Leonetti, Emmanouil Spyrakos-Papastavridis, Shan Luo

entry.summary: Proposes learning peg-in-hole assembly by leveraging the easier inverse task (peg-out-of-hole disassembly) using visual-tactile RL. Both tasks share a unified POMDP formulation, and the disassembly policy helps guide exploration for the harder assembly task.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Tool for AI Weather Models

author.name: Kirsten I. Tempest, Matthias Beylich, George C. Craig

entry.summary: Presents an open-source mechanistic interpretability tool for AI weather models that organizes internal latent representations for analysis. Aims to build confidence in AI weather prediction by making these black-box models more transparent.

entry.title: Learning Lifted Action Models from Unsupervised Visual Traces

author.name: Kai Xi, Stephen Gould, Sylvie Thi\'ebaux

entry.summary: Proposes learning lifted action models from sequences of state images without action observation, using a deep learning framework with a mixed-integer linear program to prevent prediction collapse.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning Improves LLM Accuracy and Reasoning in Disease Classification from Radiology Reports

author.name: Yishu Wei, Yi Lin, Adam Flanders, George Shih, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Applies a two-stage approach (SFT then GRPO reinforcement learning) to improve LLM accuracy and reasoning for disease classification from radiology reports, showing GRPO further improves over SFT alone.

entry.title: Four-Axis Decision Alignment for Long-Horizon Enterprise AI Agents

author.name: Vasundra Srininvasan

entry.summary: Proposes a four-axis evaluation framework for enterprise AI agents: factual precision, reasoning coherence, compliance reconstruction, and calibrated abstention. Introduces novel regulatory-grounded and abstention axes.

entry.title: Multi-modal Reasoning with LLMs for Visual Semantic Arithmetic

author.name: Chuou Xu, Liya Ji, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Explores visual semantic arithmetic with LLMs (e.g., image analogies like 'king'-'man'+'woman'='queen' with images), using reinforcement learning to improve multimodal reasoning for robotics applications.

entry.title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM

author.name: Sravanth Kodavanti, Sowmya Vajrala, Srinivas Miriyala, Utsav Tiwari, Uttam Kumar, Utkarsh Kumar Mahawar, Achal Pratap Singh, Arya D, Narendra Mutyala, Vikram Nelvoy Rajendiran, Sharan Kumar Allur, Euntaik Lee, Dohyoung Kim, HyeonSu Lee, Gyusung Cho, JungBae Kim

entry.summary: Presents a hardware-aware framework for deploying LLaMA-based multilingual models with multiple LoRAs on Samsung Galaxy devices, enabling dynamic task switching without recompilation.

entry.title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models

author.name: Valentina Kuskova, Dmitry Zaytsev, Michael Coppedge

entry.summary: Argues causal relevance in nonlinear time-series models should be evaluated through forecast necessity rather than coefficient magnitude. Presents ablation-based evaluation framework for causal discovery.

entry.title: Choose Your Own Adventure: Non-Linear AI-Assisted Programming with EvoGraph

author.name: Vassilios Exarhakos, Jinghui Cheng, Jin L. C. Guo

entry.summary: Presents EvoGraph, an IDE plugin that represents AI-assisted coding interactions as a branching development graph, enabling developers to compare, merge, and revisit prior states. User study with 20 participants shows improved developer experience.

entry.title: Reducing the Offline-Streaming Gap for Unified ASR Transducer with Consistency Regularization

author.name: Andrei Andrusenko, Vladimir Bataev, Lilit Grigoryan, Nune Tadevosyan, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Boris Ginsburg

entry.summary: Presents a unified ASR framework for RNNT that supports both offline and streaming decoding in a single model, with a Triton-implemented mode-consistency regularization to close the gap between offline and streaming performance.

entry.title: Multi-Gait Learning for Humanoid Robots Using Reinforcement Learning with Selective Adversarial Motion Prior

author.name: Yuanye Wu, Keyi Wang, Linqi Ye, Boyang Xing

entry.summary: Presents a multi-gait learning approach enabling humanoid robots to master five distinct gaits using a selective Adversarial Motion Prior strategy—applying AMP to periodic gaits while omitting it for highly dynamic movements.

entry.title: LBLLM: Lightweight Binarization of Large Language Models via Three-Stage Distillation

author.name: Siqing Song, Chuang Wang, Yong Lang, Yi Yang, Xu-Yao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents LBLLM, a three-stage binarization framework for LLMs achieving W(1+1)A4 quantization by decoupling weight and activation quantization through progressive PTQ initialization, layer-wise distillation, and learnable activation factors.

entry.title: Revisiting Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding

author.name: Gerard Pons, Carlos Escolano, Besim Bilalli, Anna Queralt

entry.summary: Identifies 'entity interference' as an overlooked source of catastrophic forgetting in continual knowledge graph embedding, where new entity embeddings interfere with previously learned ones. Shows this is distinct from the commonly studied embedding drift problem.

entry.title: Counting Worlds Branching Time Semantics for post-hoc Bias Mitigation in generative AI

author.name: Alessandro G. Buda, Giuseppe Primiero, Leonardo Ceragioli, Melissa Antonelli

entry.summary: Introduces CTLF, a branching-time logic with counting worlds semantics for formally reasoning about bias in generative AI output series. Provides modal operators for verifying whether outputs respect intended probability distributions over protected attributes.

entry.title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language

author.name: Yi Zhong, Buqiang Xu, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, Shuofei Qiao, Guozhou Zheng, Ningyu Zhang

entry.summary: Chat2Workflow introduces a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows from natural language, targeting real-world industrial automation of workflow construction that currently requires manual engineering.

entry.title: Learning Hybrid-Control Policies for High-Precision In-Contact Manipulation Under Uncertainty

author.name: Hunter L. Brown, Geoffrey Hollinger, Stefan Lee

entry.summary: Presents hybrid position-force control policies for high-precision in-contact manipulation that dynamically select force or position control per dimension, with a Mode-Aware curriculum for learning efficiency.

entry.title: Accelerating PayPal's Commerce Agent with Speculative Decoding: An Empirical Study on EAGLE3 with Fine-Tuned Nemotron Models

author.name: Ally Qin, Jian Wan, Sarat Mudunuri, Srinivasan Manoharan

entry.summary: Evaluates EAGLE3 speculative decoding for PayPal's Commerce Agent using fine-tuned Nemotron models, achieving 22-49% throughput improvement and 18-33% latency reduction at zero additional hardware cost.

entry.title: Replicable Bandits with UCB based Exploration

author.name: Rohan Deb, Udaya Ghai, Karan Singh, Arindam Banerjee

entry.summary: Develops replicable UCB-based algorithms for stochastic multi-armed bandits and linear bandits, where two executions with shared randomness produce the same action sequence with high probability.

entry.title: Maximum Entropy Semi-Supervised Inverse Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Julien Audiffren, Michal Valko, Alessandro Lazaric, Mohammad Ghavamzadeh

entry.summary: MESSI combines MaxEnt-IRL with semi-supervised learning principles, integrating unsupervised trajectory data into the inverse reinforcement learning framework using a pairwise penalty.

entry.title: Sheaf Neural Networks on SPD Manifolds: Second-Order Geometric Representation Learning

author.name: Yuhan Peng, Junwen Dong, Yuzhi Zeng, Hao Li, Ce Ju, Huitao Feng, Diaaeldin Taha, Anna Wienhard, Kelin Xia

entry.summary: Extends sheaf neural networks to operate on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold, enabling edge-specific transformations of matrix-valued features in graph neural networks. Addresses the limitation that GNNs typically propagate vector features using shared transformations.

entry.title: R2IF: Aligning Reasoning with Decisions via Composite Rewards for Interpretable LLM Function Calling

author.name: Aijia Cheng, Kailong Wang, Ling Shi, Yongxin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes R2IF, a reasoning-aware RL framework for LLM function calling that uses composite rewards including Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness and Specification-Modification-Value rewards optimized via GRPO. Achieves up to 34.62% improvement on BFCL benchmark.

entry.title: Occupancy Reward Shaping: Improving Credit Assignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Aravind Venugopal, Jiayu Chen, Xudong Wu, Chongyi Zheng, Benjamin Eysenbach, Jeff Schneider

entry.summary: Formalizes how world models encode the geometry of goal-reaching via occupancy measures, and uses optimal transport to extract reward functions for better credit assignment in offline goal-conditioned RL.

entry.title: Algorithm Selection with Zero Domain Knowledge via Text Embeddings

author.name: Stefan Szeider

entry.summary: Proposes ZeroFolio, a feature-free approach to algorithm selection that uses pretrained text embeddings of raw instance files as features, combined with k-nearest neighbors. Achieves competitive performance across 11 diverse problem domains without any domain knowledge.

entry.title: TTKV: Temporal-Tiered KV Cache for Long-Context LLM Inference

author.name: Gradwell Dzikanyanga, Weihao Yang, Hao Huang, Donglei Wu, Shihao Wang, Wen Xia, Sanjeeb K C

entry.summary: Proposes TTKV, a KV cache management framework inspired by human memory systems, partitioning the cache into temporal tiers with heterogeneous capacity and precision. Addresses the quadratic memory scaling of long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: Mol-Debate: Multi-Agent Debate Improves Structural Reasoning in Molecular Design

author.name: Wengyu Zhang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes Mol-Debate, a multi-agent debate framework for text-guided molecular design that uses iterative generate-debate-refine loops. Enables dynamic, multi-perspective critique for reconciling natural language instructions with molecular structure feasibility in drug discovery.

entry.title: Online Survival Analysis: A Bandit Approach under Cox PH Model

author.name: Yang Xu, Wenbin Lu, Rui Song

entry.summary: First work integrating survival analysis into a purely online bandit learning setting under the Cox proportional hazards model, addressing staggered entry, delayed feedback, and right censoring. Adapts three canonical bandit algorithms with theoretical regret bounds.

entry.title: WebGen-R1: Incentivizing Large Language Models to Generate Functional and Aesthetic Websites with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juyong Jiang, Chenglin Cai, Chansung Park, Jiasi Shen, Sunghun Kim, Jianguo Li, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Presents WebGen-R1, using RL to train small LLMs for generating functional and aesthetic multi-page websites. Addresses the critical challenge of designing reliable rewards for website generation, moving beyond single-page static generation.

entry.title: AAC: Admissible-by-Architecture Differentiable Landmark Compression for ALT

author.name: An T. Le, Vien Ngo

entry.summary: Introduces AAC, a differentiable landmark-selection module for A* search heuristics that guarantees admissibility by construction through row-stochastic mixtures of triangle-inequality bounds. First differentiable method preserving admissibility in classical heuristic search.

entry.title: Saying More Than They Know: A Framework for Quantifying Epistemic-Rhetorical Miscalibration in Large Language Models

author.name: Asim D. Bakhshi

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for quantifying epistemic-rhetorical miscalibration in LLMs through a triadic marker taxonomy, measuring how LLMs express more confidence rhetorically than their epistemic grounding warrants. Finds a model-agnostic 'LLM epistemic signature' across 225 texts.

entry.title: Large language models perceive cities through a culturally uneven baseline

author.name: Rong Zhao, Wanqi Liu, Zhizhou Sha, Nanxi Su, Yecheng Zhang

entry.summary: Tests whether frontier LLMs perceive cities from a culturally neutral standpoint using global street-view images. Finds that the 'neutral' baseline systematically aligns more with European/Northern American perspectives, revealing culturally uneven perception.

entry.title: Aligning Human-AI-Interaction Trust for Mental Health Support: Survey and Position for Multi-Stakeholders

author.name: Xin Sun, Yue Su, Yifan Mo, Qingyu Meng, Yuxuan Li, Saku Sugawara, Mengyuan Zhang, Charlotte Gerritsen, Sander L. Koole, Koen Hindriks, Jiahuan Pei

entry.summary: Proposes a three-layer trust framework (human-oriented, AI-oriented, interaction-oriented) for AI mental health support systems, integrating perspectives from practitioners, researchers, and regulators. Systematically reviews existing AI-driven mental health research through this framework.

entry.title: Text-to-Distribution Prediction with Quantile Tokens and Neighbor Context

author.name: Yilun Zhu, Yuan Zhuang, Nikhita Vedula, Dushyanta Dhyani, Shaoyuan Xu, Moyan Li, Mohsen Bayati, Bryan Wang, Shervin Malmasi

entry.summary: Introduces Quantile Token Regression, which inserts dedicated quantile tokens into the input sequence of LLMs for distributional regression, enabling direct input-to-quantile attention rather than shared bottleneck representations. Addresses text-to-distribution prediction with neighbor context.

entry.title: Ask Only When Needed: Proactive Retrieval from Memory and Skills for Experience-Driven Lifelong Agents

author.name: Yuxuan Cai, Jie Zhou, Qin Chen, Liang He

entry.summary: Introduces ProactAgent, a lifelong learning framework for agents that proactively retrieves from structured experience memory during interaction, rather than only at task initialization. Includes an Experience-Enhanced Online Evolution mechanism for continual improvement.

entry.title: SpeechParaling-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Paralinguistic-Aware Speech Generation

author.name: Ruohan Liu, Shukang Yin, Tao Wang, Dong Zhang, Weiji Zhuang, Shuhuai Ren, Ran He, Caifeng Shan, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Introduces SpeechParaling-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating paralinguistic-aware speech generation in Large Audio-Language Models, expanding coverage from under 50 to over 100 fine-grained features with 1,000+ English-Chinese parallel queries across three tasks of increasing difficulty.

entry.title: Self-Guided Plan Extraction for Instruction-Following Tasks with Goal-Conditional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zoya Volovikova, Nikita Sorokin, Dmitriy Lukashevskiy, Aleksandr Panov, Alexey Skrynnik

entry.summary: Introduces SuperIgor, a framework for instruction-following where a language model generates and refines high-level plans through self-learning, with iterative co-training between an RL agent and the planning model using RL feedback.

entry.title: SceneOrchestra: Efficient Agentic 3D Scene Synthesis via Full Tool-Call Trajectory Generation

author.name: Yun He, Kelin Yu, Matthias Zwicker

entry.summary: Proposes SceneOrchestra for efficient 3D scene synthesis, replacing iterative execute-review-reflect loops with full tool-call trajectory generation by the LLM orchestrator, reducing rendering overhead and improving execution quality.

entry.title: Gaussians on a Diet: High-Quality Memory-Bounded 3D Gaussian Splatting Training

author.name: Yangming Zhang, Jian Xu, Kunxiong Zhu, Wei Niu, Miao Yin

entry.summary: Proposes a memory-bounded training framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that dynamically optimizes Gaussians through iterative growth and pruning, addressing peak memory spikes during training. This enables deployment on memory-constrained edge devices by controlling densification throughout training rather than only pruning post-training.

entry.title: Rethinking Where to Edit: Task-Aware Localization for Instruction-Based Image Editing

author.name: Jingxuan He, Xiyu Wang, Mengyu Zheng, Xiangyu Zeng, Yunke Wang, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free, task-aware edit localization framework for instruction-based image editing that distinguishes between addition, removal, and replacement operations to prevent over-editing in diffusion transformers.

entry.title: SurgCoT: Advancing Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Surgical Videos through a Chain-of-Thought Benchmark

author.name: Gui Wang, YongSong Zhou, Kaijun Deng, Wooi Ping Cheah, Rong Qu, Jianfeng Ren, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Introduces SurgCoT, a benchmark for evaluating chain-of-thought reasoning in MLLMs across surgical videos spanning 7 specialties and 35 procedures, assessing five core reasoning dimensions with structured CoT annotations.

entry.title: Self-supervised pretraining for an iterative image size agnostic vision transformer

author.name: Nedyalko Prisadnikov, Danda Pani Paudel, Yuqian Fu, Luc Van Gool

entry.summary: Introduces a sequential-to-global self-supervised learning framework for a foveal-inspired, image-size-agnostic Vision Transformer, enabling DINO-style pretraining for resolution-agnostic backbones.

entry.title: Beyond ZOH: Advanced Discretization Strategies for Vision Mamba

author.name: Fady Ibrahim, Guangjun Liu, Guanghui Wang

entry.summary: Systematically compares six discretization schemes (ZOH, FOH, bilinear, polynomial, higher-order hold, RK4) within Vision Mamba, finding that advanced discretization strategies improve over the default zero-order hold.

entry.title: GeoRect4D: Geometry-Compatible Generative Rectification for Dynamic Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Zhenlong Wu, Zihan Zheng, Xuanxuan Wang, Qianhe Wang, Hua Yang, Xiaoyun Zhang, Qiang Hu, Wenjun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoRect4D for sparse-view dynamic 3D reconstruction combining explicit 3D consistency with generative refinement through a closed-loop optimization process with degradation-aware feedback.

entry.title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning using Linear Koopman Dynamics for Nonlinear Robotic Systems

author.name: Wenjian Hao, Yuxuan Fang, Zehui Lu, Shaoshuai Mou

entry.summary: Presents a model-based RL framework using Koopman operator theory to learn linear lifted dynamics for nonlinear robotic systems, integrating with actor-critic architecture using one-step predictions for efficiency.

entry.title: Toward Cooperative Driving in Mixed Traffic: An Adaptive Potential Game-Based Approach with Field Test Verification

author.name: Shiyu Fang, Xiaocong Zhao, Xuekai Liu, Peng Hang, Jianqiang Wang, Yunpeng Wang, Jian Sun

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive potential game framework for cooperative driving in mixed traffic with both connected autonomous vehicles and human-driven vehicles. The approach optimizes both individual and system utility and is validated with field tests on real vehicles.

entry.title: AdaTracker: Learning Adaptive In-Context Policy for Cross-Embodiment Active Visual Tracking

author.name: Kui Wu, Hao Chen, Jinzhu Han, Haijun Liu, Churan Wang, Yizhou Wang, Zhoujun Li, Si Liu, Fangwei Zhong

entry.summary: AdaTracker proposes an adaptive in-context policy learning framework for active visual tracking across diverse robot morphologies. Uses an Embodiment Context Encoder to infer platform-specific constraints from history, dynamically modulating a Context-Aware Policy.

entry.title: Fast and Provably Accurate Sequential Designs using Hilbert Space Gaussian Processes

author.name: Huanyan Zhu, Cheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a Hilbert space GP approximation for the IMSE acquisition function in sequential experimental design, enabling closed-form evaluation through truncated eigenbasis representations. Provides sharp non-asymptotic bounds for both kernel approximation error and IMSE gap.

entry.title: A "Lay" Introduction to "On the Complexity of Neural Computation in Superposition"

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Accessible introduction to a theoretical paper on the computational complexity of neural computation in superposition, explaining how neural networks represent more features than they have dimensions, the relationship to sparse coding, and the theoretical hardness results for recovering superposed computations.

entry.title: Inductive Subgraphs as Shortcuts: Causal Disentanglement for Heterophilic Graph Learning

author.name: Xiangmeng Wang, Qian Li, Haiyang Xia, Hao Miao, Qing Li, Guandong Xu

entry.summary: Examines how recurring inductive subgraphs act as spurious shortcuts in heterophilic graphs, misleading GNNs. Proposes a causal inference approach to correct biased learning behavior induced by these shortcut subgraphs.

entry.title: Surrogate modeling for interpreting black-box LLMs in medical predictions

author.name: Changho Han (Medical Big Data Research Center, Seoul National University Medical Research Center, Seoul National University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Songsoo Kim (Department of Biomedical Systems Informatics, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Dong Won Kim (Department of Biomedical Systems Informatics, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Leo Anthony Celi (Laboratory for Computational Physiology, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA, USA, Department of Biostatistics, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Boston, MA, USA), Jaewoong Kim (Department of Biomedical Systems Informatics, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea), SungA Bae (Department of Cardiology, Yongin Severance Hospital, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Yongin, Republic of Korea, Center for Digital Health, Yongin Severance Hospital, Yonsei University Health System, Yongin, Republic of Korea), Dukyong Yoon (Department of Biomedical Systems Informatics, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea, Institute for Innovation in Digital Healthcare, Severance Hospital, Seoul, Republic of Korea)

entry.summary: Proposes a surrogate modeling framework to explain LLM-encoded medical knowledge by approximating the latent knowledge space through extensive prompting across simulated scenarios. Provides quantitative interpretability for black-box LLM medical predictions.

entry.title: Tracing Relational Knowledge Recall in Large Language Models

author.name: Nicholas Popovi\v{c}, Michael F\"arber

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs recall relational knowledge during generation, finding that per-head attention contributions to residual streams are strong features for linear relation classification. Provides feature attribution analysis explaining why some relations are easier to classify linearly.

entry.title: Less Languages, Less Tokens: An Efficient Unified Logic Cross-lingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Framework

author.name: Chenyuan Zhang, Qiguang Chen, Xie Chen, Zhuotao Tian, Bowen Xing, Meishan Zhang, Libo Qin, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces UL-XCoT, an efficient cross-lingual chain-of-thought reasoning framework that reduces token usage by selecting minimal language sets in a unified logic space and pruning redundant reasoning steps.

entry.title: Dual Causal Inference: Integrating Backdoor Adjustment and Instrumental Variable Learning for Medical VQA

author.name: Zibo Xu, Qiang Li, Ke Lu, Jin Wang, Weizhi Nie, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Proposes Dual Causal Inference framework for Medical VQA that integrates Backdoor Adjustment and Instrumental Variable learning to jointly tackle observable and unobserved confounders in multimodal medical data.

entry.title: Video-ToC: Video Tree-of-Cue Reasoning

author.name: Qizhong Tan, Zhuotao Tian, Guangming Lu, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Introduces Video-ToC, a video reasoning framework using tree-of-cue reasoning with tree-guided visual cue localization and reasoning-demand routing to enhance video LLMs' understanding through structured reasoning.

entry.title: AROMA: Augmented Reasoning Over a Multimodal Architecture for Virtual Cell Genetic Perturbation Modeling

author.name: Zhenyu Wang, Geyan Ye, Wei Liu, Man Tat Alexander Ng

entry.summary: Proposes AROMA, a multimodal architecture for virtual cell genetic perturbation modeling that integrates text, graph topology, and protein sequences. Uses two-stage optimization for accurate and interpretable predictions of molecular state changes under genetic perturbations.

entry.title: GSCompleter: A Distillation-Free Plugin for Metric-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting Completion in Seconds

author.name: Ao Gao, Jingyu Gong, Xin Tan, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Proposes GSCompleter, a distillation-free plugin for 3D Gaussian Splatting scene completion under sparse views using a 'Generate-then-Register' workflow with stereo-anchor mechanism for metric-scale 3D primitive generation.

entry.title: Has Automated Essay Scoring Reached Sufficient Accuracy? Deriving Achievable QWK Ceilings from Classical Test Theory

author.name: Masaki Uto

entry.summary: Derives theoretical QWK ceilings for automated essay scoring based on classical test theory, showing what performance is achievable given inherent human rater noise. Finds current AES systems may already reach human-like performance on some datasets.

entry.title: FASE : A Fairness-Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph Framework for Predictive Policing

author.name: Pronob Kumar Barman, Pronoy Kumar Barman, Plaban Kumar Barman, Rohan Mandar Salvi

entry.summary: Presents FASE, a fairness-aware spatiotemporal framework for predictive policing that integrates crime prediction with fairness-constrained patrol allocation and feedback simulation, tested on Baltimore data.

entry.title: The Cost of Relaxation: Evaluating the Error in Convex Neural Network Verification

author.name: Merkouris Papamichail, Konstantinos Varsos, Giorgos Flouris, Jo\~ao Marques-Silva

entry.summary: Studies the worst-case divergence between neural networks and their convex relaxations used in verification, providing analytical bounds and showing relaxations form a lattice structure.

entry.title: Handling and Interpreting Missing Modalities in Patient Clinical Trajectories via Autoregressive Sequence Modeling

author.name: Andrew Wang, Ellie Pavlick, Ritambhara Singh

entry.summary: Proposes an autoregressive sequence modeling approach for handling missing modalities in clinical patient trajectories, using causal decoders from LLMs. Introduces a missingness-aware contrastive pre-training objective to integrate multiple modalities in sparse clinical datasets while retaining explainability.

entry.title: MORPHOGEN: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Gender-Aware Morphological Generation

author.name: Mehul Agarwal, Aditya Aggarwal, Arnav Goel, Medha Hira, Anubha Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces MORPHOGEN, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to handle grammatical gender and morphological agreement in French, Arabic, and Hindi. The core task requires rewriting first-person sentences in the opposite gender.

entry.title: AutoAWG: Adverse Weather Generation with Adaptive Multi-Controls for Automotive Videos

author.name: Jiagao Hu, Daiguo Zhou, Danzhen Fu, Fuhao Li, Zepeng Wang, Fei Wang, Wenhua Liao, Jiayi Xie, Haiyang Sun

entry.summary: Presents AutoAWG, a controllable adverse weather video generation framework for autonomous driving that uses semantics-guided adaptive fusion and vanishing point-anchored temporal synthesis to generate realistic weather conditions while preserving safety-critical annotations.

entry.title: SAHM: A Benchmark for Arabic Financial and Shari'ah-Compliant Reasoning

author.name: Rania Elbadry, Sarfraz Ahmad, Ahmed Heakl, Dani Bouch, Momina Ahsan, Muhra AlMahri, Marwa Elsaid khalil, Yuxia Wang, Salem Lahlou, Sophia Ananiadou, Veselin Stoyanov, Jimin Huang, Xueqing Peng, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie

entry.summary: Introduces SAHM, a benchmark for Arabic financial NLP and Shari'ah-compliant reasoning with 14,380 expert-verified instances spanning seven tasks, evaluating 19 open and closed models.

entry.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: A Component-Wise Evaluation Framework for Medical Question Answering Systems with Health Equity Implications

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, Md. Main Oddin Chisty, Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VB-Score, a component-wise evaluation framework for medical question answering that separately evaluates entity recognition, semantic similarity, factual consistency, and structured information completeness, with health equity implications.

entry.title: Mesh Memory Protocol: Semantic Infrastructure for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Hongwei Xu

entry.summary: Mesh Memory Protocol proposes semantic infrastructure for multi-agent LLM systems enabling cross-session cognitive collaboration, with field-level acceptance/rejection, claim traceability, and conflict resolution for long-running agent teams.

entry.title: Cross-Model Consistency of AI-Generated Exercise Prescriptions: A Repeated Generation Study Across Three Large Language Models

author.name: Kihyuk Lee

entry.summary: Compares exercise prescription consistency across GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, finding fundamentally different generative behaviors: GPT-4.1 produces near-identical outputs while Claude shows higher surface variation despite similar semantic content.

entry.title: Towards Streaming Target Speaker Extraction via Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing of Autoregressive Language Model

author.name: Shuhai Peng, Hui Lu, Jinjiang Liu, Liyang Chen, Guiping Zhong, Jiakui Li, Huimeng Wang, Haiyun Li, Liang Cao, Shiyin Kang, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Presents the first autoregressive models for streaming target speaker extraction, introducing a chunk-wise interleaved splicing paradigm for efficient streaming inference with historical context refinement for boundary coherence.

entry.title: Multi-Cycle Spatio-Temporal Adaptation in Human-Robot Teaming

author.name: Alex Cuellar, Michael Hagenow, Julie Shah

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated spatio-temporal adaptation framework for human-robot teaming that jointly optimizes task-level allocation and motion-level adaptation over repeated interaction cycles in manufacturing settings.

entry.title: Generalization and Membership Inference Attack a Practical Perspective

author.name: Fateme Rahmani, Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani, Mohammad Hossein Rohban

entry.summary: Revisits the correlation between membership inference attack success and model generalization, finding that advanced generalization techniques (augmentation, early stopping) can decrease attack performance by up to 100x.

entry.title: Improved large-scale graph learning through ridge spectral sparsification

author.name: Daniele Calandriello, Ioannis Koutis, Alessandro Lazaric, Michal Valko

entry.summary: GSQUEAK efficiently sparsifies graph Laplacians in distributed streaming settings by maintaining a small subset of effective resistances, with strong spectral approximation guarantees.

entry.title: Pairing Regularization for Mitigating Many-to-One Collapse in GANs

author.name: Kuan-Yu Lin, Yu-Chih Huang, Tie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a pairing regularizer for GANs to mitigate intra-mode (many-to-one) collapse by enforcing local consistency between latent variables and generated samples, distinct from the more-studied inter-mode collapse.

entry.title: Fourier Weak SINDy: Spectral Test Function Selection for Robust Model Identification

author.name: Zhiheng Chen, Urban Fasel, Anastasia Bizyaeva

entry.summary: Fourier Weak SINDy combines weak-form sparse equation learning with spectral density estimation, using sinusoidal test functions to reduce the regression to Fourier coefficients with multitaper-selected frequencies.

entry.title: SMART: A Spectral Transfer Approach to Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Boxin Zhao, Mladen Kolar, Jinchi Lv

entry.summary: SMART proposes spectral transfer for multi-task regression assuming target singular subspaces lie within source subspaces with sparse alignment, going beyond standard bounded-difference assumptions.

entry.title: Explicit Dropout: Deterministic Regularization for Transformer Architectures

author.name: Vidhi Agrawal, Illia Oleksiienko, Alexandros Iosifidis

entry.summary: Reformulates stochastic dropout as a deterministic additive regularizer directly in the training loss for Transformer architectures. Provides explicit regularization terms for attention components with independently controllable strengths.

entry.title: Tokenised Flow Matching for Hierarchical Simulation Based Inference

author.name: Giovanni Charles, Cosmo Santoni, Seth Flaxman, Elizaveta Semenova

entry.summary: Proposes Tokenised Flow Matching for hierarchical simulation-based inference, exploiting likelihood factorisation to train from single-site simulations rather than requiring multi-site data. Assembles synthetic multi-site observations for amortised inference.

entry.title: SkillGraph: Graph Foundation Priors for LLM Agent Tool Sequence Recommendation

author.name: Hao Liu, Dongyu Li

entry.summary: Introduces SkillGraph, a directed weighted execution-transition graph mined from 49,831 successful LLM agent trajectories, encoding workflow precedence for tool sequence recommendation. Uses a two-stage retrieval-then-reranking approach.

Yuan, S. Yun-C\'arcamo, A. Zander Jurowitzki, A. Zegarelli, S. Zhang, Z. Zhang, P. Zhelnin, P. Zilberman

entry.summary: Applies transformer-encoded normalizing flows on the 2-sphere for neutrino direction reconstruction in IceCube, achieving state-of-the-art angular resolution for both track and shower events while being significantly faster than traditional methods.

entry.title: MMCORE: MultiModal COnnection with Representation Aligned Latent Embeddings

author.name: Zijie Li, Yichun Shi, Jingxiang Sun, Ye Wang, Yixuan Huang, Zhiyao Guo, Xiaochen Lian, Peihao Zhu, Yu Tian, Zhonghua Zhai, Peng Wang

entry.summary: Presents MMCORE, a unified multimodal generation framework using a pre-trained VLM to predict semantic visual embeddings via learnable query tokens, which condition a diffusion model. Avoids deep fusion or training from scratch.

entry.title: Robust Out-of-Distribution Stochastic Optimization

author.name: Xianyu Li, Huan Xu, Xiaolin Huang, Chao Shang

entry.summary: Proposes a robust out-of-distribution stochastic optimization framework using meta-distributions over distributions and data-driven uncertainty sets in RKHS. Provides theoretical guarantees for decision-making when no data from the target distribution is available.

entry.title: WildFireVQA: A Large-Scale Radiometric Thermal VQA Benchmark for Aerial Wildfire Monitoring

author.name: Mobin Habibpour, Niloufar Alipour Talemi, John Spodnik, Camren J. Khoury, Fatemeh Afghah

entry.summary: Introduces WildFireVQA, a large-scale VQA benchmark for aerial wildfire monitoring integrating RGB and radiometric thermal data. Contains 6,097 samples with 207,298 questions spanning detection, classification, localization, and cross-modal reasoning tasks.

entry.title: VTouch++: A Multimodal Dataset with Vision-Based Tactile Enhancement for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Qianxi Hua, Xinyue Li, Zheng Yan, Yang Li, Chi Zhang, Yongyao Li, Yufei Liu

entry.summary: Introduces VTouch++, a multimodal dataset for bimanual manipulation with vision-based tactile sensing, matrix-style task design, and automated data collection. Addresses the lack of rich physical interaction datasets for contact-rich robotic manipulation.

entry.title: pAI/MSc: ML Theory Research with Humans on the Loop

author.name: Mahmoud Abdelmoneum, Pierfrancesco Beneventano, Tomaso Poggio

entry.summary: Presents pAI/MSc, a multi-agent system for academic research workflows that reduces human steering needed to turn hypotheses into manuscript drafts. Open-source, modular system focused on ML theory research. Co-authored by Tomaso Poggio (MIT).

entry.title: LLM Agents Predict Social Media Reactions but Do Not Outperform Text Classifiers: Benchmarking Simulation Accuracy Using 120K+ Personas of 1511 Humans

author.name: Ljubisa Bojic, Alexander Felfernig, Bojana Dinic, Velibor Ilic, Achim Rettinger, Vera Mevorah, Damian Trilling

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLM agents' ability to predict individual social media reactions using 120K+ persona-agent combinations from 1,511 Serbian participants. Finds agents achieve 70.7% accuracy but do not outperform text classifiers.

entry.title: Commonsense Knowledge with Negation: A Resource to Enhance Negation Understanding

author.name: Zijie Wang, MohammadHossein Rezaei, Farzana Rashid, Eduardo Blanco

entry.summary: Shows that commonsense knowledge with negation is challenging for LLMs and presents an approach to automatically augment commonsense knowledge corpora with negation, yielding 2M+ triples. Pre-training on these corpora improves negation understanding.

entry.title: TriEx: A Game-based Tri-View Framework for Explaining Internal Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Ziyi Wang, Chen Zhang, Wenjun Peng, Qi Wu, Xinyu Wang

entry.summary: Presents TriEx, a tri-view explainability framework for multi-agent LLMs using first-person reasoning, second-person belief states, and third-person oracle audits. Applied to imperfect-information strategic games to create evidence-anchored explanations.

entry.title: Aligning Stuttered-Speech Research with End-User Needs: Scoping Review, Survey, and Guidelines

author.name: Hawau Olamide Toyin, Mutiah Apampa, Toluwani Aremu, Humaid Alblooshi, Ana Rita Valente, Gon\c{c}alo Leal, Zhengjun Yue, Zeerak Talat, Hanan Aldarmaki

entry.summary: Combines a scoping review of stuttered-speech research with a survey of 70 stakeholders (people who stutter and speech-language pathologists) to identify misalignment between research priorities and end-user needs, proposing a taxonomy and guidelines.

entry.title: Exploiting LLM-as-a-Judge Disposition on Free Text Legal QA via Prompt Optimization

author.name: Mohamed Hesham Elganayni, Runsheng Chen, Sebastian Nagl, Matthias Grabmair

entry.summary: Explores prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge in legal QA evaluation, finding that automatic optimization outperforms human-designed prompts, lenient judge feedback yields more consistent gains, and optimized prompts don't always transfer across different judge models.

entry.title: Do Small Language Models Know When They're Wrong? Confidence-Based Cascade Scoring for Educational Assessment

author.name: Tyler Burleigh

entry.summary: Explores verbalized confidence as a routing signal in cascade scoring systems for educational assessment, testing GPT-5.4, Claude 4.5+, and Gemini 3.1 model pairs. Finds that confidence discrimination varies widely across small LMs and cascading can achieve cost savings while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Environmental Understanding Vision-Language Model for Embodied Agent

author.name: Jinsik Bang, Jaeyeon Bae, Donggyu Lee, Siyeol Jung, Taehwan Kim

entry.summary: Proposes EUEA, a framework that fine-tunes VLMs on four core embodied skills (object perception, task planning, action understanding, goal recognition) to improve environmental understanding for embodied agents.

entry.title: Infection-Reasoner: A Compact Vision-Language Model for Wound Infection Classification with Evidence-Grounded Clinical Reasoning

author.name: Palawat Busaranuvong, Reza Saadati Fard, Emmanuel Agu, Deepak Kumar, Shefalika Gautam, Bengisu Tulu, Diane Strong

entry.summary: Presents Infection-Reasoner, a compact 4B-parameter vision-language model for chronic wound infection classification with evidence-grounded reasoning, using GPT-5.1 for reasoning distillation and chain-of-thought rationale generation.

entry.title: PASTA: A Patch-Agnostic Twofold-Stealthy Backdoor Attack on Vision Transformers

author.name: Dazhuang Liu, Yanqi Qiao, Rui Wang, Kaitai Liang, Georgios Smaragdakis

entry.summary: Introduces PASTA, a backdoor attack on Vision Transformers that exploits the self-attention mechanism's long-range dependencies through a 'Trigger Radiating Effect' where triggers activate across neighboring patches. Demonstrates a stealthier attack that works at multiple patch locations during inference.

entry.title: DynamicRad: Content-Adaptive Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion

author.name: Yongji Long, Shijun Liang, Jintao Li, Yun Li

entry.summary: Proposes DynamicRad, a content-adaptive sparse attention method for long video diffusion that uses dual-mode static-ratio/dynamic-threshold strategy with Bayesian optimization and semantic motion routing.

entry.title: Learning Hippo: Multi-attractor Dynamics and Stability Effects in a Biologically Detailed CA3 Extension of Hopfield Networks

author.name: Daniele Corradetti, Renato Corradetti

entry.summary: Presents a biologically detailed CA3 hippocampal model extending Hopfield networks with ten populations, forty-seven compartments, and multi-rule plasticity, demonstrating multi-attractor dynamics and oscillation-gated consolidation.

entry.title: Lexicographic Minimum-Violation Motion Planning using Signal Temporal Logic

author.name: Patrick Halder, Lothar Kiltz, Hannes Homburger, Johannes Reuter, Matthias Althoff

entry.summary: Proposes a method for minimum-violation motion planning using Signal Temporal Logic, transforming a lexicographic multi-objective optimization into a more tractable single-objective problem. This enables autonomous vehicles to gracefully handle situations where not all specifications can be simultaneously satisfied.

entry.title: Smart Contracts as Credible Commitments for Trading with Scheming AIs

author.name: Ram Potham

entry.summary: Proposes using smart contracts as credible commitment mechanisms for trading with potentially scheming AIs, addressing the 'honeypot problem' where AIs might not trust lab-offered deals. Argues smart contracts reduce the ability to honeypot by making commitments verifiable on-chain.

entry.title: CoDA: Towards Effective Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via CoT-guided Domain Adaptation

author.name: Jianzhi Yan, Le Liu, Buzhou Tang, Yang Xiang, Dongning Sun, Zhiming Li

entry.summary: Proposes CoDA, a method for cross-domain knowledge transfer via CoT-guided domain adaptation, addressing scenarios where in-domain exemplars are scarce or unavailable.

entry.title: Time Series Augmented Generation for Financial Applications

author.name: Anton Kolonin, Alexey Glushchenko, Evgeny Bochkov, Abhishek Saxena

entry.summary: Introduces TSAG (Time Series Augmented Generation) framework for evaluating LLM agents on financial time-series analysis, with a 100-question benchmark comparing GPT-4o, Llama 3, Qwen and others.

entry.title: CentaurTA Studio: A Self-Improving Human-Agent Collaboration System for Thematic Analysis

author.name: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Presents CentaurTA Studio, a human-agent collaboration system for thematic analysis that integrates persistent prompt optimization and rubric-based evaluation, achieving up to 92.12% accuracy.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Continual Learning for Sequential Deployment of Nuclear Plant Monitoring Systems

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Sajedul Talukder, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Presents the first SNN-based anomaly detection system with continual learning for nuclear industrial control systems, addressing catastrophic forgetting in safety-critical monitoring.

entry.title: DanceCrafter: Fine-Grained Text-Driven Controllable Dance Generation via Choreographic Syntax

author.name: Hang Yuan, Xiaolin Hu, Yan Wan, Menglin Gao, Wenzhe Yu, Cong Huang, Fei Xu, Qing Li, Christina Dan Wang, Zhou Yu, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Choreographic Syntax theory and DanceFlow dataset for fine-grained text-driven controllable dance generation, bridging dance studies, anatomy, and biomechanics.

entry.title: A Proxy Consistency Loss for Grounded Fusion of Earth Observation and Location Encoders

author.name: Zhongying Wang, Kevin Lane, Levi Cai, Morteza Karimzadeh, Esther Rolf

entry.summary: Introduces a proxy consistency loss for fusing Earth observation satellite imagery with location encoders, leveraging abundantly available proxy variables (correlated but different from the target) to improve predictions when labeled data is scarce.

entry.title: SAMoRA: Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts for Task-Adaptive Learning

author.name: Boyan Shi, Wei Chen, Shuyuan Zhao, Junfeng Shen, Shengnan Guo, Shaojiang Wang, Huaiyu Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SAMoRA, a semantic-aware mixture of LoRA experts that explicitly matches input semantics with expert capabilities and provides adaptive update strengths based on task complexity.

entry.title: Sherpa.ai Privacy-Preserving Multi-Party Entity Alignment without Intersection Disclosure for Noisy Identifiers

author.name: Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez, Enrique Zuazua, Georgios Kellaris, Joaquin Del Rio, Oleksii Sliusarenko, Xabi Uribe-Etxebarria

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving multi-party entity alignment method for federated learning that handles noisy identifiers without disclosing intersection membership, going beyond standard private set intersection protocols.

entry.title: PLaMo 2.1-VL Technical Report

author.name: Tommi Kerola, Yuya Masuda, Takashi Masuko, Toshiki Nakanishi, Daisuke Nishino, Kuniyuki Takahashi, Hanqin Wang, Yoshihiro Yamada

entry.summary: Introduces PLaMo 2.1-VL, a lightweight Vision Language Model (8B and 2B variants) designed for edge deployment with Japanese-language operation, focusing on VQA and visual grounding for factory inspection and infrastructure anomaly detection.

entry.title: Multimodal Transformer for Sample-Aware Prediction of Metal-Organic Framework Properties

author.name: Seunghee Han, Jaewoong Lee, Jihan Kim

entry.summary: EXIT is a multimodal transformer that combines MOF identity (MOFid) with X-ray diffraction data for sample-aware property prediction of metal-organic frameworks, addressing the issue that experimental samples of the same framework can have different properties due to defects and crystallinity variations.

entry.title: Revisiting RaBitQ and TurboQuant: A Symmetric Comparison of Methods, Theory, and Experiments

author.name: Jianyang Gao, Yutong Gou, Yuexuan Xu, Jifan Shi, Yongyi Yang, Shuolin Li, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong, Cheng Long

entry.summary: Revisits the comparison between RaBitQ and TurboQuant vector quantization methods, finding that TurboQuant does not consistently improve over RaBitQ and several reported results could not be reproduced.

entry.title: EgoSelf: From Memory to Personalized Egocentric Assistant

author.name: Yanshuo Wang, Yuan Xu, Xuesong Li, Jie Hong, Yizhou Wang, Chang Wen Chen, Wentao Zhu

entry.summary: EgoSelf builds a graph-based interaction memory from egocentric observations for personalized assistance, capturing temporal and semantic relationships among events to derive user-specific profiles for prediction tasks.

entry.title: CoCo-SAM3: Harnessing Concept Conflict in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Yanhui Chen, Baoyao Yang, Siqi Liu, Jingchao Wang

entry.summary: CoCo-SAM3 improves open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by addressing concept conflicts through explicit decoupling of intra-class enhancement and inter-class competition in SAM3's prompt-driven segmentation.

entry.title: Fast Amortized Fitting of Scientific Signals Across Time and Ensembles via Transferable Neural Fields

author.name: Sophia Zorek, Kushal Vyas, Yuhao Liu, David Lenz, Tom Peterka, Guha Balakrishnan

entry.summary: Extends implicit neural representations to handle spatiotemporal and multivariate scientific signals, showing how INR features can be transferred across time steps and ensemble runs for amortized fitting of scientific data.

entry.title: Analysis of Nystrom method with sequential ridge leverage scores

author.name: Daniele Calandriello, Alessandro Lazaric, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Analyzes Nyström approximation with sequential ridge leverage scores for kernel ridge regression, studying how approximate leverage scores affect statistical-computational tradeoffs in streaming settings.

entry.title: Energy-Based Open-Set Active Learning for Object Classification

author.name: Zongyao Lyu, William J. Beksi

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stage energy-based framework for open-set active learning that handles both known and unknown classes using two specialized energy-based models for sample selection.

entry.title: Learning to Solve the Quadratic Assignment Problem with Warm-Started MCMC Finetuning

author.name: Yicheng Pan, Ruisong Zhou, Haijun Zou, Tianyou Li, Zaiwen Wen

entry.summary: PLMA proposes a permutation learning framework for the quadratic assignment problem with warm-started MCMC finetuning, using an additive energy-based model enabling O(1)-time Metropolis-Hastings proposals.

entry.title: A Delta-Aware Orchestration Framework for Scalable Multi-Agent Edge Computing

author.name: Samaresh Kumar Singh, Joyjit Roy

entry.summary: DAOEF addresses synergistic collapse in multi-agent edge computing (beyond 100 agents), combining differential action-space compression, spatial redundancy elimination, and task-aware hardware scheduling for smart city deployment.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Variational Learning of a Class of Generalized Diffusions

author.name: Yubin Lu, Xiaofan Li, Chun Liu, Qi Tang, Yiwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a structure-aware, energy-based learning framework for inferring potential functions in generalized diffusion processes, grounded in the energetic variational approach and Fokker-Planck equations. Uses De Giorgi dissipation functionals as loss functions for learning from partial noisy observations.

entry.title: Calibrating conditional risk

author.name: Andrey Vasilyev, Yikai Wang, Xiaocheng Li, Guanting Chen

entry.summary: Introduces the problem of calibrating conditional risk — estimating expected loss conditional on features — and shows it is fundamentally equivalent to regression. Establishes connections to probability calibration and develops theoretical performance metrics.

entry.title: COMPASS: COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling

author.name: Noah Flynn

entry.summary: Introduces COMPASS, a data-centric framework for multilingual LLM adaptation using language-specific PEFT adapters trained on semantically selected multilingual data. Uses distribution-aware sampling to identify semantic gaps between training data and target usage.

entry.title: Relative Entropy Estimation in Function Space: Theory and Applications to Trajectory Inference

author.name: Chao Wang, Luca Nepote, Giulio Franzese, Pietro Michiardi

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for estimating KL divergence between probability measures on function space for trajectory inference, providing a tractable data-driven estimator. Validates on single-cell genomics applications.

entry.title: Hidden Reliability Risks in Large Language Models: Systematic Identification of Precision-Induced Output Disagreements

author.name: Yifei Wang, Tianlin Li, Xiaohan Zhang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Wei Ma, Mingfei Cheng, Li Pan

entry.summary: Presents PrecisionDiff, a differential testing framework for detecting precision-induced behavioral disagreements in LLMs across different numerical formats (bfloat16, float16, int8). Generates precision-sensitive test inputs for cross-precision analysis.

entry.title: ChipCraftBrain: Validation-First RTL Generation via Multi-Agent Orchestration

author.name: Cagri Eryilmaz

entry.summary: Presents ChipCraftBrain, a multi-agent framework for RTL code generation combining symbolic-neural reasoning with PPO-based adaptive orchestration over six specialized agents. Targets functional correctness on industrial-difficulty benchmarks.

entry.title: Toward Safe Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Interventions using World Models

author.name: Harry Robertshaw, Nikola Fischer, Han-Ru Wu, Andrea Walker Perez, Weiyuan Deng, Benjamin Jackson, Christos Bergeles, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C Booth

entry.summary: Investigates world-model-based RL (TD-MPC2) for autonomous endovascular navigation in robotic surgery, evaluating across patient-specific vasculatures. Addresses challenges of variable anatomy and real-time control for mechanical thrombectomy.

entry.title: Auto-ART: Structured Literature Synthesis and Automated Adversarial Robustness Testing

author.name: Abhijit Talluri

entry.summary: Introduces Auto-ART, an open-source adversarial robustness testing framework with 50+ attacks, 28 defenses, gradient-masking detection, and compliance mapping to NIST AI RMF and OWASP. Includes structured synthesis of robustness literature from 2020-2026.

entry.title: PR-CAD: Progressive Refinement for Unified Controllable and Faithful Text-to-CAD Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Jiyuan An, Jiachen Zhao, Fan Chen, Liner Yang, Zhenghao Liu, Hongyan Wang, Weihua An, Meishan Zhang, Erhong Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PR-CAD, a progressive refinement framework unifying CAD generation and editing from text using LLMs. Curates a lifecycle dataset spanning multiple CAD representations with both qualitative and quantitative descriptions.

entry.title: To Know is to Construct: Schema-Constrained Generation for Agent Memory

author.name: Lei Zheng, Weinan Song, Daili Li, Yanming Yang

entry.summary: Proposes schema-constrained generation for agent memory inspired by constructivist epistemology. Addresses failure modes of both dense retrieval (context-mismatched entries) and open-ended generation (structural hallucination) through schema-guided memory access.

entry.title: Effects of Cross-lingual Evidence in Multilingual Medical Question Answering

author.name: Anar Yeginbergen, Maite Oronoz, Rodrigo Agerri

entry.summary: Investigates multilingual medical QA across high-resource and low-resource languages, evaluating different external evidence sources and retrieval strategies. Finds web-retrieved English data helps high-resource languages while LLM-generated explanations best support low-resource languages.

entry.title: Can "AI" Be a Doctor? A Study of Empathy, Readability, and Alignment in Clinical LLMs

author.name: Mariano Barone, Francesco Di Serio, Roberto Moio, Marco Postiglione, Giuseppe Riccio, Antonio Romano, Vincenzo Moscato

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs including GPT-5 and Claude for clinical communication quality across semantic fidelity, readability, and empathy. Finds that larger models produce overly complex text compared to physicians, and empathy-oriented prompting can partially mitigate this.

entry.title: Camera Control for Text-to-Image Generation via Learning Viewpoint Tokens

author.name: Xinxuan Lu, Charless Fowlkes, Alexander C. Berg

entry.summary: Presents a framework for precise camera control in text-to-image generation by learning parametric viewpoint tokens, fine-tuned on combined 3D-rendered images and photorealistic augmentations.

entry.title: Opportunistic Bone-Loss Screening from Routine Knee Radiographs Using a Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework with Sensitivity-Constrained Threshold Optimization

author.name: Zhaochen Li, Xinghao Yan, Runni Zhou, Xiaoyang Li, Chenjie Zhu, Gege Wang, Yu Shi, Lixin Zhang, Rongrong Fu, Liehao Yan, Yuan Chai

entry.summary: Develops STR-Net, a multi-task deep learning system for opportunistic bone-loss screening from routine knee radiographs, enabling osteoporosis/osteopenia detection without additional DXA imaging.

entry.title: Fourier Series Coder: A Novel Perspective on Angle Boundary Discontinuity Problem for Oriented Object Detection

author.name: Minghong Wei, Pu Cao, Zhihao Chen, Zhiyuan Zang, Lu Yang, Qing Song

entry.summary: Proposes Fourier Series Coder for oriented object detection that addresses angle boundary discontinuity through orthogonal Fourier basis decomposition, avoiding structural noise amplification in non-orthogonal decoding.

entry.title: RefAerial: A Benchmark and Approach for Referring Detection in Aerial Images

author.name: Guyue Hu, Hao Song, Yuxing Tong, Duzhi Yuan, Dengdi Sun, Aihua Zheng, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Introduces RefAerial, a large-scale dataset for referring detection in aerial images with characteristics including low object-to-scene ratios, numerous targets, and fine-grained descriptions, plus a human-in-the-loop annotation engine.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Conditional Diffusion for Motion-Robust Retinal Temporal Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging

author.name: Qian Chen, Yuehao Chen, Qiang Wang, Lei Zhu, Yanye Lu, Qiushi Ren

entry.summary: Proposes RetinaDiff, a physics-informed conditional diffusion model for retinal laser speckle contrast imaging that is robust to motion artifacts and requires only a few frames for temporal reconstruction.

entry.title: Stochastic Barrier Certificates in the Presence of Dynamic Obstacles

author.name: Rayan Mazouz, Luca Laurenti, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Introduces time-invariant and time-varying stochastic barrier certificates for ensuring safety of discrete-time systems with dynamic obstacles. The time-varying formulation uses Bellman's optimality perspective to capture temporal structure, yielding less conservative bounds than prior approaches.

entry.title: ALAS: Adaptive Long-Horizon Action Synthesis via Async-pathway Stream Disentanglement

author.name: Yutong Shen, Hangxu Liu, Lei Zhang, Penghui Liu, Yinqi Liu, Liuxiang Yang, Tongtong Feng

entry.summary: ALAS is a framework for long-horizon human-scene interaction tasks that uses biologically-inspired dual-stream disentanglement (where/what pathways) to separate environment observation from self-state, enabling cross-domain generalization to new environment-skill combinations.

entry.title: Marginal Risk is BS

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: Critiques the concept of 'marginal risk' in AI policy - the idea that one can justify building dangerous AI by arguing the incremental risk is small given others are already building similar systems. Uses gain-of-function research analogy to argue this reasoning is fundamentally flawed.

entry.title: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically

author.name: Marti\~no R\'ios-Garc\'ia, Nawaf Alampara, Chandan Gupta, Indrajeet Mandal, Sajid Mannan, Ali Asghar Aghajani, N. M. Anoop Krishnan, Kevin Maik Jablonka

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Evaluates LLM-based scientific agents across 8 domains with 25,000+ runs, finding that agents produce results without adhering to epistemic norms of scientific reasoning. The base model accounts for 41.4% of performance variance, and agents exhibit confirmation bias and lack self-correction.

entry.title: OmniMouse: Scaling properties of multi-modal, multi-task Brain Models on 150B Neural Tokens

author.name: Konstantin F. Willeke, Polina Turishcheva, Alex Gilbert, Goirik Chakrabarty, Hasan A. Bedel, Paul G. Fahey, Yongrong Qiu, Marissa A. Weis, Michaela Vystr\v{c}ilov\'a, Taliah Muhammad, Lydia Ntanavara, Rachel E. Froebe, Kayla Ponder, Zheng Huan Tan, Emin Orhan, Erick Cobos, Sophia Sanborn, Katrin Franke, Fabian H. Sinz, Alexander S. Ecker, Andreas S. Tolias

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Presents OmniMouse, a multi-modal multi-task brain model trained on 150 billion neural tokens from 3.1 million neurons across 73 mice. Achieves state-of-the-art neural prediction, behavioral decoding, and neural forecasting, demonstrating scaling laws apply to brain modeling.

entry.title: From Experience to Skill: Multi-Agent Generative Engine Optimization via Reusable Strategy Learning

author.name: Beining Wu, Fuyou Mao, Jiong Lin, Cheng Yang, Jiaxuan Lu, Yifu Guo, Siyu Zhang, Yifan Wu, Ying Huang, Fu Li

entry.summary: Reframes Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as a strategy learning problem, proposing MAGEO, a multi-agent framework that distills reusable optimization skills for improving content visibility in AI-generated answers.

entry.title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Chenghao Li, Shuxu Chen, Qigan Sun, Jiaquan Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Tae-Ho Kim, Jiwei Wei, Malu Zhang, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Agent-GWO, a multi-agent framework using Grey Wolf Optimization for joint optimization of LLM prompts and decoding hyperparameters, addressing limitations of single-agent prompt optimization.

entry.title: REVEAL: Multimodal Vision-Language Alignment of Retinal Morphometry and Clinical Risks for Incident AD and Dementia Prediction

author.name: Seowung Leem, Lin Gu, Chenyu You, Kuang Gong, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Introduces REVEAL, a multimodal vision-language framework that aligns retinal morphometric features with clinical risk factors for early prediction of Alzheimer's disease and dementia, using cross-modal alignment to capture joint patterns.

entry.title: SCURank: Ranking Multiple Candidate Summaries with Summary Content Units for Enhanced Summarization

author.name: Bo-Jyun Wang, Ying-Jia Lin, Hung-Yu Kao

entry.summary: Proposes SCURank, a framework for ranking summary candidates using Summary Content Units (SCUs) rather than surface-level metrics or unstable LLM comparisons, improving distillation of summaries from diverse LLMs.

entry.title: IndiaFinBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Model Performance on Indian Financial Regulatory Text

author.name: Rajveer Singh Pall

entry.summary: Introduces IndiaFinBench, the first evaluation benchmark for LLMs on Indian financial regulatory text (SEBI, RBI), with 406 expert-annotated QA pairs across four task types including regulatory interpretation and contradiction detection.

entry.title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues

author.name: Fanyu Wang, Xiaoxi Kang, Paul Burgess, Aashish Srivastava, Chetan Arora, Adnan Trakic, Lay-Ki Soon, Md Khalid Hossain, Lizhen Qu

entry.summary: LePREC addresses legal issue identification using LLMs, showing that GPT-4o achieves only 62% precision on this task. Proposes a structured reasoning approach inspired by legal professionals, tested on 769 Malaysian Contract Act court cases.

entry.title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps

author.name: Lekai Qian, Haoyu Gu, Jingwei Zhao, Ziyu Wang

entry.summary: BEAT proposes tokenizing symbolic music using uniform temporal steps (beats) rather than variable-duration event sequences, offering a more natural representation of musical time for language model-based music generation.

entry.title: Environmental Sound Deepfake Detection Using Deep-Learning Framework

author.name: Lam Pham, Khoi Vu, Dat Tran, Phat Lam, Vu Nguyen, David Fischinger, Alexander Schindler, Martin Boyer, Son Le

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework for environmental sound deepfake detection, exploring spectrograms, architectures, and pre-trained models. Finds that sound scene and sound event deepfake detection should be treated as separate tasks.

entry.title: Transparent Screening for LLM Inference and Training Impacts

author.name: Arnault Pachot, Thierry Petit

entry.summary: Presents a transparent screening framework for estimating environmental impacts (inference and training) of current LLMs under limited observability, with an auditable proxy methodology for comparing market models.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Generating Covalent Inhibitor Candidates

author.name: Renee Gil

entry.summary: Applies multi-objective RL with Pareto crowding distance to generate covalent inhibitor candidates for EGFR and ACHE, using SMILES-based LSTM with policy gradient optimization balancing multiple scoring functions.

entry.title: Distributional Value Estimation Without Target Networks for Robust Quality-Diversity

author.name: Behrad Koohy, Jamie Bayne

entry.summary: Introduces QDHUAC, a sample-efficient quality-diversity algorithm that removes target networks by using distributional value estimation, significantly reducing computational overhead while maintaining diversity in skill discovery.

entry.title: Amortized Vine Copulas for High-Dimensional Density and Information Estimation

author.name: Houman Safaai

entry.summary: Proposes Vine Denoising Copula (VDC), an amortized vine-copula pipeline that trains a single bivariate denoising model reused across all vine edges, with Sinkhorn projection for copula constraints. Maintains exact vine likelihood while replacing per-edge optimization with GPU inference.

entry.title: Closing the Domain Gap in Biomedical Imaging by In-Context Control Samples

author.name: Ana Sanchez-Fernandez, Thomas Pinetz, Werner Zellinger, G\"unter Klambauer

entry.summary: Proposes CS-ARM-BN, a meta-learning method that exploits negative control samples (present in every experimental batch) to close the domain gap caused by batch effects in biomedical imaging. Claims to be the first to successfully close this gap for deep learning.

entry.title: EvoForest: A Novel Machine-Learning Paradigm via Open-Ended Evolution of Computational Graphs

author.name: Kamer Ali Yuksel, Hassan Sawaf

entry.summary: Presents EvoForest, a hybrid neuro-symbolic system for open-ended evolution of computational graphs, discovering what transformations to compute rather than just optimizing weights. Targets non-differentiable objectives and interpretable models.

entry.title: Improving Molecular Force Fields with Minimal Temporal Information

author.name: Ali Mollahosseini, Mohammed Haroon Dupty, Wee Sun Lee

entry.summary: Explores incorporating minimal temporal information from molecular dynamics simulations into neural network force fields, leveraging the sequential nature of MD trajectories rather than treating configurations independently.

entry.title: Decision-Focused Federated Learning Under Heterogeneous Objectives and Constraints

author.name: Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos, Alexander Vinel

entry.summary: Proposes Decision-Focused Federated Learning (DFFL), combining predict-then-optimize with federated learning where clients have heterogeneous objectives and constraints. Develops theoretical heterogeneity bounds for the SPO+ surrogate loss using support function representations. This bridges two important ML subfields but is fairly niche in scope.

entry.title: RADS: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sample Selection Improves Transfer Learning in Low-resource and Imbalanced Clinical Settings

author.name: Wei Han, David Martinez, Anna Khanina, Lawrence Cavedon, Karin Verspoor

entry.summary: Introduces RADS, using reinforcement learning for sample selection in transfer learning under extremely low-resource and class-imbalanced clinical settings. Outperforms traditional active learning methods that tend to favor outliers under these conditions.

entry.title: MOMO: A framework for seamless physical, verbal, and graphical robot skill learning and adaptation

author.name: Markus Knauer, Edoardo Fiorini, Maximilian M\"uhlbauer, Stefan Schneyer, Promwat Angsuratanawech, Florian Samuel Lay, Timo Bachmann, Samuel Bustamante, Korbinian Nottensteiner, Freek Stulp, Alin Albu-Sch\"affer, Jo\~ao Silv\'erio, Thomas Eiband

entry.summary: Presents MOMO, a multimodal robot skill adaptation framework combining kinesthetic touch, natural language, and graphical interfaces. Integrates energy-based intention detection, LLM-based tool architecture, and interactive visualization for non-expert robot programming.

entry.title: Towards Certified Malware Detection: Provable Guarantees Against Evasion Attacks

author.name: Nandakrishna Giri, Asmitha K. A., Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P

entry.summary: Proposes a certifiably robust malware detection framework using randomized smoothing through feature ablation and noise injection. Provides formal certificates guaranteeing robustness against feature-space perturbations within specific radii.

entry.title: LEXIS: LatEnt ProXimal Interaction Signatures for 3D HOI from an Image

author.name: Dimitrije Anti\'c, Alvaro Budria, George Paschalidis, Sai Kumar Dwivedi, Dimitrios Tzionas

entry.summary: Proposes LEXIS with InterFields, a representation encoding dense continuous proximity across body and object surfaces for 3D human-object interaction reconstruction from single images. Uses learned interaction signatures conditioned on action and object geometry.

entry.title: Dual-Cluster Memory Agent: Resolving Multi-Paradigm Ambiguity in Optimization Problem Solving

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Yuchen Wan, Boxuan Zhang, Zesheng Yang, Lingling Zhang, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DCM-Agent, a training-free agent that helps LLMs solve optimization problems with structural ambiguity by leveraging dual-cluster memory (modeling and coding clusters) of historical solutions, distilled into structured guidance types.

entry.title: Decoding Text Spans for Efficient and Accurate Named-Entity Recognition

author.name: Andrea Maracani, Savas Ozkan, Junyi Zhu, Sinan Mutlu, Mete Ozay

entry.summary: Proposes SpanDec, an efficient span-based NER framework that consolidates span representation interactions into a decoder, reducing inference cost compared to methods that enumerate and process all candidate spans individually.

entry.title: SAKE: Self-aware Knowledge Exploitation-Exploration for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Jielong Tang, Xujie Yuan, Jiayang Liu, Jianxing Yu, Xiao Dong, Lin Chen, Yunlai Teng, Shimin Di, Jian Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SAKE for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition, combining self-aware knowledge exploitation (internal MLLM knowledge) with exploration (external retrieval) to handle long-tailed and unseen entities in social media.

entry.title: Lucky High Dynamic Range Smartphone Imaging

author.name: Baiang Li, Ruyu Yan, Ethan Tseng, Zhoutong Zhang, Adam Finkelstein, Jiawen Chen, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Proposes a Lucky HDR method for smartphone photography that robustly captures high dynamic range from bracketed exposures using lightweight networks, where every output pixel is a convex combination of input pixels to avoid hallucination.

entry.title: FurnSet: Exploiting Repeats for 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Paul Dobre, Xin Wang, Hongzhou Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FurnSet, a framework for single-view 3D scene reconstruction that explicitly identifies and leverages repeated object instances (like furniture) to improve reconstruction through set-aware self-attention and complementary observation aggregation.

entry.title: From Scene to Object: Text-Guided Dual-Gaze Prediction

author.name: Zehong Ke, Yanbo Jiang, Jinhao Li, Zhiyuan Liu, Yiqian Tu, Qingwen Meng, Heye Huang, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-branch gaze prediction framework for autonomous driving that predicts both scene-level and object-level driver attention with text grounding, constructing a new object-level driver attention dataset.

entry.title: ConeSep: Cone-based Robust Noise-Unlearning Compositional Network for Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Mingyu Zhang, Zhiheng Fu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes ConeSep for composed image retrieval that addresses noisy triplet correspondence using cone-based representations, identifying unique challenges of 'hard noise' that breaks the small loss hypothesis.

entry.title: Where are they looking in the operating room?

author.name: Keqi Chen, S\'eraphin Baributsa, Lilien Schewski, Vinkle Srivastav, Didier Mutter, Guido Beldi, Sandra Keller, Nicolas Padoy

entry.summary: Introduces gaze-following to the surgical domain by extending the 4D-OR and Team-OR datasets with gaze annotations, demonstrating potential for understanding clinical roles, surgical phases, and team communication.

entry.title: RSRCC: A Remote Sensing Regional Change Comprehension Benchmark Constructed via Retrieval-Augmented Best-of-N Ranking

author.name: Roie Kazoom, Yotam Gigi, George Leifman, Tomer Shekel, Genady Beryozkin

entry.summary: Presents RSRCC, a 126K-question benchmark for remote sensing change question-answering focused on localized, change-specific questions requiring reasoning about particular semantic changes.

entry.title: MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation

author.name: Yang Luo, Yan Gong, Yongsheng Gao, Xiaoying Sun, Jie Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MAPRPose, a two-stage framework for multi-object 6D pose estimation using mask-aware correspondences for proposals and amodal-driven ROI prediction for refinement in cluttered scenes.

entry.title: Secure Rate-Distortion-Perception: A Randomized Distributed Function Computation Approach for Realism

author.name: Gustaf {\AA}hlgren, Onur G\"unl\"u

entry.summary: Studies secure rate-distortion-perception trade-offs for neural image compression over public channels, characterizing exact secure RDP regions for noiseless channels and deriving bounds for broadcast channels.

entry.title: Response time of lateral predictive coding and benefits of modular structures

author.name: Guanghui Cai, Zhen-Ye Huang, Weikang Wang, Hai-Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Investigates response-time reduction in lateral predictive coding neural circuits, finding that modular network structures can minimize response time without compromising prediction quality.
